			AddAbilityAndSetLevelDelay(baojun, 'is_god_buff_plus')
			play_particle("effect/god/1.vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, baojun, 5)
		end
	elseif ability == 'flag_god6' then
		if baojun:HasAbility('is_god_buff_plus_plus') == false then
			baojun.is_god_zhanhou = true
			AddAbilityAndSetLevelDelay(baojun, 'is_god_buff_plus_plus')
			play_particle("effect/god/1.vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, baojun, 5)
		end
	elseif ability == 'flag_drawf2' or ability == 'is_dwarf_buff' or ability == 'is_dwarf_buff_plus' then
		if baojun:HasAbility(ability) == false and baojun:Script_GetAttackRange() > 205 then
			AddAbilityAndSetLevelDelay(baojun, ability)
		end
	elseif ability == 'flag_centaur4' or ability == 'is_centaur_buff_plus' then
		if baojun:HasAbility(ability) == false and baojun:Script_GetAttackRange() <= 205 then
			AddAbilityAndSetLevelDelay(baojun, ability)
		end
	elseif ability == 'flag_monk2' or ability == 'is_monk_buff' then
		if baojun:HasAbility(ability) == false and baojun:Script_GetAttackRange() <= 205 then
			AddAbilityAndSetLevelDelay(baojun, ability)
		end
	elseif ability == 'is_shaman' or ability == 'is_shaman1' then

		if baojun:HasAbility(ability) == false then
			AddAbilityAndSetLevelDelay(baojun, ability)
		end
	end
end

function MirrorARound(teamid)
	local opp = nil
	local my_opp = nil
	local opp_lineup = {}
	Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
		for myteam, enemyteam in pairs(_G.counterpart) do
			if enemyteam == teamid then
				opp = myteam
			end
			if myteam == teamid then
				my_opp = enemyteam --my_opp是teamid要打的敌人队伍
			end
		end
		if opp ~= nil then
			--镜像棋手
			if IsSkipBattle(TeamId2Hero(teamid)) == false then
				Timers:CreateTimer(1, function()
					local opp_hero = TeamId2Hero(my_opp)
					local opp_steam_id = opp_hero.steam_id
					local opp_model = GetStat(opp_hero:GetPlayerID(), 'zhugong_model')
					local opp_effect = GetStat(opp_hero:GetPlayerID(), 'zhugong_effect')
					local mirror_chesser = MirrorChesserGuest(
						teamid,
						opp_model,
						opp_effect,
						opp_hero:GetModelScale(),
						opp_hero.ori_skin,
						opp_hero.win_streak
					)
					mirror_chesser.onduty_hero = GetStat(opp_hero:GetPlayerID(), 'zhugong')
					opp_hero.my_away_mirror_chesser = mirror_chesser
					MakeGreevil(mirror_chesser, true)

					if mirror_chesser ~= nil and opp_hero.pet_name1 ~= nil and opp_hero.pet_name1 ~= 't000' then
						local pet = RefreshPets(mirror_chesser, mirror_chesser.pet1, opp_hero.pet_name1, 2)
						if pet ~= nil then
							pet:SetForwardVector(Vector(0, -1, 0))
						end
					end
				end)
			else
				SkipBattleDrum(TeamId2Hero(teamid))
			end

			for i = 1, 4 do
				for j = 1, 8 do
					if _G.mychess[teamid][i .. '_' .. j] ~= nil then
						_G.unit[teamid][i .. '_' .. j] = 1
						_G.unit[opp][(9 - i) .. '_' .. (9 - j)] = 1

						--opp_lineup记录魔术卡牌偷牌池
						local loopcount = GetChessRank1Count(_G.mychess[teamid][i .. '_' .. j].chess)
						for t = 1, loopcount do
							table.insert(opp_lineup, GetChessBaseName(_G.mychess[teamid][i .. '_' .. j].chess))
						end

						--复制棋子（把teamid场地的i,j格子的棋子复制到opp场地镜像的位置）
						MirrorAChess(teamid, i, j, opp)
					end
				end
			end
			TeamId2Hero(opp).last_opp_lineup = opp_lineup
			Timers:CreateTimer(4.5, function()
				AddComboAbility(teamid)
			end)
		end
	end)
end

function MirrorAChess(teamid, i, j, opp)
	if IsSkipBattle(TeamId2Hero(opp)) == true then
		return
	end

	--获取出场动画
	local hero = TeamId2Hero(teamid)
	if IsUnitExist(hero) == false then
		return
	end
	local animation_info = GetAnimation(hero.animation or 'n000')


	Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(0, 0.9), function()
		--播放起始动画
		local ppp = ShowTPEffectAtPosition(XY2Vector(9 - j, 9 - i, opp), animation_info.tp_effect)
		-- if hero.ti_tp_effect then
		-- 	ShowTITPEffectAtPosition(XY2Vector(9-j,9-i,opp),hero.ti_tp_effect)
		-- end

		Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(1.1, 2.1), function()
			if ppp ~= nil then
				ParticleManager:DestroyParticle(ppp, true)
				ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(ppp)
			end
			local x = CreateUnitByName(_G.mychess[teamid][i .. '_' .. j].chess, XY2Vector(9 - j, 9 - i, opp), true, nil,
				nil, DOTA_TEAM_NEUTRALS)
			SetChessSpecialLook(x)
			x:SetForwardVector(Vector(0, -1, 0))
			ExecuteOrderFromTable({
				UnitIndex = x:entindex(),
				OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_POSITION,
				Position = x:GetOrigin() + Vector(0, -1, 0),
				Queue = 0,
			})

			x.y_x = (9 - i) .. '_' .. (9 - j)
			x.y = 9 - i
			x.x = 9 - j
			x.team_id = 4
			x.at_team_id = opp
			x.from_team_id = teamid
			AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'root_self')
			AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'jiaoxie_wudi')
			table.insert(_G.to_be_destory_list[opp], x)

			--复制物品
			local uindex = _G.mychess[teamid][i .. '_' .. j].index
			for slot = 0, 9 do
				if EntIndexToHScript(uindex):GetItemInSlot(slot) ~= nil then
					local name = EntIndexToHScript(uindex):GetItemInSlot(slot):GetAbilityName()
					if name ~= nil then
						x:AddItemByName(name)
					end
				end
			end
			local v = _G.mychess[teamid][i .. '_' .. j]
			if v ~= nil and v.rubick_a ~= nil then
				if x:FindAbilityByName(v.rubick_a) == nil then
					local a_level = GetChessStar(x) or 1
					if x:HasModifier('modifier_item_ahalimushenzhang') then
						a_level = a_level + 1
					end
					if a_level > 3 then
						a_level = 3
					end
					AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, v.rubick_a, a_level)
					x.steal_ability = v.rubick_a
					if v.rubick_range ~= nil and v.rubick_range > 210 then
						if x:Script_GetAttackRange() > 410 then
							AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'attackrange_600', 1)
						else
							AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'attackrange_400', 1)
						end
					end
				end
			elseif GetChessAbility(x) then
				local a, a_level = GetChessAbility(x)
				if x:FindAbilityByName(a) == nil then
					AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, a, a_level)
				end
			end
			--传入vchess
			CopyChessProperties(x, v)
			SyncAllPermanentStackCount(x)
			--播放后续动画
			if animation_info.tp_sound ~= nil then
				EmitSoundOn(animation_info.tp_sound, x)
			end
			if animation_info.animation_modifier ~= nil then
				BlinkChessX({ caster = x, blink_type = animation_info.animation_modifier })
			end
			if animation_info.end_effect ~= nil then
				play_particle(animation_info.end_effect, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, x, 3)
			end
		end)
	end)
end

			vi.y = 9 - vi.y

			for _, data in pairs(_G.cloudlineup['' .. _G.battle_round]) do

					MirrorChesserGuest(

						cloud_hero_effect,

function LoadOneCloudChess(vi, team)
	--获取出场动画
	--暂时用默认的TP，后续可以改造为获取镜像玩家装备的动画
	local animation_info = GetAnimation('n000')

	Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(0, 0.9), function()
		--播放起始动画
		local ppp = ShowTPEffectAtPosition(XY2Vector((9 - vi.x), (9 - vi.y), team), animation_info.tp_effect)

		Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(0.1, 2.1), function()
			if ppp ~= nil then
				ParticleManager:DestroyParticle(ppp, true)
				ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(ppp)
			end
			_G.unit[team][(9 - vi.y) .. '_' .. (9 - vi.x)] = 1

			CreateChessOnBoardAsync(vi.chess, XY2Vector((9 - vi.x), (9 - vi.y), team), DOTA_TEAM_NEUTRALS, function(x)
				x:SetForwardVector(Vector(0, -1, 0))
				x.y_x = (9 - vi.y) .. '_' .. (9 - vi.x)
				x.y = (9 - vi.y)
				x.x = (9 - vi.x)
				x.team_id = 4
				x.at_team_id = team

				AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'root_self')
				AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'jiaoxie_wudi')
				table.insert(_G.to_be_destory_list[team], x)
				--复制物品
				if vi.lastitem ~= nil then
					for _, it in pairs(vi.lastitem) do
						x:AddItemByName(it)
					end
				end


				x.mojing_ability = vi.mojing_ability
				x.mojing_ability_level = vi.mojing_ability_level
				x.extra_synergy = CopyTable(vi.extra_synergy)
				if x.extra_synergy ~= nil and table.maxn(x.extra_synergy) > 0 then
					for _, ss in pairs(x.extra_synergy) do
						AddSynergy({
							caster = x,
							synergy = ss
						})
					end
					x:FindAbilityByName('dac_guai_base'):ApplyDataDrivenModifier(x, x, 'modifier_shining', {})
				end

				--播放后续动画
				if animation_info.tp_sound ~= nil then
					EmitSoundOn(animation_info.tp_sound, x)
				end
				if animation_info.animation_modifier ~= nil then
					BlinkChessX({ caster = x, blink_type = animation_info.animation_modifier })
				end
				if animation_info.end_effect ~= nil then
					play_particle(animation_info.end_effect, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, x, 3)
				end
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

	-- 	AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u,"pudge_dismember",u:FindAbilityByName('pudge_meat_hook_lua'):GetLevel())
	-- 	-- u:FindAbilityByName("pudge_dismember"):SetHidden(true)
	-- end
	-- if base_ability == 'lion_mana_drain_datadriven' and u:HasAbility('lion_mana_drain_datadriven') then
	-- 	AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u,"keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic",1)
	-- 	u:FindAbilityByName("keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic"):SetHidden(true)
	-- end

	if base_ability == 'jakiro_macropyre' and u:HasAbility('jakiro_macropyre') then
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, "jakiro_ice_path", u:FindAbilityByName('jakiro_macropyre'):GetLevel())
		if RandomInt(1, 100) > 50 then
			u:FindAbilityByName("jakiro_ice_path"):SetHidden(true)
			u.ice_or_fire = 'fire'
		else
			u:FindAbilityByName("jakiro_macropyre"):SetHidden(true)
			u.ice_or_fire = 'ice'
		end
	end

	if u:HasAbility('is_assassin') then
		u.has_assassin_blink = true
	end
end

--游戏循环2.3——自走！

executionFunctions.name: ChessAI
executionFunctions.bodyRaw:
function ChessAI(u, force_delay)
	if IsUnitExist(u) == false or GetBattleTable(u.at_team_id or u.team_id) == false then
		return
	end
	if _G.start_ai == true and (u.aitimer == nil or Timers.timers[u.aitimer] == nil) then
		if _G.is_game_ended == true then
			return
		end

		u:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_SPAWN)
		u:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)

		-- RemoveAbilityAndModifier(u, 'is_ghost')
		local a_name, a_level = GetChessAbility(u)
		--狗头人复制
		if u.kobold_result ~= nil and _G.is_game_ended ~= true then
			local yonghengzhipan = nil
			if u:HasModifier('modifier_yonghengzhipan_yongheng_buff') == true then
				for slot = 0, 5 do
					if u:GetItemInSlot(slot) ~= nil then
						local ability = u:GetItemInSlot(slot)
						local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
						if name == 'item_yonghengzhipan' then
							yonghengzhipan = ability
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end

			Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(0.01, 0.1), function()
				--复制狗头人
				local aposition = FindEmptyGridAtUnit(u)
				local team_id = u:GetTeam()
				local at_team_id = u.at_team_id or u.team_id
				local items = GetAllItemsAndCDInUnits({ [1] = u })
				local x = nil
				if u:HasAbility('is_kobold') and u.kobold_result ~= u:GetUnitName() then
					--塑形？（3）狗头人
					TransformAChess(u, u.kobold_result, -1, function(x)
						x:FindAbilityByName('dac_guai_base'):ApplyDataDrivenModifier(x, x, 'modifier_transfer_debuff', {duration = RandomInt(4,6)})
						AddModifierKill(x, RandomInt(15,20))
						play_particle("particles/econ/items/meepo/meepo_colossal_crystal_chorus/meepo_divining_rod_poof_start_ring.vpcf", PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, x, 5)
						EmitSoundOn('Hero_Meepo.CrystalsLayer01',x)
					end)
				end
				if u.kobold_count >= 1 then
					if u.kobold_item == 1 then
						--（2）狗头人
						local kill_duration = nil
						if string.find(u:GetUnitName(), 'pve_') == nil then
							kill_duration = 60
						end
						x = SummonOneChess({
							teamid = team_id,
							position = aposition,
							chessname = u.kobold_result,
							at_teamid = at_team_id,
							-- items = items,
							items = nil,
							-- kill_duration = kill_duration,
						})
						if yonghengzhipan ~= nil then
							yonghengzhipan:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(x, x, 'modifier_yonghengzhipan_yongheng_buff', {})
						end
					else
						local kill_duration = nil
						if string.find(u:GetUnitName(), 'pve_') == nil then
							kill_duration = 30
						end
						x = SummonOneChess({
							teamid = team_id,
							position = aposition,
							chessname = u.kobold_result,
							at_teamid = at_team_id,
							items = nil,
							-- kill_duration = kill_duration,
						})
						if yonghengzhipan ~= nil then
							yonghengzhipan:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(x, x, 'modifier_yonghengzhipan_yongheng_buff', {})
						end
					end
					if u.bh_gold == nil and u:HasAbility('bh_shuriken') == true then
						x:RemoveModifierByName(x, x, 'modifier_bh_gold', {})
					end
					BlinkChessX({ caster = x, blink_type = "breaksoil" })
					x.is_copied_kobold = true
					x.bh_gold = u.bh_gold
					ExtendBeastBuff(x, u, true, true)
				end
				u.kobold_result = nil
				u.kobold_item = nil
				u.kobold_count = nil
			end)
		end

		if u:HasAbility('skeletonking_reincarnation') == true then
			local ability = u:FindAbilityByName('skeletonking_reincarnation')
			if IsUnitExist(u) == true and u.hand_index == nil then
				ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, 'modifier_skeletonking_reincarnation_aura', {})
				ability.snk_level = GetLevel(u)
			end
		end

		--组合技的棋子：添加附加技能
		AddAffiliatedAbility(u, a_name, a_level)

		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, 'root_self')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, 'jiaoxie')
		RemoveAbilityAndModifier(u, 'jiaoxie_wudi')

		--自制血条：暂时不用
		-- AddHPBar2HPBarTable({
		-- 	unit_index = u:entindex(),
		-- })

		--计算AI启动延迟
		local start_delay = 0
		if u:HasAbility('is_assassin') == false and u:HasModifier('modifier_is_assassin_buff_plus_plus') then
			--非刺客的9刺buff，一开始不跳跃，也不延迟
			u.assassin_blinked = true
			-- start_delay = 0
		end
		local delay = RandomFloat(0.1, 1.0)

		if u.y == 1 or u.y == 8 then
			start_delay = RandomFloat(0.3, 0.4)
		elseif u.y == 2 or u.y == 7 then
			start_delay = RandomFloat(0.2, 0.3)
		elseif u.y == 3 or u.y == 6 then
			start_delay = RandomFloat(0.1, 0.2)
		elseif u.y == 4 or u.y == 5 then
			start_delay = RandomFloat(0.05, 0.1)
		end

		--新版delay方案，按星级启动
		local chess_star = GetChessStar(u)
		if u:HasAbility('is_assassin') or chess_star == 1 then
			delay = RandomFloat(1.1, 1.5)
		elseif chess_star == 2 then
			delay = RandomFloat(0.6, 1)
		elseif chess_star == 3 then
			delay = RandomFloat(0.1, 0.5)
		end

		delay = delay + start_delay

		if force_delay and force_delay > 0 then
			delay = force_delay
		end

		if u:HasModifier('modifier_item_fulingsuo') == true or u:HasModifier('modifier_item_atuosi') == true or u:HasModifier('modifier_is_priest_buff_plus') or u:HasModifier('modifier_is_centaur_buff') == true or u:HasAbility('broodmother_silken_bola') or u:HasModifier('modifier_dw_flower') then
			delay = RandomFloat(0.01, 0.1)
		end
		--战吼（卡尔的技能不算战吼）
		if u:FindAbilityByName('sil_silence_all') ~= nil and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false then 
			EmitSoundOn('Hero_Silencer.GlobalSilence.Cast',u)
			SilencerGlobalSilence({
				caster = u,
				ability = u:FindAbilityByName('sil_silence_all'),
			})
		end
		if u:HasAbility('grimstroke_stroke_of_fate_lua') and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false then
			local aa = u:FindAbilityByName('grimstroke_stroke_of_fate_lua')
			local tt = FindFarthestGridForAbility(u,'grimstroke_stroke_of_fate_lua')
			local unluckypoint = tt['skip_postion']
			if unluckypoint ~= nil then
				u.is_comboing = true
				local newOrder = {
					UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
					OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
					TargetIndex = nil,                  --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
					AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName('grimstroke_stroke_of_fate_lua'):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
					Position = unluckypoint,            --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
					Queue = 0                           --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
				}
				ExecuteOrderFromTable(newOrder)
				OnChessCastStart(u)
				Timers:CreateTimer(2,function()
					u:FindAbilityByName('grimstroke_stroke_of_fate_lua'):SetActivated(false)
					u.is_comboing = nil
				end)
			end
		end 
		-- if u:HasModifier('modifier_gs_mingyunzhibi') and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false then
		-- 	u:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_gs_mingyunzhibi')
		-- 	u:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_CAST_ABILITY_3)
		-- 	EmitSoundOn('Hero_Grimstroke.SoulChain.Cast', u)

		-- 	local fuhun_ability = u:FindAbilityByName('gs_mingyunzhibi')
		-- 	local dog_count = GetAbilityKV(fuhun_ability, "fuhun_count") or 1
		-- 	local dogs = FindNUnluckyDog({
		-- 		caster = u,
		-- 		dog_count = dog_count,
		-- 		relation = 'enemy',
		-- 		ignore_nomana = false,
		-- 		ignore_invisible = true,
		-- 		ignore_fullmana = false,
		-- 		ignore_magic_immune = true,
		-- 		ignore_modifier = { 'modifier_gs_fuhun' }
		-- 	})
		-- 	for _, dd in pairs(dogs) do
		-- 		dd.fuhun_debuff = fuhun_ability
		-- 		play_particle_delay("particles/units/heroes/hero_grimstroke/grimstroke_darkartistry_dmg_stroke_tgt.vpcf",
		-- 			PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, dd, 5, 1)
		-- 	end
		-- 	--新命运之笔
		-- 	-- local unluckydog = FindUnluckyDog(u)
		-- 	-- if unluckydog ~= nil and u:HasAbility('gs_moji') then
		-- 	-- 	ExecuteOrderFromTable({
		-- 	-- 		UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
		-- 	-- 		OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION,
		-- 	-- 		TargetIndex = nil,--unluckydog:entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
		-- 	-- 		AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName('gs_moji'):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
		-- 	-- 		Position = unluckydog:GetAbsOrigin(), --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
		-- 	-- 		Queue = 0 --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
		-- 	-- 	})
		-- 	-- 	-- u.evolve_result = RandomEvolveResult(u)
		-- 	-- end
		-- end

		--精灵守卫：羁绊
		if u:HasAbility('wisp_tether_lua') and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false then
			local w_ability = u:FindAbilityByName('wisp_tether_lua')
			local ally_around = FindUnitsInRadiusByTeam({
				team = u:GetTeam(),
				chessboard_id = u.at_team_id or u.team_id or u:GetTeam(),
				role = 1,
				position = u:GetAbsOrigin(),
				radius = GetAbilityKV(w_ability, "radius"),
				exclude_modifier = "modifier_wisp_tether_buff",
			})
			local power_count = nil
			if u:HasModifier('modifier_wisp_altar_power_count') then 
				power_count = u:FindModifierByName('modifier_wisp_altar_power_count'):GetStackCount()
			end
			-- if power_count then 
			-- 	for c = 1,power_count do
			-- 		u:FindAbilityByName('wisp_altar_power'):ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, 'modifier_wisp_altar_power',{})
			-- 	end
			-- end
			for i,v in pairs(ally_around) do 
				if IsUnitExist(v) == true and v:HasAbility('is_ward') == false then
					local pid = ParticleManager:CreateParticle('effect/wisp_tether/wisp_tether.vpcf', PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, u)
					ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(pid,0,u,PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW,"attach_hitloc",u:GetAbsOrigin(),true)
					ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(pid,1,v,PATTACH_POINT_FOLLOW,"attach_hitloc",v:GetAbsOrigin(),true)
					if u.io_ally_index_table == nil then 
						u.io_ally_index_table = {}
					end
					table.insert(u.io_ally_index_table,v:entindex())
					v.io_ally_pid = pid
					w_ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, v, 'modifier_wisp_tether_buff', {})
					if power_count and v:HasAbility('is_druid') then
						if u:HasModifier('modifier_wisp_altar_power_count') then 
							u:FindAbilityByName('wisp_altar_power'):ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, v, 'modifier_wisp_altar_power_count', {})
							v:FindModifierByName('modifier_wisp_altar_power_count'):SetStackCount(power_count)
						end
						-- for c = 1,power_count do
						-- 	u:FindAbilityByName('wisp_altar_power'):ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, v, 'modifier_wisp_altar_power',{})
						-- end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if u:HasModifier('modifier_smoke_screen_trigger') and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false then
			u:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_smoke_screen_trigger')
			--riki：烟雾弹
			local enemy_team_id = 4
			if u:GetTeam() == 4 then
				enemy_team_id = u.at_team_id
			end
			RevealOneChess(u)
			-- u.evolve_result = RandomEvolveResult(u)
			if IsLonely4Team(u, enemy_team_id) == true then
				--如果没有近身敌人，就在u的镜像位置施放
				InvisibleUnitCast({
					caster = u,
					ability = 'smoke_screen_datadriven',
					level = u:FindAbilityByName('smoke_screen_trigger'):GetLevel(),
					caster_position = CentrosymmetryPosition(u.at_team_id or u.team_id, u.x, u.y),
					position = CentrosymmetryPosition(u.at_team_id or u.team_id, u.x, u.y),
					ignore_nether_ward = true,
				})
			else
				--否则，在u的位置施放
				InvisibleUnitCast({
					caster = u,
					ability = 'smoke_screen_datadriven',
					level = u:FindAbilityByName('smoke_screen_trigger'):GetLevel(),
					caster_position = XY2Vector(u.x, u.y, u.at_team_id or u.team_id),
					position = XY2Vector(u.x, u.y, u.at_team_id or u.team_id),
					ignore_nether_ward = true,
				})
			end
		end
		if u:HasModifier('modifier_dw_flower') == true and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false then
			--荆棘迷宫
			local flower_ability = u:FindAbilityByName('dw_flower')
			local duration = GetAbilityKV(flower_ability, "duration") or 8.0
			local enemy_count = GetAbilityKV(flower_ability, "enemy_count") or 1
			local dogs = FindNUnluckyDog({
				caster = u,
				dog_count = enemy_count,
				relation = 'enemy',
				ignore_nomana = false,
				ignore_invisible = true,
				ignore_fullmana = false,
				ignore_magic_immune = true,
				ignore_modifier = { 'modifier_dw_flower_debuff' }
			})
			if dogs ~= nil and table.maxn(dogs) > 0 then
				for _, d in pairs(dogs) do
					if IsUnitExist(d) == true then
						d.dw_flower = u
						ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile({
							Target = d,
							Source = u,
							Ability = flower_ability,
							EffectName =
							'particles/econ/items/dark_willow/dark_willow_immortal_2021/dw_2021_willow_wisp_bedlam_projectile.vpcf',
							bDodgeable = false,
							iMoveSpeed = 800,
							bProvidesVision = false,
							iSourceAttachment = DOTA_PROJECTILE_ATTACHMENT_ATTACK_1
						})
					end
				end
			end
			EmitSoundOn('Hero_DarkWillow.Bramble.Target', u)
			u:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_CAST_ABILITY_4)
			u:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_dw_flower')
			flower_ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, 'modifier_dw_flower_self', { duration = 3 })
		end
		if u:HasAbility('arc_double') and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false and u.is_copied_aw ~= true and u.is_copied_kobold ~= true then
			--战斗中生成的本尊，复制本尊
			local aposition = FindEmptyGridAtUnit(u, nil, true)
			local team_id = u:GetTeam()
			local at_team_id = u.at_team_id or u.team_id
			local items = GetAllItemsAndCDInUnits({ [1] = u })
			local chess_star = GetChessStar(u) or 1
			local x = SummonOneChess({
				teamid = u:GetTeam(),
				position = aposition,
				chessname = u:GetUnitName(),
				at_teamid = at_team_id,
				items = items,
				kill_duration = 10 * chess_star,
			})
			if x then
				BlinkChessX({ caster = x, blink_type = "breaksoil" })
				x.is_copied_aw = true
			end
		end
		if u:FindAbilityByName('rubick_qiequ') ~= nil and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false then
			--拉比克窃取技能
			local steal_chess = nil
			local steal_chess_unit = nil
			local try_time = 0
			local all_chess = GetValidChessOnBoard(u.at_team_id or u.team_id)
			while steal_chess == nil and try_time < 100 do
				local rant = RandomInt(1, table.maxn(all_chess))
				local cc = all_chess[rant]
				if IsUnitExist(cc) and cc:GetTeam() ~= u.team_id and not string.find(cc:GetUnitName(), 'chess_rubick') and not string.find(cc:GetUnitName(), 'chess_meepo') and not string.find(cc:GetUnitName(), 'chess_kael') and not cc:HasAbility('is_ward') and _G.ability_behavior_list[_G.chess_ability_list[cc:GetUnitName()]] ~= 0 and cc:GetMaxMana() > 0 then
					steal_chess = cc:GetUnitName()
					steal_chess_unit = cc
				end
				try_time = try_time + 1
			end
			if steal_chess ~= nil and not string.find(steal_chess, 'chess_rubick') then
				if steal_chess_unit:Script_GetAttackRange() > 210 then
					if steal_chess_unit:Script_GetAttackRange() > 410 then
						AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, 'attackrange_600', 1)
					else
						AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, 'attackrange_400', 1)
					end
				end
				local a = _G.chess_ability_list[steal_chess]
				if a ~= nil then
					u.steal_ability = a
					if u.team_id ~= 4 then
						for ii, vv in pairs(_G.mychess[u.team_id]) do
							if vv.index == u:entindex() then
								vv.rubick_a = a
								vv.rubick_range = steal_chess_unit:Script_GetAttackRange()
							end
						end
					end
					if u:FindAbilityByName(a) == nil then
						AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, a, a_level)
					else
						u:FindAbilityByName(a):SetLevel(a_level)
					end
					RemoveAbilityAndModifier(u, 'rubick_qiequ')
					--特效、音效
					local effect_name = "particles/units/heroes/hero_rubick/rubick_spell_steal.vpcf"
					if u:GetUnitName() == 'chess_rubick11' then
						effect_name = "particles/econ/items/rubick/rubick_arcana/rubick_arc_spell_steal_default.vpcf"
					end
					ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile({
						Target = u,
						Source = steal_chess_unit,
						Ability = nil,
						EffectName = effect_name,
						bDodgeable = false,
						iMoveSpeed = 1200,
						bProvidesVision = false,
						iSourceAttachment = DOTA_PROJECTILE_ATTACHMENT_ATTACK_1
					})
					u:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_CAST_ABILITY_4)
					EmitSoundOn("Hero_Rubick.SpellSteal.Cast", u)
					UpdateBHGold({ caster = u })
					-- u.evolve_result = RandomEvolveResult(u)
				end
			end
		end
		--孽主：恶魔之扉
		if u:HasAbility('au_portal') == true and u.is_au_called == nil and HasKillModifier(u) == false then
			local p = FindEmptyGridAtUnit(u, true)
			if p ~= nil then
				local hasDemonBuff = false
				if u:HasModifier('modifier_is_demon_buff') == true then
					hasDemonBuff = true
				end
				EmitSoundOn('Hero_Underlord.Portal.Spawn',u)
				SummonMinion(u, 'au_portal', 1, nil, function(w)
					local demon_sum = SumFriendDemonOnChessboard(w)
					w:SetBaseMaxHealth(demon_sum)
					w:SetMaxHealth(demon_sum)
					w:SetHealth(demon_sum)
					local ability_level = u:FindAbilityByName('au_portal'):GetLevel() or 1
					AddAbilityAndSetLevel(w,'ward_portal',ability_level)
					w.portal_star = ability_level
					if hasDemonBuff == true then
						AddAbilityAndSetLevel(w,'is_demon_buff',1)
					end
				end, p, true, nil, true)
			end
		end

		--kael
		if u:FindAbilityByName('invoke') ~= nil then
			local find_team = 0
			local find_combo = nil
			if _G.battle_boss[_G.battle_round - 1] == nil then
				if u.team_id == 4 then
					find_team = u.at_team_id
				else
					find_team = _G.counterpart[u.team_id]
				end
			end
			if find_team ~= 0 and TeamId2Hero(find_team) then
				find_combo = TeamId2Hero(find_team).kael_combo
			end
			RefreshKaelOrbandAbility(u, find_combo)
		end
		--魔晶：偷技能
		if u:GetTeam() ~= 4 and u:HasModifier('modifier_illusion') == false and u:HasModifier('modifier_item_ahalimumojing') and u.mojing_ability == nil and u:GetMaxMana() >= 100 then
			local steal_ability = nil
			local steal_ability_level = nil
			local steal_chess_unit = nil
			local try_time = 0
			local all_chess = GetValidChessOnBoard(u.at_team_id or u.team_id)
			local is_melee = false
			if u:Script_GetAttackRange() <= 205 then
				is_melee = true
			end
			local black_list = {
				--不能偷的技能
				'invoke',
				'bh_shuriken',
				'leshrac_pulse_nova',
				'jakiro_macropyre',
				'jakiro_ice_path',
			}
			local black_list_melee = {
				--近战不能偷的技能
			}
			local black_list_ranged = {
				--远程不能偷的技能
				'tusk_walrus_punch',
			}
			--优先偷等级高的
			while steal_ability == nil and try_time < 30 do
				local rant = RandomInt(1, table.maxn(all_chess))
				local cc = all_chess[rant]

				if IsUnitExist(cc) and cc:GetTeam() ~= u.team_id and not cc:HasAbility('is_ward') and cc:GetMaxMana() > 0 then
					local aa, aa_level = GetChessAbility(cc)
					if FindValueInTable(black_list, aa) == false then
						if (is_melee == true and FindValueInTable(black_list_melee, aa) == false) or (is_melee == false and FindValueInTable(black_list_ranged, aa) == false) then
							if _G.ability_behavior_list[aa] ~= 0 and u:HasAbility(aa) == false and aa_level >= GetChessStar(u) then
								steal_ability = aa
								steal_ability_level = aa_level
								steal_chess_unit = cc
							end
						end
					end
				end
				try_time = try_time + 1
			end
			--没有就偷等级低的
			while steal_ability == nil and try_time < 100 do
				local rant = RandomInt(1, table.maxn(all_chess))
				local cc = all_chess[rant]

				if IsUnitExist(cc) and cc:GetTeam() ~= u.team_id and not cc:HasAbility('is_ward') and cc:GetMaxMana() > 0 then
					local aa, aa_level = GetChessAbility(cc)
					if FindValueInTable(black_list, aa) == false then
						if (is_melee == true and FindValueInTable(black_list_melee, aa) == false) or (is_melee == false and FindValueInTable(black_list_ranged, aa) == false) then
							if _G.ability_behavior_list[aa] ~= 0 and u:HasAbility(aa) == false then
								steal_ability = aa
								steal_ability_level = aa_level
								steal_chess_unit = cc
							end
						end
					end
				end
				try_time = try_time + 1
			end
			if steal_ability ~= nil and steal_chess_unit ~= nil then
				u.mojing_ability = steal_ability
				u.mojing_ability_level = steal_ability_level or 1

				local v_chess = Unit2VChess(u)
				v_chess['mojing_ability'] = u.mojing_ability
				v_chess['mojing_ability_level'] = u.mojing_ability_level

				AddMojingAbility({
					caster = u,
				})

				local effect_name = "particles/units/heroes/hero_rubick/rubick_spell_steal.vpcf"
				ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile({
					Target = u,
					Source = steal_chess_unit,
					Ability = nil,
					EffectName = effect_name,
					bDodgeable = false,
					iMoveSpeed = 1200,
					bProvidesVision = false,
					iSourceAttachment = DOTA_PROJECTILE_ATTACHMENT_ATTACK_1
				})
				EmitSoundOn("Hero_Rubick.SpellSteal.Cast", u)
				AddAffiliatedAbility(u, steal_ability, steal_ability_level)
			end
		end
		--新食人魔：开吃！
		if u:HasModifier('modifier_is_ogre_buff') == true then
			Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(0, 0.3), function()
				OgreEat(u)
			end)
		end

		--骑士：如果有相邻骑士，启动原地开盾，必开盾
		if u:HasAbility('is_knight') and u.knight_first_shield == nil then
			if FindFriendlyChessInRadius(u, 'is_knight', 205) == true then
				if u:HasAbility('is_knight_buff') then
					-- delay = delay + 2
					--开盾
					u:FindAbilityByName('is_knight_buff'):ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, 'modifier_is_knight_buff_2',
						{ duration = delay })
					OnKnightBuffCreate({
						caster = u
					})
					play_particle('particles/econ/items/omniknight/omni_ti8_head/omniknight_repel_buff_ti8_rings.vpcf',
						PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, u, 3)
					EmitSoundOn("dac.shield", u)
				end
				-- u:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_DISABLED)
				u.knight_first_shield = true
				-- u.cannot_move = true
				-- Timers:CreateTimer(delay,function()
				-- 	if IsUnitExist(u) then
				-- 		u.cannot_move = nil
				-- 		u:RemoveGesture(ACT_DOTA_DISABLED)
				-- 	end
				-- end)
			else
				u.knight_first_shield = true
			end
		end

		--开战时获得buff（中途给上就没效果的）
		if u:HasModifier('modifier_item_feijiangxiaomao') == true and u.is_tb_ally == nil and GetLevel(u) <= 5 then
			local ability = u:FindModifierByName('modifier_item_feijiangxiaomao'):GetAbility()
			if ability ~= nil then
				ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, 'modifier_item_feijiangxiaomao_buff', {})
			end
		end

		u.base_model_scale = u:GetModelScale()
		RevealOneChess(u)

		--TODO：不知道是做什么用的代码
		-- Timers:CreateTimer(2, function()
		-- 	if IsUnitExist(u) == true and u.is_removing ~= true then
		-- 		_G.unit[u.at_team_id or u.team_id][u.y_x] = 1
		-- 	end
		-- end)

		u.aitimer = Timers:CreateTimer(delay, function()
			--棋子死亡或者回合/游戏结束，就终止AI
			if u == nil or u:IsNull() == true or u:IsAlive() == false or u.alreadywon == true or u.transforming == true or _G.is_game_ended == true or u.is_removing == true or u:HasModifier('modifier_item_test_no_ai') then
				return
			end

			if GetBattleTable(u.at_team_id or u.team_id) == false then
				return
			end

			--容错
			if u:FindAbilityByName('modifier_no_hp_bar') ~= nil or u:FindAbilityByName('modifier_jiaoxie_wudi') ~= nil then
				DestroyUnit(u)
				return
			end

			--如果棋子在不宜打断的状态，就暂缓运行AI
			if u:IsStunned() == true or IsHexxed(u) == true or u.is_moving == true or u.is_comboing == true or u:IsChanneling() == true or u.centaur_rushing == true or u:IsFrozen() == true or HasMovingModifier(u) == true or (u:HasModifier('modifier_is_ogre_buff') == true and u.is_eat ~= true) or u:HasModifier('modifier_phoenix_sun_ray') == true then
				return 0.3
			end

			--AI思考正式开始
			u.ai_started = true
			local ai_delay = 0

			if u:HasAbility('priest_mind_control') and u:FindAbilityByName('priest_mind_control'):IsCooldownReady() == true and u.mind_control_priest == 1 and u.priest_triggered ~= true then
				PriestSalvation(u)
				return 1
			end

			--被点金手点了：延迟结算
			if u.dianjin_killer ~= nil then
				if HasKillModifier(u) == true then
					ApplyDamage({
						victim = u,
						attacker = u.dianjin_killer,
						damage = u:GetHealth(),
						damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE,
					})
					u.dianjin_killer = nil
					if u.dianjin_money ~= nil and u.dianjin_money > 0 then
						DropMoneyBag(u:GetAbsOrigin(), u:GetAbsOrigin(), 300, u.dianjin_money, 200)
						u.dianjin_money = nil
					end
				else
					--永久棋子，点金无效
					u.dianjin_killer = nil
					u.dianjin_money = nil
				end
				return
			end

			--荆棘迷宫
			if u.dw_flower ~= nil and IsUnitExist(u.dw_flower) == true then
				if BlockByLinken(u) == false then
					local flower_ability = u.dw_flower:FindAbilityByName('dw_flower')
					local duration = GetAbilityKV(flower_ability, "duration") or 3.0
					flower_ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u.dw_flower, u, 'modifier_dw_flower_debuff',
						{ duration = duration })
				end
				u.dw_flower = nil
				return 1
			end
			--术士：满血则卖血变成蓝
			if u.warlock_finished == nil and u:FindAbilityByName('is_warlock') ~= nil and u:GetHealth() >= u:GetMaxHealth()*0.99 and u:GetMaxMana() > 0 then
				EmitSoundOn("dac.warlock.soul_ring", u)
				play_particle("particles/items2_fx/soul_ring.vpcf", PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, u, 2)
				u:StartGestureWithPlaybackRate(ACT_DOTA_CAST_ABILITY_1, 1)
				local result = u:GetHealth() * 0.75
				if result < 1 then result = 1 end
				u:SetHealth(result)
				local u_mana = u:GetMana() + 50
				if u_mana > 100 then
					u_mana = 100
				end
				u:SetMana(u_mana)
				u.warlock_finished = true
				return 0.5
			end
			--萨满：进化
			if u.evolve_result ~= nil and IsUnitExist(u) and u:HasModifier('modifier_is_centaur_buff') == false and u:HasModifier("modifier_kill") == false then
				local evolveresult = EvolveThink(u)
				if evolveresult then
					return evolveresult
				end
			end

			--被墨客缚魂了的
			if u.fuhun_debuff ~= nil then
				if IsUnitExist(u.fuhun_debuff:GetOwner()) == true then
					EmitSoundOn('Hero_Grimstroke.DarkArtistry.Cast', u)
					u.fuhun_debuff:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u.fuhun_debuff:GetOwner(), u, 'modifier_gs_fuhun', nil)
					u.fuhun_debuff = nil
					return 1
				end
			end

			--被TB魔化了
			if u.is_mohua_max_star ~= nil and u.is_evolving ~= true and u:HasModifier('modifier_is_centaur_buff') == false then
				TransformAMohuaChess(u, true, u.demon_buff)
				return 1
			end

			--龙、古龙号角：开局满蓝，神
			if u.is_dragon_zhanhou == true then
				u.is_dragon_zhanhou = nil
				play_particle("particles/units/heroes/hero_monkey_king/monkey_king_fur_army_positions_ring_dragon.vpcf",
					PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, u, 5)
				EmitSoundOn('Hero_DragonKnight.DragonTail.DragonFormCast', u)
				AddChessManaInstant(u, 100)
				return 0.5
			end
			--神
			if u.is_god_zhanhou == true then
				u.is_god_zhanhou = nil
				play_particle("effect/god/1.vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, u, 5)
				EmitSoundOn('Hero_Disruptor.StaticStorm.Cast', u)
				return 0.5
			end

			--【优先级1.5：法力虚空】
			if u.mana_void == true and u:HasAbility('antimage_mana_void') == true and u:FindAbilityByName('antimage_mana_void'):IsCooldownReady() == true then
				local unluckydog = FindLeastManaEnemy(u)
				if unluckydog ~= nil then
					local newOrder = {
						UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
						OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
						TargetIndex = unluckydog:entindex(),               --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
						AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName('antimage_mana_void'):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
						Position = nil,                                    --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
						Queue = 0                                          --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
					}
					ExecuteOrderFromTable(newOrder)
					OnChessCastStart(u)
					u.mana_void = nil
					return 1.5
				end
			end

			--【优先级2：使用物品】
			if IsChessCanUseItem(u) == true then
				local active_item_table = {
					item_bkb = function() return TriggerBKB(u) end,
					item_renjia = function() return TriggerRenjia(u) end,
					item_hudie = function() return TriggerHudie(u) end,
					item_sadan = function() return TriggerSadan(u) end,
					item_tiaodao = function() return TriggerTiaodao(u) end,
					item_jinghunzhiren = function(u, lengjing) return TriggerJinghunzhiren(u, lengjing) end,
					item_yangdao = function(u, lengjing) return TriggerYangdao(u, lengjing) end,
					item_atuosi = function(u, lengjing) return TriggerAtuosi(u, lengjing) end,
					item_jurenzhijie = function() return TriggerJurenzhijie(u) end,
					item_fulingsuo = function() return TriggerFulingsuo(u) end,
					item_hongzhang = function(u, lengjing) return TriggerHongzhang(u, lengjing) end,
					item_xueji = function(u, lengjing) return TriggerXueji(u, lengjing) end,
					item_tiantangzhiji = function(u, lengjing) return TriggerTiantangzhiji(u, lengjing) end,
					item_huanyingfu = function() return TriggerHuanyingfu(u) end,
					item_xiwa = function() return TriggerXiwa(u) end,
					item_dongchayandou = function() return TriggerDongchayandou(u) end,
					item_fenzhengmiansha = function() return TriggerFenzhengmiansha(u) end,
					item_chihongjia = function() return TriggerChihongjia(u) end,
					item_aoshuxie = function() return TriggerAoshuxie(u) end,
					item_xiangweixie = function() return TriggerXiangweixie(u) end,
					item_yuanlifazhang = function() return TriggerYuanlifazhang(u) end,
					item_dianjinshou = function(u, lengjing) return TriggerDianjinshou(u, lengjing) end,
					item_meiken = function() return TriggerMeiken(u) end,
					item_weishijingjia = function() return TriggerWeishijingjia(u) end,
					item_minglingshu = function() return TriggerMinglingshu(u) end,
					item_shuaxinqiu = function() return TriggerShuaxinqiu(u) end,
					item_zhipeitoukui = function() return TriggerZhipeitoukui(u) end,
					item_dayunchui = function(u, lengjing) return TriggerDayunchui(u, lengjing) end,
				}
				local item_lengjing_list = { 'item_yangdao', 'item_atuosi', 'item_hongzhang', 'item_xueji',
					'item_tiantangzhiji', 'item_dianjinshou', 'item_dayunchui' }
				for item_name, item_function in pairs(active_item_table) do
					local result = TriggerActiveItem(u, item_name, item_function,
						FindValueInTable(item_lengjing_list, item_name))
					if result ~= nil and result > 0 then
						return result + ai_delay
					end
				end
			end

			--【优先级3：释放技能】
			local a = GetChessAbility(u)
			if a ~= nil and u:FindAbilityByName(a) ~= nil and IsChessCanCast(u) == true then
				--多重施法
				if u:HasModifier('modifier_om_multi_cast') == true and u.is_multi_cast_enable == true then
					--使用多重施法buff，刷新技能
					local refresh_result = MultiCast(u)
					if refresh_result ~= nil and refresh_result > 0 then
						return refresh_result + ai_delay
					end
				else
					--卡尔：切换技能
					if u.kael_ability_refresh == true then
						local kael_result = RefreshKaelOrbandAbility(u)
						if kael_result then
							return 0.5 + ai_delay
						end
					end
				end

				local cast_ability = u:FindAbilityByName(a)
				if cast_ability ~= nil and u.mojing_ability ~= nil and cast_ability:IsCooldownReady() == false then
					local a_ability = u:FindAbilityByName(u.mojing_ability)
					if a_ability ~= nil and a_ability:IsCooldownReady() == true and a_ability:IsActivated() == true then
						cast_ability = a_ability
						a = u.mojing_ability
					end
				end
				--决定是否要放技能
				if u:GetMana() >= GetManaCostX(u, a) and _G.ability_behavior_list[a] ~= 0 and u:FindAbilityByName(a):IsCooldownReady() == true then
					--有蓝，释放技能
					if _G.ability_behavior_list[a] == 1 then
						--单位目标
						local unluckydog = FindUnluckyDog(u)
						if a == "windrunner_shackleshot" then
							--束缚击
							unluckydog = FindUnluckyDogClosest(u) or unluckydog
							-- if unluckydog ~= nil then
							-- 	ExecuteOrderFromTable({
							-- 		 UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
							-- 		 OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
							-- 		 TargetIndex = unluckydog:entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
							-- 		 AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName(a):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
							-- 		 Position = nil, --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
							-- 		 Queue = 0 --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
							-- 	 })

							-- 	 TargetedSpell(u,unluckydog,a)
							-- end
						end
						if unluckydog ~= nil then
							local newOrder = {
								UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
								OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
								TargetIndex = unluckydog:entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
								AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName(a):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
								Position = nil,            --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
								Queue = 0                  --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
							}
							ExecuteOrderFromTable(newOrder)
							if a == 'shadow_shaman_voodoo' then
								TriggerHex({
									target = unluckydog
								})
							end
							TargetedSpell(u, unluckydog, a)

							OnChessCastStart(u, unluckydog)
							return RandomFloat(0.5, 2) + ai_delay
						end
					elseif _G.ability_behavior_list[a] == 2 then
						--无目标
						local unluckydog = nil
						if a == 'axe_berserkers_call' or a == 'juggernaut_blade_fury_lua' or a == 'shredder_whirling_death' or a == 'rattletrap_battery_assault' or a == 'siren_song' then
							--确保斧王、剑圣、发条、伐木机近身范围内有敌人（如果希望靠近敌人前就放技能，可以调整 205 的值。）
							if FindAttackTargetOrUnluckyDogInRange(u, 205) ~= nil then
								local newOrder = {
									UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
									OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
									TargetIndex = nil,                             --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
									AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName(a):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
									Position = nil,                                --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
									Queue = 0                                      --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
								}
								ExecuteOrderFromTable(newOrder)
								OnChessCastStart(u)
								return RandomFloat(0.5, 2) + ai_delay
							end
						elseif a == 'void_astralstep' then
							--紫猫：确保能跳出来才放技能
							if FindAstralStepPosition(u) ~= nil then
								local newOrder = {
									UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
									OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
									TargetIndex = nil,                             --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
									AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName(a):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
									Position = nil,                                --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
									Queue = 0                                      --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
								}
								ExecuteOrderFromTable(newOrder)
								OnChessCastStart(u)
								return RandomFloat(0.5, 2) + ai_delay
							end
						elseif a == 'leshrac_pulse_nova' then
							if u:FindAbilityByName(a):GetToggleState() == false then
								u:FindAbilityByName(a):ToggleAbility()
							end
						elseif unluckydog ~= nil or a ~= 'tiny_touzhi' then
							local newOrder = {
								UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
								OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
								TargetIndex = nil,         --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
								AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName(a):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
								Position = nil,            --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
								Queue = 0                  --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
							}
							ExecuteOrderFromTable(newOrder)

							if a == 'alchemist_chemical_rage' then
								AcidSpray({
									caster = u,
									ability_level = u:FindAbilityByName(a):GetLevel(),
								})
								local aa = u:FindAbilityByName('alchemist_chemical_rage')
								if aa ~= nil then
									local bonus_max_health = GetAbilityKV(aa, "bonus_max_health") or 250
									ModMaxHP({
										caster = u,
										const = bonus_max_health,
										is_heal = true,
									})
								end
							end
							if a == "sven_gods_strength" then
								CastGodsStrength(u)
							end
							OnChessCastStart(u)
							return RandomFloat(0.5, 2) + ai_delay
						end
					elseif _G.ability_behavior_list[a] == 4 then
						--以自己为目标
						if u ~= nil then
							local newOrder = {
								UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
								OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
								TargetIndex = u:entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
								AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName(a):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
								Position = nil,            --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
								Queue = 0                  --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
							}
							ExecuteOrderFromTable(newOrder)
							OnChessCastStart(u)
							return RandomFloat(0.5, 2) + ai_delay
						end
					elseif _G.ability_behavior_list[a] == 5 then
						--近身单位目标
						local unluckydog = FindAttackTargetOrUnluckyDogInRange(u, u:Script_GetAttackRange())
						if unluckydog ~= nil and unluckydog:HasModifier("modifier_jiaoxie_wudi") == false then
							local newOrder = {
								UnitIndex = u:entindex(),
								OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET,
								TargetIndex = unluckydog:entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when targeting units
								AbilityIndex = u:FindAbilityByName(a):entindex(), --Optional.  Only used when casting abilities
								Position = nil,            --Optional.  Only used when targeting the ground
								Queue = 0                  --Optional.  Used for queueing up abilities
							}
							ExecuteOrderFromTable(newOrder)

							TargetedSpell(u, unluckydog, a)
							OnChessCastStart(u, unluckydog)
							return RandomFloat(0.5, 2) + ai_delay
						end
				elseif _G.ability_behavior_list[a] == 6 then

					return 0.2
				else
					--正常行走：走向最近的能攻击到敌人的格子
					find_ok = FindNextSkipPosition(u)
				end

				-- if find_ok ~= nil then
				-- 	if HasShoes(u) then
				-- 		blink_type = 'jump'
				-- 	elseif blink_type == 'run' then
				-- 		local pos1 = XY2Vector(u.x,u.y,u.at_team_id or u.team_id)

				-- 			find_ok = (find_ok - pos1):Normalized() * 128 * 3 + pos1
				-- 		end
				-- 	end
				-- end

				if find_ok ~= nil then
					if HasShoes(u) and u:HasModifier("modifier_is_centaur_buff") == false then
						blink_type = 'jump'
					end
					--走！
					local x = Vector2X(find_ok, u.at_team_id or u.team_id)
					local y = Vector2Y(find_ok, u.at_team_id or u.team_id)
					local xx = u.x
					local yy = u.y
					_G.unit[u.at_team_id or u.team_id][y .. '_' .. x] = 1
					u:SetForwardVector((find_ok - u:GetAbsOrigin()):Normalized())
					u.is_moving = true
					BlinkChessX({
						p = find_ok,
						caster = u,
						blink_type = blink_type,
						set_forward = true,
					})
					u.y_x = y .. '_' .. x
					u.y = y
					u.x = x
					_G.unit[u.at_team_id or u.team_id][yy .. '_' .. xx] = nil

					if u:HasModifier("modifier_is_centaur_buff") then
						if u:HasModifier('modifier_bloodseeker_thirst') == false then
							u:AddNewModifier(u, nil, "modifier_bloodseeker_thirst", nil)
						end
						u.centaur_rushing = true
						local speed = u:GetIdealSpeed()
						local duration = (find_ok - u:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D() / speed
						Timers:CreateTimer(duration + 0.5, function()
							u.centaur_rushing = false
							u:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_is_centaur_buff")
							u:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_bloodseeker_thirst")
						end)
					end

						u:RemoveModifierByName("modifier_bloodseeker_thirst")

		end)
	end

function GaussRandom()
	local ranbase = 9999
	while (ranbase > 4 or ranbase < -4) do
		local u = RandomInt(1, 10000) / 10000
		local v = RandomInt(1, 10000) / 10000
		ranbase = math.sqrt((-2) * math.log(u)) * math.cos(2 * math.pi * v)
	end
	local ranresult = math.ceil(ranbase * 128 + 512)
	return ranresult
end

function StatAllPlayerLineup()
	for team_i = 6, 13 do
		local hero = TeamId2Hero(team_i)
		if IsUnitExist(hero) == true and hero.steam_id ~= nil then
			local lineup_count = 0
			local lineup = ''
			local chess_5 = 0
			local chess_5_2star = 0
			local lineup_value = 0

			for _, v in pairs(_G.mychess[team_i]) do
				if v ~= nil and v.chess ~= nil and lineup_count < hero:GetLevel() then
					lineup = lineup .. v.chess .. ','
					lineup_count = lineup_count + 1

					local cname = GetChessBaseName(v.chess)
					local ccost = _G.chess_2_mana[cname] or 1
					local chess_star = GetChessNameStar(v.chess) or 1
					if ccost == 5 then
						chess_5 = chess_5 + 1
						if chess_star >= 2 then
							chess_5_2star = chess_5_2star + 1
						end
					end

					lineup_value = lineup_value + ccost*GetChessRank1Count(v.chess)
				end
			end
			if lineup_value >= _G.stat_info[hero.steam_id]['max_lineup_value'] and _G.battle_round <= 50 then
				--更新最大阵容价值
				_G.stat_info[hero.steam_id]['max_lineup_value'] = lineup_value
				_G.stat_info[hero.steam_id]['max_lineup_value_lineup'] = lineup
			end
			--更新当前阵容价值
			_G.stat_info[hero.steam_id]['lineup_value'] = lineup_value

			if _G.egg_quest == 'q029' and chess_5_2star >= 3 then
				SetQuest(team_i, true)
			end
			SetStat(hero:GetPlayerID(), 'chess_lineup', lineup, true)

			local hands = ''
			if hero.hand_entities ~= nil then
				for _, ent in pairs(hero.hand_entities) do
					if ent ~= nil and ent:IsNull() == false then
						hands = hands .. ent:GetUnitName() .. ','
					end
				end
			end
			SetStat(hero:GetPlayerID(), 'chess_hand', hands, false)



		end
	end
end

	local live_count = GetAlivePlayerCount()
	local last_steamid = _G.send_status[1]
	local last_hero = PlayerId2Hero(_G.steamid2playerid[last_steamid])
	if _G.playing_player_count > 1 then

				end
			end
		end
	end

function TransformAChess(u, new_chess_name, item_inherited, cb)
	if u.transforming == true then
		return
	end
	u.transforming = true
	if IsUnitExist(u) == false or IsHexxed(u) == true then
		return
	end
	-- if u:HasModifier('modifier_item_zhusidoupeng') == true then
	-- 	--宽容之靴：免疫变形
	-- 	new_chess_name = u:GetUnitName()
	-- end
	u:Stop()
	FillEmptySlot(u)
	AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, 'jiaoxie')
	RemoveAbilityAndModifier(u, 'jiaoxie_wudi')

	u:SetModelScale(0.5)
	local combo_ability_table = {}
	for _, m in pairs(u:FindAllModifiers()) do
		if m:IsDebuff() == false then
			local a = m:GetAbility()
			if a and a:GetAbilityName() then
				if _G.combo_ability_list[a:GetAbilityName()] ~= nil and a:GetAbilityName() ~= 'wisp_altar_power' then
					table.insert(combo_ability_table, a:GetAbilityName())
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local hp_bouns_by_6_orc = u.hp_bouns_by_6_orc
	local demon_count = u.demon_count
	local ptable = CopyChessProperties(nil, u)
	local initial_index = u:entindex()
	local old_chess_name = u:GetUnitName()
	local k_m, k_d = GetKillModifierAndDuration(u)

	local yonghengzhipan = nil
	if u:HasModifier('modifier_yonghengzhipan_yongheng_buff') == true then
		for slot = 0, 5 do
			if u:GetItemInSlot(slot) ~= nil then
				local ability = u:GetItemInSlot(slot)
				local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
				if name == 'item_yonghengzhipan' then
					yonghengzhipan = ability
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end

	Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
		if IsUnitExist(u) == true then
			local team_id = u:GetTeam()
			local chessboard_id = u.at_team_id or u.team_id
			local aposition = XY2Vector(u.x, u.y, chessboard_id) or u:GetAbsOrigin()

			local hp_per = 100 * u:GetHealth() / u:GetMaxHealth()
			local knight_first_shield = u.knight_first_shield
			local vchess_index = u.vchess_index
			RemoveFromToBeDestroyList(u)
			if IsUnitExist(u) == true then
				local forward_vector = u:GetForwardVector()
				forward_vector.z = 0

				local items = {}
				--大于0是进化装备，0是保留装备，-1是没有装备
				if item_inherited == 2 or item_inherited == 1 then
					items = GetAllItemsAndCDInUnits({ [1] = u }, item_inherited, true)
				elseif item_inherited == 0 then
					items = GetAllItemsAndCDInUnits({ [1] = u }, nil, true)
				elseif item_inherited == -1 then
					items = {} --3萨满
					-- items = {{
					-- 	item = 'item_ahalimumojing'
					-- }}
				end
				if u.mohua_items then
					items = u.mohua_items
				end
				local jiubei_buff = false
				if u:HasModifier('modifier_item_goutourenjiubei') then 
					jiubei_buff = true
				end
				if u:GetTeam() ~= 4 and u.ori_team ~= 4 then
					RemoveChessFromWaterIDList(u)
					SaveItem(team_id, u:entindex(), function()
						if IsUnitExist(u) then
							u:SetModelScale(0.0001)
							AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, 'no_hp_bar')
							u.no_death_rattle = true
							u:ForceKill(false)
						end
					end)
				else
					u:SetModelScale(0.0001)
					if IsUnitExist(u) then
						AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u, 'no_hp_bar')
						u.no_death_rattle = true
						u:ForceKill(false)
					end
				end

				local new_team = team_id
				if u.ori_team then
					new_team = u.ori_team
				end
				SummonOneChessAsync({
					teamid = new_team,
					position = aposition,

function ModMaxHP(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	if keys.target then
		caster = keys.target
	end
	local is_heal = keys.is_heal or false
	if IsUnitExist(caster) == false or caster:IsAncient() == true or caster:HasAbility('is_ward') then
		--信使无效，守卫无效
		return
	end

	if not caster.hp_basic then
		caster.hp_basic = caster:GetMaxHealth()
	end
	local per = tonumber(keys.per or 0)
	local const = tonumber(keys.const or 0)
	caster.hp_per = tonumber(caster.hp_per or 0) + per
	if keys.from_ability == "is_undead_buff_plus_plus" then
		if IsUnitExist(caster) == false or caster.is_in_battle == false or caster.alreadywon == true then
			return
		end
		if caster.hp_per <= -95 then
			caster.hp_per = -95
		else
			play_particle('particles/units/heroes/hero_skeletonking/wraith_king_death.vpcf', PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW,
				caster, 5)
		end
	end
	caster.hp_const = tonumber(caster.hp_const or 0) + const
	local hp_result_max = math.floor(caster.hp_basic * (100 + caster.hp_per) / 100 + caster.hp_const)
	if hp_result_max < 1 then hp_result_max = 1 end

	if is_heal == true then
		local heal = hp_result_max - caster:GetMaxHealth()
		caster:SetBaseMaxHealth(hp_result_max)
		caster:SetMaxHealth(hp_result_max)

		caster:Heal(heal, caster)
	else
		local hp_per_now = caster:GetHealth() / caster:GetMaxHealth()
		caster:SetBaseMaxHealth(hp_result_max)
		caster:SetMaxHealth(hp_result_max)
		local hp_result = hp_result_max * hp_per_now

		if hp_result < 1 then hp_result = 1 end
		caster:SetHealth(hp_result)
	end
end

	local split = keys.split or false
	local ignore_magic_immune = false
	local exclude_modifier = keys.exclude_modifier
	if keys.ignore_magic_immune ~= nil then
		ignore_magic_immune = keys.ignore_magic_immune
	end

	Timers:CreateTimer(delay, function()
		local unlucky_dogs = FindUnitsInRadiusByTeam({
			team = team,
			chessboard_id = caster.at_team_id or caster.team_id or caster:GetTeam(),
			role = role,
			position = position,
			radius = radius,
			exclude_modifier = exclude_modifier,
		})
		local count = 1
		if split then
			count = table.maxn(unlucky_dogs) or 1
		end
		for _, u in pairs(unlucky_dogs) do
			if u ~= nil and u:IsNull() == false and u:IsAlive() == true then
				if damage_per ~= nil and damage_per > 0 then
					local max_hp = u:GetMaxHealth()
					damage = max_hp / 100 * damage_per
				end

				if ignore_magic_immune or not u:IsMagicImmune() then
					ApplyDamage({
						victim = u,
						attacker = caster,
						damage_type = damage_type,
						damage = damage / count,
						ability = keys.ability_entity or caster:FindAbilityByName(keys.ability)
					})
					if stun_duration > 0 then
						u:AddNewModifier(u, nil, "modifier_stunned", { duration = stun_duration })
					end

					if stun_partical ~= nil and damage > 10 then
						play_particle(stun_partical, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, u, 3)
					end
					if knockback == true then
						KnockBack({
							caster = caster,
							target = u,
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

	end

	if attacker ~= nil then

	end

	if attacker:GetClassname() ~= 'npc_dota_creature' or attacker:IsHero() == true then

	if IsUnitExist(attacker) == true and caster:HasModifier('modifier_br_web_debuff') and (attacker:HasAbility('br_web') or attacker:GetUnitName() == 'br_spider1' or attacker:GetUnitName() == 'br_spider2' or attacker:GetUnitName() == 'br_spider3') then

				local v_max_hp = caster:GetMaxHealth()
				local v_hp_per = 1.0 * v_hp / v_max_hp
				local duang_check_prob = 0
				if math.tan(v_hp_per * 3) > 0 and v_hp_per < 0.2 then
					duang_check_prob = math.sqrt(damage / 150) * math.pow(1 / math.tan(v_hp_per * 2.8), 1 / 3) *

					--幸运挂坠的加成
					duang_check_prob = duang_check_prob * GetLuckyValue(attacker) + GetHoodwinkAcornValue(caster)
				end

				if RandomFloat(0, 1) <= duang_check_prob then
					play_particle("effect/monk_duang/1positions.vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, caster, 2)

					-- caster:ForceKill(false)
					ApplyDamage({
						victim = caster,
						attacker = attacker,
						damage = caster:GetHealth(),
						damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE,
					})
					if attacker:HasModifier("modifier_is_monk_buff_plus_plus") then 
						attacker:Heal(caster:GetHealth(), attacker)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	if IsUnitExist(attacker) and caster:GetTeam() ~= attacker:GetTeam() and attacker:HasModifier("modifier_is_monk_buff_plus") and keys.ability ~= 'is_monk_buff_plus' then
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.3, function()
			if IsUnitExist(caster) == true then
				local monk_hp = caster:GetHealth()
				local v_max_hp = caster:GetMaxHealth()
				local v_hp_per = 1.0 * monk_hp / v_max_hp
				local duang_per = 0.2
				duang_per = duang_per * math.sqrt(damage / 100)
				--幸运挂坠的加成
				duang_per = duang_per * GetLuckyValue(attacker) + GetHoodwinkAcornValue(caster)

				if RandomFloat(0, 1) < duang_per and v_hp_per >= 0.4 then

function AddCourierExp(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	if caster == nil then
		return
	end
	local team_id = caster:GetTeam()
	local xpnow = caster:GetCurrentXP()
	local xpadd = keys.xpadd or 4
	local disable_quick_lvl_up = keys.disable_quick_lvl_up

	if disable_quick_lvl_up == true then
		caster.quick_lvl_up = false
	end
	local xpnextlvl = _G.HeroExpTable[caster:GetLevel() + 1]
	if xpnextlvl == nil then return end
	local next_lvl_exp = math.ceil((xpnextlvl - xpnow) / 4) * 4
	local exp_multiplier = 1
	-- if caster:HasModifier('modifier_talent_2b_promotion') then 
	-- 	exp_multiplier = 0.75
	-- end

	local cost = keys.cost or 4
	-- 判断是否满足直接升级的条件
	if caster.quick_lvl_up == true and xpnextlvl - xpnow > 4 and caster:GetMana() >= (next_lvl_exp - 4)*exp_multiplier then
		xpadd = next_lvl_exp
		cost = (next_lvl_exp - 4)*exp_multiplier
		caster:Script_ReduceMana(cost, caster:FindAbilityByName("exp_book"))
		caster:FindAbilityByName("exp_book"):StartCooldown(2)
		caster:FindAbilityByName("exp_book_mana_reduced"):StartCooldown(2)
	end
	-- 添加经验值，达到10级则禁用经验按钮
	--talent4b


	local level_max = 10
	if caster:HasModifier('modifier_talent_4b_morepieces') then
		level_max = 16
	end
	if keys.ignore_level_restrict then
		caster:AddExperience(xpadd, 0, false, false)
	elseif caster:GetLevel() < level_max then
		-- 超过最大等级时去掉经验值零头
		if xpadd + xpnow > _G.HeroExpTable[level_max] then
			xpadd = _G.HeroExpTable[level_max] - xpnow
		end
		if xpadd < 0 then
			xpadd = 0
		end
		caster:AddExperience(xpadd, 0, false, false)
	end

	UnlockExpLimit(caster)

	-- 显示特效
	if cost > 0 then
		if xpadd > 4 then
			play_particle_controlIndex(
			"particles/econ/items/keeper_of_the_light/kotl_ti10_immortal/kotl_ti10_blinding_light.vpcf",
				PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, caster.ai_pet or caster, 3, 1)
			EmitSoundOn("quick_lvl_up", caster)
		else
			AMHC:CreateParticle("particles/units/heroes/hero_oracle/oracle_false_promise_cast_enemy.vpcf",
				PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, false, caster.ai_pet or caster, 3)
			EmitSoundOn("lvl_up", caster)
		end
		AMHC:CreateNumberEffect(caster.ai_pet or caster, cost, 3, AMHC.MSG_MISS, { 80, 80, 255 }, 3)
	end
	Timers:CreateTimer(0.5, function()
		AMHC:CreateNumberEffect(caster.ai_pet or caster, xpadd, 3, AMHC.MSG_MISS, { 255, 255, 128 }, 0)
	end)
	-- 添加快速升级标签
	caster.quick_lvl_up = true
	Timers:CreateTimer(0.18, function()
		caster.quick_lvl_up = false
	end)
	-- 同步UI
	CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(team_id, "show_gold", {
		key = GetClientKey(team_id),
		gold = caster:GetMana(),
		lose_streak = caster.lose_streak or 0,
		win_streak = caster.win_streak or 0,
		box_level = CalStreakPlusBoxLevel(TeamId2Hero(team_id)),
	})
	CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("sync_hp", {
		player_id = caster:GetPlayerID(),
		hp = caster:GetHealth(),
		hp_max = caster:GetMaxHealth(),
		mp = caster:GetMana(),
		level = caster:GetLevel(),
		win_streak = caster.win_streak,
		unit_index = caster:entindex(),
		courier_id = caster.onduty_hero,
	})
end

executionFunctions.name: AddModelScalePlus
executionFunctions.bodyRaw:
function AddModelScalePlus(unit, scale)
	local curr_scale = unit:GetModelScale()
	local step = (scale - curr_scale) / 10
	unit.target_scale = scale
	Timers:CreateTimer(0.01, function()
		if not IsUnitExist(unit) then
			return
		end
		if unit.target_scale ~= scale then
			return
		end
		curr_scale = unit:GetModelScale()
		if math.abs(curr_scale - unit.target_scale) <= math.abs(step) then
			unit:SetModelScale(unit.target_scale)
			return
		else
			unit:SetModelScale(curr_scale + step)
			return 0.05
		end
	end)
end

function SummonOneMinion(caster, minion, p, chessai, shenshi_buff, force_team, bian_buff)
	local summon_chess_duarion_table = {
		bm_beast1 = 30,
		bm_beast2 = 30,
		bm_beast3 = 30,
		ss_ssr_ward = 20,
		lyc_wolf1 = 30,
		lyc_wolf2 = 30,
		lyc_wolf3 = 30,
		veno_ward1 = 20,
		veno_ward2 = 20,
		veno_ward3 = 15,
		invoker_spirit1 = 40,
		invoker_spirit2 = 40,
		invoker_spirit3 = 40,
		fur_tree1 = 30,
		fur_tree2 = 20,
		fur_tree3 = 20,
		ld_bear1 = 40,
		ld_bear2 = 40,
		ld_bear3 = 40,
		minglingshu = 20,
		br_spider1 = 30,
		br_spider2 = 30,
		br_spider3 = 40,
		wl_golem = 10,
		visage_dragon_1 = 40,
		visage_dragon_2 = 40,
		visage_dragon_3 = 30,
		disarm_ward = 40,
		taunt_ward = 40,
		nether_ward = 40,
		necro_archer = 4,
		necro_warrior = 4,
	}
	if caster == nil or caster:IsNull() == true then
		return
	end
	if chessai == nil then
		chessai = true
	end

	if p == 'random' then
		p = FindUnluckyPoint(caster)
	end

	local v = p or FindEmptyGridAtUnit(caster)
	local teamid = force_team or caster.team_id
	local at_teamid = caster.at_team_id or caster.team_id

	if IsEmptyGrid(at_teamid, Vector2X(v, at_teamid), Vector2Y(v, at_teamid)) ~= true then
		v = FindEmptyGridAtPosition(at_teamid, v)
	end

	if v == nil then
		return
	end
	if teamid == nil then
		return
	end
	if at_teamid == nil then
		return
	end

	--判断英雄是否还活着
	local hero1 = TeamId2Hero(at_teamid)
	if hero1 == nil or hero1:IsNull() or hero1:IsAlive() == false then
		return
	end

	if _G.battle_timer <= 1 then
		return
	end

	local x = CreateUnitByName(minion, v, true, nil, nil, teamid)
	x.is_summoned = true
	x.damage_owner = caster

	table.insert(_G.to_be_destory_list[at_teamid], x)
	if IsUnitExist(caster) == true then
		x:SetForwardVector(caster:GetForwardVector() or Vector(0, 1, 0))
	end
	AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'root_self')
	AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'jiaoxie_wudi')
	x.x = Vector2X(v, at_teamid)
	x.y = Vector2Y(v, at_teamid)
	x.y_x = '' .. x.y .. '_' .. x.x
	x.at_team_id = at_teamid
	x.team_id = teamid
	_G.unit[at_teamid][x.y .. '_' .. x.x] = 1
	if chessai == true then
		Timers:CreateTimer(function()
			if x == nil or x:IsNull() == true or x:IsAlive() == false or x.alreadywon == true then
				return
			end
			ChessAI(x)
			return 1
		end)
	end

	ExtendBeastBuff(x, caster, shenshi_buff, bian_buff)

	--有持续时间的召唤物
	if summon_chess_duarion_table[minion] ~= nil then
		local duration = summon_chess_duarion_table[minion]
		if minion == 'wl_golem' then
			duration = RandomInt(5, 10)
		end
		if minion == 'necro_archer' or minion == 'necro_warrior' then
			local level = GetLevel(caster)
			if level > 9 then
				level = 9
			end
			duration = 5 + level * 3
		end
		-- if shenshi_buff and caster:FindModifierByName('modifier_item_zhaohuanshenshi') ~= nil then
		-- 	duration = duration * 2
		-- end
		if bian_buff and caster:FindModifierByName('modifier_item_linglichangbian') ~= nil then
			duration = duration * 2
		end
		AddModifierKill(x, duration)
	end

	--动态设置死灵战士/死灵法师的血量、技能等
	if minion == 'necro_warrior' then
		local level = GetLevel(caster)
		if level > 9 then
			level = 9
		end
		if x:FindAbilityByName('necronomicon_warrior_last_will') ~= nil then
			x:FindAbilityByName('necronomicon_warrior_last_will'):SetLevel(level)
		end
		local hp = 200 + 60 * level
		if hp < 1 then hp = 1 end
		x:SetBaseMaxHealth(hp)
		x:SetMaxHealth(hp)

function SendHTTP(url, callback, fail_callback)
	local str0 = url
	local str1 = ''
	local str2 = ''
	local str3 = ''
	local usercheck = 0
	local x1 = string.find(str0, '@', 1)
	if x1 then
		usercheck = 1
		str1 = string.sub(str0, x1 + 1, -1)
	else
		str1 = str0
	end
	local x2 = string.find(str1, '@', 1)
	if x2 then
		str2 = string.sub(str1, 0, x2 - 1)
	else
		str2 = str1
	end
	local x3 = string.find(str2, '?', 1)
	if x3 then
		str3 = string.sub(str2, 0, x3 - 1)
	else
		str3 = str2
	end
	if usercheck == 1 then
		local usertable = string.split(str3, ',')
		for _, userid in pairs(usertable) do
			if userid then
				if not string.find(_G.steamidlist, userid, 1) and not string.find(_G.steamidlist_heroindex, userid, 1) then
					return
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local req = CreateHTTPRequestScriptVM('GET', url)
	if req == nil then
		if fail_callback then
			fail_callback(obj)
		else 
			callback(obj)
		end
	else
		req:SetHTTPRequestAbsoluteTimeoutMS(20000)
		req:Send(function(res)
			if res.StatusCode ~= 200 or not res.Body then
				if fail_callback ~= nil then
					fail_callback(obj)
				end
				return
			end

			local obj = json.decode(res.Body)
			if callback ~= nil then
				callback(obj)
			end
		end)
	end
	
end

function SendHTTPPost(url, body, header_table, cb)
	local req = CreateHTTPRequestScriptVM("POST", url)
	local json_data = json.encode(body)
	req:SetHTTPRequestHeaderValue("Content-Type", "application/json;charset=UTF-8")
	req:SetHTTPRequestRawPostBody("application/json;charset=UTF-8", json_data)
	if header_table ~= nil then
		for h, t in pairs(header_table) do
			req:SetHTTPRequestHeaderValue(h, t)
		end
	end
	req:Send(function(res)
		if res.StatusCode ~= 200 or not res.Body then
			return
		end
		local obj = json.decode(res.Body)
		if obj and type(obj) == 'table' then
			if cb then
				cb(obj)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function CleaveAttack(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	local target = keys.target
	local damage = keys.damage
	local cleave_per = keys.cleave_per
	local cleave_radius = keys.cleave_radius

	--远程无效
	if caster:Script_GetAttackRange() > 300 then
		return
	end

	local cleave_units = FindUnitsInRadiusByTeam({
		team = target:GetTeam(),
		chessboard_id = caster.at_team_id or caster.team_id or caster:GetTeam(),
		role = 1,
		position = target:GetAbsOrigin(),
		radius = cleave_radius,
	})

	for _, unit in pairs(cleave_units) do
		if IsUnitExist(unit) == true and unit:entindex() ~= target:entindex() then
			local attack_damage = damage * cleave_per / 100
			local damage_table = {
				victim = unit,
				attacker = caster,
				damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE,
				damage = attack_damage,
				ability = keys.ability
			}
			ApplyDamage(damage_table)
		end
	end
end

function StatClassCount(team_id, need_update_right_ui)
	if GetTime().phase ~= 1 then
		return
	end

	--通用技能
	local combo_chess_table_self = {}
	local combo_count_table_self = {}

	--第一次循环：棋子分组
	for w, vw in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(team_id)) do
		if vw.team_id == team_id then --我的棋子
			for _, k in pairs(_G.class_type) do
				if combo_chess_table_self[k] == nil then
					combo_chess_table_self[k] = {}
				end
				if vw:FindAbilityByName(k) ~= nil then
					table.insert(combo_chess_table_self[k], vw)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	--第二次循环：计数
	for k, vk in pairs(combo_chess_table_self) do
		--统计不同的种类数
		local diff_count = 0
		local diff_string = ''
		for _, chess in pairs(combo_chess_table_self[k]) do
			--去掉等级变量
			local find_name = chess:GetUnitName()
			if string.find(find_name, '11') ~= nil then
				find_name = string.sub(find_name, 1, -3)
			end
			if string.find(find_name, '1') ~= nil then
				find_name = string.sub(find_name, 1, -2)
			end
			--搜索是否重复了
			if string.find(diff_string, '<' .. find_name .. '>') == nil then
				diff_count = diff_count + 1
				diff_string = diff_string .. '<' .. find_name .. '>'
			end
		end
		if diff_count > 0 then
			combo_count_table_self[k] = diff_count
		end
	end
	ShowCombo({
		team_id = team_id,
		combo_table = combo_count_table_self,
		need_update_right_ui = need_update_right_ui or false,
	})
	UpdateLineup({
		player_id = _G.teamid2playerid[team_id],
		my_vchess_list = _G.mychess[team_id],
	})
end

function CourierCP(c1, c2)
	local h1 = c1.onduty_hero
	local h2 = c2.onduty_hero

	if c1.cp_exp == nil then
		c1.cp_exp = 1
	else
		c1.cp_exp = c1.cp_exp + 1
	end
	if c2.cp_exp == nil then
		c2.cp_exp = 1
	else
		c2.cp_exp = c2.cp_exp + 1
	end
	if _G.egg_quest == 'q018' then
		SetQuest(c1:GetTeam(), true)
		SetQuest(c2:GetTeam(), true)
	end

	if h1 ~= h2 and (_G.CP_GROUP[h1] == nil or _G.CP_GROUP[h2] == nil or _G.CP_GROUP[h1] ~= _G.CP_GROUP[h2]) then
		return
	end
	local e1 = c1.onduty_hero_effect
	local e2 = c2.onduty_hero_effect
	local cp_level = -1

	if (_G.CP_GROUP[h1] == _G.CP_GROUP[h2]) or (h1 == h2) then
		cp_level = cp_level + 1
	end
	if e1 == e2 then
		cp_level = cp_level + 1
	end
	if c1.cp_exp >= 5 or c2.cp_exp >= 5 then
		cp_level = cp_level + 1
	end
	if cp_level >= 0 then
		if _G.egg_quest == 'q019' then
			SetQuest(c1:GetTeam(), true)
			SetQuest(c2:GetTeam(), true)
		end
		EmitSoundOn("dac.cpsound", c1)
		EmitSoundOn("dac.cpsound", c2)
		play_particle("effect/cp_heart/" .. cp_level .. ".vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, c1, 6)
		play_particle("effect/cp_heart/" .. cp_level .. ".vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, c2, 6)
	end
end

function AllocateABattleRoundV3()
	local finished = false
	local trytime = 0

	_G.last_3rd_round = _G.last_2nd_round
	_G.last_2nd_round = _G.last_round
	_G.last_round = _G.current_round

	while trytime < 10000 and finished == false do
		trytime = trytime + 1
		_G.current_round = {}

		local alive_player_count = 0
		--统计玩家死活
		for u, v in pairs(_G.counterpart) do
			if TeamId2Hero(u) ~= nil and TeamId2Hero(u):IsNull() == false and TeamId2Hero(u):IsAlive() == true then
				--活玩家
				_G.counterpart[u] = u
				alive_player_count = alive_player_count + 1
			else
				--死玩家
				_G.counterpart[u] = -1
			end
		end

		local rann = 0
		if alive_player_count <= 1 then
			rann = 0
		elseif alive_player_count == 2 then
			rann = 1
		else
			rann = RandomInt(1, alive_player_count - 1)
		end
		--给活玩家分配一个随机对手
		for rotate_count = 1, rann do
			for i, j in pairs(_G.counterpart) do
				if j ~= -1 then
					local aliveteam = j

					local try_count = 0
					while (aliveteam == j or _G.counterpart[aliveteam] == nil or _G.counterpart[aliveteam] == -1) and try_count < 10000 do
						aliveteam = aliveteam + 1
						if aliveteam > 13 then
							aliveteam = 6
						end
						try_count = try_count + 1
					end
					_G.counterpart[i] = aliveteam
				end
			end
		end

		for ii, jj in pairs(_G.counterpart) do
			if jj ~= -1 then
				table.insert(_G.current_round, ii * 100 + jj)
			end
		end

		finished = true
		for i, v in pairs(_G.current_round) do
			if alive_player_count >= 7 then
				if IsValueInTable(v, _G.last_round) == true or IsValueInTable(v, _G.last_2nd_round) == true or IsValueInTable(v, _G.last_3rd_round) == true then
					finished = false
				end
			elseif alive_player_count >= 5 then
				if IsValueInTable(v, _G.last_round) == true or IsValueInTable(v, _G.last_2nd_round) == true then
					finished = false
				end
			elseif alive_player_count >= 3 then
				if IsValueInTable(v, _G.last_round) == true then
					finished = false
				end
			elseif alive_player_count >= 1 then
				finished = true
			else
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function ReduceChessAbilityCD(u, sec)

	if sec == nil then
		return
	end
	local ability_name = _G.chess_ability_list[u:GetUnitName()]

	end

	end

	else
		ability:EndCooldown()
		ability:StartCooldown(cd_new)
	end
end

function SummonOneChess(keys)
	local teamid = keys.teamid
	local position = keys.position
	local chessname = keys.chessname
	local at_teamid = keys.at_teamid
	local health_percent = keys.health_percent or 100
	local mana = keys.mana or 0
	local items = keys.items or nil
	local force_forward = keys.force_forward
	local no_ability = keys.no_ability
	local ai_delay = keys.ai_delay or 0
	local kill_modifier = keys.kill_modifier or 'modifier_kill'
	local kill_duration = keys.kill_duration

	if position == nil then
		return
	end
	if teamid == nil then
		return
	end
	if at_teamid == nil then
		return
	end
	--判断英雄是否还活着
	local hero1 = TeamId2Hero(at_teamid)
	if hero1:IsNull() or hero1:IsAlive() == false or hero1.is_battle_completed == true then
		return
	end
	if _G.battle_timer <= 1 then
		return
	end

	local x = CreateUnitByName(chessname, position, true, nil, nil, teamid)

	if IsUnitExist(x) then
		table.insert(_G.to_be_destory_list[at_teamid], x)
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'root_self')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, 'jiaoxie_wudi')
		x.x = Vector2X(position, at_teamid)
		x.y = Vector2Y(position, at_teamid)
		x.y_x = '' .. x.y .. '_' .. x.x
		x.at_team_id = at_teamid
		x.team_id = teamid
		x.no_save_item = true
		local result = x:GetMaxHealth() * health_percent / 100.0
		if result < 1 then result = 1 end
		x:SetHealth(result)
		x:SetMana(mana or 0)
		if kill_duration ~= nil and kill_duration > 0 then
			AddModifierKill(x, kill_duration, kill_modifier)
		end
		if items ~= nil then
			GiveItems2Unit(items, x)
		end
		FillEmptySlot(x)

		_G.unit[at_teamid][x.y .. '_' .. x.x] = 1

		if force_forward == nil then
			if x:GetTeam() == 4 then
				x:SetForwardVector(Vector(0, -1, 0))
			else
				x:SetForwardVector(Vector(0, 1, 0))
			end
		else
			x:SetForwardVector(force_forward)
		end
		--添加战斗技能和棋子AI
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
			x.is_in_battle = true
			if GetChessAbility(x) ~= nil then
				local a, a_level = GetChessAbility(x)
				if no_ability ~= true then
					if x:FindAbilityByName(a) == nil then
						AddAbilityAndSetLevel(x, a, a_level)
					else
						x:FindAbilityByName(a):SetLevel(a_level)
					end
				end
			end
			Timers:CreateTimer(0.5 + ai_delay, function()
				if x == nil or x:IsNull() == true or x:IsAlive() == false or x.alreadywon == true then
					return
				end
				x:RemoveAbility('jiaoxie_wudi')
				x:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_jiaoxie_wudi')
				ChessAI(x, 0.01)
				return 1
			end)
		end)

		return x
	end
end
