executionFunctions.bodyRaw:
function JuFengAttack(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	local target = caster:GetAttackTarget()
	local modifier = caster:FindModifierByName('modifier_item_jufengchangji_buff')
	if modifier == nil then
		return
	end

	local stack = modifier:GetStackCount()
	if stack <= 1 or caster.taunt_target == nil or IsUnitExist(caster.taunt_target) == false then
		caster:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_item_jufengchangji_buff')
		caster.taunt_target = nil
	end
	if caster.taunt_target ~= nil and IsUnitExist(caster.taunt_target) == true and target:entindex() ~= caster.taunt_target:entindex() then
		caster:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_item_jufengchangji_buff')
		caster.taunt_target = nil
	end
	modifier:SetStackCount(stack - 1)
end

function FindItemAbilityByName(u, item_name)
	for slot = 0, 5 do
		if u:GetItemInSlot(slot) ~= nil then
			local ability = u:GetItemInSlot(slot)
			local name = ability:GetAbilityName()
			if name == item_name then
				return ability
			end
		end
	end
end

function TriggerHongzhang(u, lengjing)
	local ability = FindItemAbilityByName(u, 'item_hongzhang')
	if ability and (ability:IsCooldownReady() == true or lengjing) then
		EmitSoundOn("DOTA_Item.Dagon.Activate", u)
		local victim = FindUnluckyDog(u)
		if victim == nil then
			return
		end
		local info = {
			Target = victim,
			Source = u,
			Ability = nil,
			EffectName = "particles/econ/events/ti5/dagon_ti5.vpcf",
			bDodgeable = false,
			iMoveSpeed = 3000,
			bProvidesVision = false,
			iVisionRadius = 0,
			iVisionTeamNumber = u:GetTeamNumber(),
			iSourceAttachment = DOTA_PROJECTILE_ATTACHMENT_ATTACK_1
		}
		projectile = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile(info)
		if victim:IsMagicImmune() == false then
			if BlockByLinken(victim) == false then
				ApplyDamage({
					victim = victim,
					attacker = u,
					damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL,
					damage = 700,
					ability = ability,
				})
			end
		end
		return 0.5

function TriggerHuanyingfu(u)
	local ability = FindItemAbilityByName(u, 'item_huanyingfu')
	if ability and ability:IsCooldownReady() == true then
		EmitSoundOn("DOTA_Item.Manta.Activate", u)
		play_particle("particles/generic_gameplay/illusion_killed.vpcf", PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, u, 3)
		local items = GetAllItemsAndCDInUnits({ [1] = u }, nil, true)
		SummonMinion(u, u:GetUnitName(), 2, "particles/generic_gameplay/illusion_killed.vpcf", function(w)
			if IsUnitExist(w) == false then
				return
			end
			local hp_set = u:GetHealth()
			local hp_max_set = u:GetMaxHealth()
			if hp_set < 1 then
				hp_set = 1
			end
			w:SetBaseMaxHealth(hp_max_set)
			w:SetMaxHealth(hp_max_set)
			w:SetHealth(hp_set)
			w:AddNewModifier(w, nil, "modifier_illusion", { duration = 7 })
			if items ~= nil then
				GiveItems2Unit(items, w)
			end
			w.is_mirror = true
			w:SetMaxMana(0)
			FillEmptySlot(w)
			ExtendBeastBuff(w, u, false, false)
			if GetChessAbility(w) ~= nil then
				local a, a_level = GetChessAbility(w)

				if w:FindAbilityByName(a) == nil then
					AddAbilityAndSetLevel(w, a, a_level)
				else
					w:FindAbilityByName(a):SetLevel(a_level)
				end
			end
		end)
		return 0.5
	end
end

function GetAllItemsAndCDInUnits(units, item_evolve_level, ignore_temp_items, ignore_aegis)
	--收集棋子的物品
	local items_table = {}
	for _, vv in pairs(units) do
		if IsUnitExist(vv, true) == true then
			--记录装备情况
			for slot = 0, 9 do
				if vv:GetItemInSlot(slot) ~= nil then
					local item = vv:GetItemInSlot(slot)
					local name = item:GetAbilityName()
					local charges = item:GetCurrentCharges()
					local cd = item:GetCooldownTimeRemaining()
					local item_name = vv:GetItemInSlot(slot):GetAbilityName()
					if item_name ~= 'item_null' then
						if item_evolve_level ~= nil and item:IsPermanent() == true and item_name ~= 'item_shengjian' then
							if item_name == 'item_moping_kong' then
								item_name = 'item_moping'
							end
							local o_level = _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[item_name]
							if o_level then
								local r_level = o_level + item_evolve_level
								if r_level > 5 then r_level = 5 end
								local try_time = 0
								local r_item = nil
								while try_time < 10 and (r_item == nil or r_item == 'item_shengjian') do
									try_time = try_time + 1
									r_item = _G.ITEM_LIST_BY_LEVEL[r_level]
									[RandomInt(1, table.maxn(_G.ITEM_LIST_BY_LEVEL[r_level]))]
								end
								if r_item ~= nil then
									item_name = r_item
									cd = nil
								end
							end
						end
						if not ignore_temp_items or item:IsPermanent() == true then
							local insertable = true
							for i, v in pairs(items_table) do
								if v.item == item_name and (item_name == 'item_xuejingshi' or item_name == 'item_changdun') then
									insertable = false
									break
								end
							end
							if insertable then
								table.insert(items_table, {
									item = item_name,
									charges = charges,
									cd = cd,
								})
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return items_table
end

function GiveItems2Unit(items, unit)
	if IsUnitExist(unit) == false then
		return
	end
	for _, v in pairs(items) do
		local item_name = v.item or v
		local charges = v.charges or 1
		local cd = v.cd or 0
		unit:AddItemByName(item_name)

		for slot = 0, 8 do
			if unit:GetItemInSlot(slot) ~= nil then
				local i = unit:GetItemInSlot(slot)
				local n = i:GetAbilityName()
				if item_name == n then
					if cd > 0 then
						i:StartCooldown(cd)
					end
					if charges > 1 then
						i:SetCurrentCharges(charges)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	local lucky_team = nil
	local try_count = 0

		local random_team = RandomInt(6, 13)

		local my_team = gg_item_hero:GetTeam()

		end
		try_count = try_count + 1
	end
	if lucky_team ~= nil then

			gg_item_one = 'item_lootbox_lv' .. _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[gg_item_one]

		local gg_item_v = CenterVector(lucky_team) + Vector(RandomInt(-512, 512), RandomInt(-512, 512), 0)
		local gg_item_dis = (gg_item_v - Vector(0, 0, 128)):Length2D()
		local gg_item_t = gg_item_dis / 800
		newItem:SimulateLaunchLoot(gg_item_v)
		AddItemGot(TeamId2Hero(lucky_team), gg_item_one)

function ValdmirRestore(hero, heal)
	--如果玩家已经死亡，就不吸血了
	if _G.death[hero:GetTeam()] == true then
		return
	end

	local hp = hero:GetHealth()
	if _G.p2_mode == true then
		heal = math.floor(heal / 2)
	end
	hp = hp + heal
	if hp > 100 then
		hp = 100
		hero:AddItemByName('item_chishu')
	end
	if hp < 1 then hp = 1 end

	if _G.p2_mode == true and GetP2Ally(hero:GetTeam()) ~= nil then
		local hh = TeamId2Hero(GetP2Ally(hero:GetTeam()))
		if hh ~= nil then
			hh:SetHealth(hp)
			SyncHP(hh)
			AMHC:CreateNumberEffect(hh, heal, 3, AMHC.MSG_MISS, { 0, 128, 0 }, 0)
			EmitSoundOn("item.lifesteal", hh)
			play_particle('particles/generic_gameplay/generic_lifesteal.vpcf', PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, hh, 3)
		end
	end
	hero:SetHealth(hp)
	SyncHP(hero)
	AMHC:CreateNumberEffect(hero, heal, 3, AMHC.MSG_MISS, { 0, 128, 0 }, 0)
	EmitSoundOn("item.lifesteal", hero)
	play_particle('particles/generic_gameplay/generic_lifesteal.vpcf', PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, hero, 3)
end

function DropMonopolizeTaxOnce(team_id, chess, tax_type)
	--tax_type 2是合成2星 3是合成3星 23是已有的3星
	--垄断收税
	local destroy_count = 0
	for i = 6, 13 do
		local hhh = TeamId2Hero(i)
		if hhh ~= nil then
			--手牌
			if hhh.hand_entities ~= nil then
				for _, ent in pairs(hhh.hand_entities) do
					if ent ~= nil and ent:IsNull() == false and GetUnitBaseName(ent) == chess then
						-- destroy_tax = destroy_tax + ent:GetLevel()
						destroy_count = destroy_count + 1
					end
				end
			end
			--场上棋子
			for j, v in pairs(_G.mychess[i]) do
				if v ~= nil and GetChessBaseName(v.chess) == chess then
					-- local level = 1
					-- for u,t in pairs(_G.chess_list_by_level) do
					-- 	if FindValueInTable(t,v.chess) == true then
					-- 		level = u
					-- 	end
					-- end
					-- destroy_tax = destroy_tax + level
					destroy_count = destroy_count + 1
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if tax_type == 3 then
		destroy_tax = (destroy_count or 1) * (GetChessCostByName(chess) or 1)
	elseif tax_type == 2 then
		destroy_tax = (GetChessCostByName(chess) or 1)
	elseif tax_type == 23 then
		destroy_tax = (2 + (destroy_count or 1)) * (GetChessCostByName(chess) or 1)
	end

	--如果获得金币，发combat
	if destroy_tax > 0 then
		ShowCombat({
			t = 'item_get_money',
			player = TeamId2Hero(team_id):GetPlayerID(),
			item = 'item_destroy_piece',
			num = destroy_tax,
		})

		--获得destroy_tax金币
		local position_to = CenterVector(team_id) + Vector(RandomInt(-400, 400), RandomInt(-400, 400), 0)
		DropMoneyBag(Vector(0, 0, 128), position_to, 300, (destroy_tax or 1))
		AddTotalMoneyStat(TeamId2Hero(team_id):GetPlayerID(), (destroy_tax or 1))
	end
end

function DestroyUnitPieceFromChessPool(base_chess)
	local destroy_info = CustomNetTables:GetTableValue("chess_pool_table", "destroy_info") or {}
	local chess_cost = _G.chess_2_mana[base_chess]
	if _G.chess_pool[chess_cost] ~= nil then
		for i = table.maxn(_G.chess_pool[chess_cost]), 1, -1 do
			if _G.chess_pool[chess_cost][i] == base_chess then
				table.remove(_G.chess_pool[chess_cost], i)
				_G.chess_remainder_table[base_chess] = 0
			end
		end
	end
	--在chess_pool_table维护本局中已被摧毁的棋子，用于UI显示
	local new_destroy_info = {}
	table.insert(new_destroy_info, base_chess)
	for i, v in pairs(destroy_info) do
		table.insert(new_destroy_info, v)
	end
	CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("chess_pool_table", "destroy_info", new_destroy_info)
end

function FindChessCountInChessPool(chess_name)
	local chess_cost = _G.chess_2_mana[chess_name] or 1
	local chess_count = 0
	for i = table.maxn(_G.chess_pool[chess_cost]), 1, -1 do
		if _G.chess_pool[chess_cost][i] == chess_name then
			chess_count = chess_count + 1
		end
	end

	return chess_count
end

function RemoveChessFromChessPool(chess_name, count)
	local chess_cost = _G.chess_2_mana[chess_name]
	if count == nil then
		count = 1
	end
	if chess_cost > 5 then
		return
	end
	for i = table.maxn(_G.chess_pool[chess_cost]), 1, -1 do
		if _G.chess_pool[chess_cost][i] == chess_name then
			table.remove(_G.chess_pool[chess_cost], i)
			if _G.chess_remainder_table[chess_name] ~= nil then
				_G.chess_remainder_table[chess_name] = _G.chess_remainder_table[chess_name] - 1
			end
			count = count - 1
			if count <= 0 then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function AppendChoiceForItemOnOneUnit(choice_table, unit, search_level, is_courier)
	for slot = 0, 9 do
		if unit:GetItemInSlot(slot) ~= nil then
			local name = unit:GetItemInSlot(slot):GetAbilityName()
			if (_G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[name] == search_level) or (_G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[name] == 5 and search_level == 4) then
				if is_courier then
					table.insert(choice_table, {
						item_name = name,
						hero_name = unit.onduty_hero,
						hero_entindex = unit:entindex(),
					})
				else
					table.insert(choice_table, {
						item_name = name,
						chess_base_name = GetUnitBaseName(unit),
						chess_water_id = GetChessWaterID(unit),
						item_level = _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[name],
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function FindChoiceForItem(hero, item_name)
	local item_level = _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[item_name]
	local choice_table = {}
	if item_level > 1 then
		for _, unit in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(hero:GetTeam())) do
			if IsUnitExist(unit) == true and unit:GetTeam() == hero:GetTeam() then
				AppendChoiceForItemOnOneUnit(choice_table, unit, item_level - 1)
			end
		end
		for i = 1, 8 do
			if hero.hand_entities and hero.hand_entities[i] then
				AppendChoiceForItemOnOneUnit(choice_table, hero.hand_entities[i], item_level - 1)
			end
		end
		AppendChoiceForItemOnOneUnit(choice_table, hero, item_level - 1, 1)
		return choice_table
	else
		return { {
			hero_name = hero.onduty_hero,
			hero_entindex = hero:entindex(),
		} }
	end
end

function AddItemPlus(hero, item_name, delay)
	if delay == nil then
		delay = 0

	Timers:CreateTimer(delay, function()
		local has_empty_slot = false
		--普通物品
		for slot = 0, 8 do
			if hero:GetItemInSlot(slot) == nil or (hero:GetItemInSlot(slot):GetAbilityName() == item_name and hero:GetItemInSlot(slot):IsStackable()) then

		--中立物品必替换（圣物）

			has_empty_slot = true
		end

		if has_empty_slot == true then
			hero:AddItemByName(item_name)
		else
			DropItemAppointed(hero, hero, item_name)
		end
	end)
end

	local slot_count = 9

	if slot_count > 0 then

		end
	end
end

function RemindItem(caster, modifier_name)
	if _G.game_status ~= 2 then
		if caster:IsHero() == false then
			InitChessMana(caster)
		end
	end
	Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
		if IsUnitExist(caster) == false or caster.is_fuhuo == true or caster.no_save_item == true or caster.is_youhun == true or caster.team_id == 4 or HasKillModifier(caster) == true or caster.is_summoned == true then
			--这些情况不做特殊处理
			return
		end
		local modifier = caster:FindModifierByName(modifier_name)
		if modifier == nil then
			return
		end
		local item = modifier:GetAbility()
		if item == nil then
			return
		end
		local item_name = item:GetAbilityName()
		if caster:IsHero() == true and modifier_name == 'modifier_' .. item_name then
			if FindValueInTable(_G.DROP_RELIC_LIST, item_name) == true then
				--获取圣物的提醒
				SendServerToAllTeam("bullet", {
					player_id = caster:GetPlayerID(),
					win_streak = caster.win_streak or 0,
					vip = caster.is_vip,
					target = nil,
					item = item_name,
					item_level = 6,
				})
			end
			--获取代币
			if item_name == 'item_common_token' or item_name == 'item_rm_token' or item_name == 'item_gold_token' then
				UpdateMyMoney(caster:GetTeam())
			end
		end
		if modifier_name ~= ('modifier_' .. item_name) or string.find(item_name, 'item_') == nil then
			return
		end
		if FindChessRemindedItem(caster, item_name) == false then
			AddChessRemindedItem(caster, item_name)
			local item_level = _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[item_name]
			if item_level ~= nil and item_level > 0 then
				--说谢谢
				if RandomInt(1, 50) < (item_level * 10) then
					PlayChessDialogue(caster, 'thanks')
				end
				--发弹幕：获得物品
				local hero = TeamId2Hero(caster.team_id)
				if item_level >= 4 and hero ~= nil then
					if caster:IsHero() ~= true then
						SendServerToAllTeam("bullet", {
							player_id = hero:GetPlayerID(),
							win_streak = hero.win_streak or 0,
							vip = hero.is_vip,
							target = caster:GetUnitName(),
							item = item_name,
							item_level = item_level,
						})
					end

					if item_level == 5 and _G.egg_quest == 'q022' then
						SetQuest(hero.team_id, true)
					end
					if item_level == 4 and _G.egg_quest == 'q032' then
						SetQuest(hero.team_id, true)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

	if stack_name == 'grow' then

function LosePermanentStackCount(u, stack_name)
	if u:GetTeam() == 4 then
		--客场不加减点数
		return 1
	end

	local v_chess = Unit2VChess(u)
	if v_chess == nil then
		return 1
	end
	local stack_count = v_chess[stack_name .. '_count']
	if stack_count == nil then

		else
			stack_count = 0
		end
	end
	v_chess[stack_name .. '_count'] = math.ceil(stack_count / 2)
	return math.ceil(stack_count / 2)
end

function GetPermanentStackCount(u, stack_name)

function SyncPermanentStackCount(keys)
	local u = keys.caster
	local stack_name = keys.stack_name
	local ability = nil
	local modifier_name = nil
	local count = keys.stack or GetPermanentStackCount(u, stack_name)
	if IsUnitExist(u) == false or u:IsHero() then return end
	if stack_name == 'grow' then
		ability = u:FindAbilityByName('tiny_grow_new')
		if ability then
			ModMaxHP({
				caster = u,
				const = count*100,
				is_heal = true,
			})
			AddModelScalePlus(u, u:GetModelScale()*(1+count*0.02))
			if u:FindModifierByName("modifier_"..ability:GetAbilityName() .. "_count") == nil then
				ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, "modifier_"..ability:GetAbilityName() .. "_count", {})
			end
			u:FindModifierByName("modifier_"..ability:GetAbilityName() .. "_count"):SetStackCount(count)
		end
	elseif stack_name == 'press' then
		ability = u:FindAbilityByName('lc_qianggong')
		if ability then
			modifier_name = 'modifier_'..ability:GetAbilityName()
			for i = 1, count do
				ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, modifier_name, {})
			end
			if u:FindModifierByName(modifier_name .. "_count") == nil then
				ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, modifier_name .. "_count", {})
			end
			u:FindModifierByName(modifier_name .. "_count"):SetStackCount(count)
		end
	elseif stack_name == 'wisp_altar_power' and count > 0 then
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(u,stack_name)
		modifier_name = 'modifier_'..stack_name
		if u:FindAbilityByName(stack_name) then
			u:FindModifierByName(modifier_name .. "_count"):SetStackCount(count)
		end
	else
		ability = FindItemInInventory(u, 'item_' .. stack_name)
		if stack_name == 'changdun' then
			modifier_name = 'modifier_item_changdun_armor'
			if u:HasModifier('modifier_item_changdun_show') and count > 0 then
				u:FindModifierByName('modifier_item_changdun_show'):SetStackCount(count)
			end
		end
		if modifier_name then
			for _, m in pairs(u:FindAllModifiers()) do
				if modifier_name == m:GetName() then
					u:RemoveModifierByName(modifier_name)
				end
			end
		end
		if ability then
			ability:SetCurrentCharges(count)
			if modifier_name then
				for i = 1, count do
					ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(u, u, modifier_name, {})
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if count > 0 then
		u[stack_name .. '_count'] = count
	end

	if keys.modmaxhp ~= nil then
        ModMaxHP({
            caster = u,
            const = keys.modmaxhp,
        })
    end
end

function RefreshPets(hero_new, old_pet, new_pet_name, name_suffix)
	if name_suffix == nil then
		name_suffix = 1
	end
	DestroyUnit(old_pet)
	--生成宠物
	local pet = nil
	if new_pet_name ~= nil then
		pet = new_pet_name
	end
	if pet ~= nil and _G.pet_list[pet] ~= nil then
		local ran1 = RandomInt(50, 200)
		local ran11 = RandomInt(0, 1)
		if ran11 == 0 then
			ran1 = -ran1
		end
		local ran2 = RandomInt(50, 200)
		local ran22 = RandomInt(0, 1)
		if ran22 == 0 then
			ran2 = -ran2
		end

		if name_suffix == 2 then
			ran1 = 100
			ran2 = -50
		end
		local my_pet = CreateUnitByName("gemtd_pet", hero_new:GetAbsOrigin() + Vector(ran1, ran2, 0), true, nil, nil,
			DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)
		my_pet.ftd = 2009
		my_pet:SetOwner(hero_new)
		hero_new.pet_entity = my_pet
		my_pet.pet_name = pet
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'no_collision')

		if pet == 't305' then
			PlayParticleOnUnitUntilDeath({
				caster = my_pet,
				p = "effect/bose_hand/bose.vpcf",
			})
		end

		local onduty_pet_model = _G.pet_list[pet]['model']
		local onduty_pet_skin = 0 --_G.sm_hero_list_skin[pet] or 0
		my_pet:SetOriginalModel(onduty_pet_model)
		my_pet:SetModel(onduty_pet_model)
		my_pet:SetSkin(onduty_pet_skin)
		my_pet:SetModelScale(_G.pet_list[pet]['size'] or 1)
		my_pet.ori_scale = _G.pet_list[pet]['size'] or 1
		my_pet.pet_kv = _G.pet_list[pet]

		-- BlinkChessX({caster=my_pet,blink_type="fall"})

		hero_new['pet' .. name_suffix] = my_pet
		hero_new['pet_name' .. name_suffix] = pet
		my_pet.owner = hero_new

		if name_suffix ~= 2 then
			PlayPetDialogue(my_pet, false, hero_new.language)
		end

		if hero_new.is_auto_ai then
			-- AddAbilityAndSetLevel(hero_new,'toggle_ai')
			CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(hero_new:GetTeam(), "show_petgpt", {
				key = GetClientKey(hero_new:GetTeam()),
			})
		end
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'pick_chess')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'recall_chess')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'remove_chess')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'summon_hero')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'exp_book')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'pet_wudi')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'no_hp_bar')
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(my_pet, 'no_selectable')


		Timers:CreateTimer(1, function()
			if my_pet == nil or my_pet.owner == nil or my_pet:IsNull() == true or my_pet:IsAlive() == false then
				return
			end
			if my_pet.owner == nil or my_pet.owner:IsNull() == true or my_pet.owner:IsAlive() == false then
				DestroyUnit(my_pet)
				return
			end
			if my_pet:HasModifier('modifier_pet_speed') then
				return 1
			end

			if (my_pet:GetAbsOrigin() - my_pet.owner:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D() > 200 then
				local ran1 = RandomInt(50, 200)
				local ran11 = RandomInt(0, 1)
				if ran11 == 0 then
					ran1 = -ran1
				end
				local ran2 = RandomInt(50, 200)
				local ran22 = RandomInt(0, 1)
				if ran22 == 0 then
					ran2 = -ran2
				end
				FindClearSpaceForUnit(my_pet, my_pet:GetAbsOrigin(), true)
				my_pet:MoveToPosition(my_pet.owner:GetAbsOrigin() + Vector(ran1, ran2, 0))
				return 1
			else
				return 1
			end
		end)

		return my_pet
	else
		hero_new['pet' .. name_suffix] = nil
		hero_new['pet_name' .. name_suffix] = nil
		-- RemoveAbilityAndModifier(hero_new,'toggle_ai')
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(hero_new:GetTeam(), "hide_petgpt", {
			key = GetClientKey(hero_new:GetTeam()),
		})
	end
end

		if _G.egg_quest == 'q013' and _G.population_max[i] >= 10 then
			SetQuest(i, true)
		end
		if _G.egg_quest == 'q051' and _G.population_max[i] >= 12 then
			SetQuest(i, true)
		end
		if _G.egg_quest == 'q052' and _G.population_max[i] >= 14 then
			SetQuest(i, true)
		end

		local hero = TeamId2Hero(i)

		if hero ~= nil then
			if hero:GetStrength() > 0 then
				hero:ModifyStrength(-8)
			end
			if hero:GetAgility() > 0 then
				hero:ModifyAgility(-8)
			end
			if hero:GetIntellect(true) > 0 then
				hero:ModifyIntellect(-8)
			end

			hero:SetAbilityPoints(0)
			local level = hero:GetLevel()
			SetStat(hero:GetPlayerID(), 'hero_level', level)
			-- for j=1,10 do
			-- 	if hero:FindAbilityByName('hero_level_'..j) ~= nil then
			-- 		hero:RemoveAbility('hero_level_'..j)
			-- 		hero:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_hero_level'..j)
			-- 	end

			if summon_level > 11 then

			end

		end

		--同步ui人口

function DAC:OnEntityKilled(keys)
	local u = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_killed)
	local attacker = nil
	if keys.entindex_attacker ~= nil then
		attacker = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_attacker)
		attacker = attacker.damage_owner or attacker
	end

	if u == nil or u:IsNull() == true then
		return
	end
	if u:IsHero() == true then
		return
	end

	if u:GetUnitName() == "enemy_bomb" then
		return
	end
	if u:GetUnitName() == "player_image" then
		return
	end
	if u:GetUnitName() == "cheer_courier" then
		return
	end
	if u:GetUnitName() == "gemtd_pet" then
		return
	end
	if u:GetUnitName() == "mango_tree" then
		return
	end
	if u:GetUnitName() == "great_vault" then
		return
	end
	RemoveAllModifiersByCaster(u)
	RemoveAllModifiers(u)
	if u:GetUnitName() == "invisible_unit" then
		return
	end
	RemoveInvisibleUnitTable(u)
	if _G.game_status == 2 then
		--战斗阶段

		--pve敌人掉宝
		DropItem(u)
		local xx = Vector2X(u:GetAbsOrigin(), u.at_team_id or u.team_id or u:GetTeam())
		local yy = Vector2Y(u:GetAbsOrigin(), u.at_team_id or u.team_id or u:GetTeam())

		if u.is_evolving ~= true and u.transforming ~= true then
			if u.at_team_id ~= nil or u.team_id ~= nil then
				if u.y_x ~= nil and _G.unit[u.at_team_id or u.team_id or u:GetTeam()] ~= nil then
					_G.unit[u.at_team_id or u.team_id or u:GetTeam()][u.y_x] = nil
				end
			end
		end
		RemoveFromToBeDestroyList(u)

		--龙骑士的龙阵亡，变换模型（因为龙模型没有死亡动画）
		if u:GetUnitName() == "chess_dk_dragon" or u:GetUnitName() == "chess_dk1_dragon" or u:GetUnitName() == "chess_dk11_dragon" then
			u:SetOriginalModel("models/heroes/dragon_knight/dragon_knight.vmdl")
			u:SetModel("models/heroes/dragon_knight/dragon_knight.vmdl")
		end
		--进坟场
		if u:HasAbility('is_ward') == false and u.no_death_rattle ~= true and u.is_summoned ~= true and u.is_mirror ~= true then
			local chess_name = u:GetUnitName()
			if _G.chess_transform_list[chess_name] ~= nil then
				chess_name = _G.chess_transform_list[chess_name]
			end

			local chess_base_name = GetChessBaseName(chess_name)
			AddChess2DeadChessList({
				at_team_id = u.at_team_id or u.team_id or u:GetTeam(),
				chess_base_name = chess_base_name,
				items = GetAllItemsAndCDInUnits({ [1] = u }),
				level = u:GetLevel(),
			})
		end
		-- 小小被杀获得加成
		if u:HasAbility('tiny_grow_new') then
			if u.grow_count == nil then 
				u.grow_count = 0
			end
			u.grow_count = u.grow_count + 1
			AddPermanentStackCount(u, 'grow')
		end
		if IsUnitExist(attacker) then
			RefreshAssassinJump({
				caster = attacker
			})

			--蓝猫/火猫/土猫/紫猫 击杀重置cd
			if IsUnitExist(attacker) and GetChessAbility(attacker) == 'storm_spirit_ball_lightning_datadriven' or GetChessAbility(attacker) == 'sleight_of_fist_datadriven' or GetChessAbility(attacker) == 'earth_rock_roll' or GetChessAbility(attacker) == 'void_astralstep' then
				local a = GetChessAbility(attacker)
				if attacker:FindAbilityByName(a) ~= nil then
					attacker:FindAbilityByName(a):EndCooldown()
				end
			end

			--赏金猎人 击杀获得赏金
			if IsUnitExist(attacker) and attacker:HasAbility('bh_shuriken') == true and attacker.bh_gold == nil and attacker:GetTeam() ~= 4 and string.find(u:GetUnitName(), 'pve') == nil then
				attacker.bh_gold = 1
				local v_chess = Unit2VChess(attacker)
				if v_chess ~= nil then
					v_chess['bh_gold'] = 1
				end
				attacker:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_bh_gold')
				local money = ({ 1, 3, 5 })[attacker:FindAbilityByName("bh_shuriken"):GetLevel()]
				DropMoneyBag(u:GetAbsOrigin(), u:GetAbsOrigin(), 300, money, 200)
			end
		end

		if u.no_death_rattle then
			return
		end
		--亡语
		if u:HasModifier('modifier_nec_scythe_debuff_no_deathrattle') == false then
			DeathRattle(u, attacker)
		end

		if u.team_id ~= 4 and u.ori_team ~= 4 then
			SaveItem(u.team_id or u:GetTeam(), u:entindex())
			RemoveChessFromWaterIDList(u)
		end
	end

	if IsUnitExist(attacker) == false then
		return
	end
	-- if string.find(attacker:GetUnitName(),'pve') ~= nil then
	-- 	return
	-- end
	-- if string.find(u:GetUnitName(),'pve') ~= nil then
	-- 	return
	-- end
	if u:GetTeam() ~= attacker:GetTeam() then
		--击杀数
		if attacker.kill_count == nil then
			attacker.kill_count = 0
		end
		attacker.kill_count = attacker.kill_count + 1

		--连杀数
		if attacker.killing_spree_time == nil or GameRules:GetGameTime() - attacker.killing_spree_time < 3 then
			attacker.killing_spree_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
			-- +1
			if attacker.killing_spree_count == nil then
				attacker.killing_spree_count = 1
			else
				attacker.killing_spree_count = attacker.killing_spree_count + 1
			end
		else
			-- =1
			attacker.killing_spree_time = GameRules:GetGameTime()
			attacker.killing_spree_count = 1
		end

		if attacker.killing_spree_count == 3 then
			--三杀
			play_particle("effect/3sha/vr_killbanner_triplekill.vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, attacker, 5)
			EmitSoundOn("announcer_killing_spree_announcer_kill_triple_01", attacker)
		end
		if attacker.killing_spree_count == 5 then
			--暴走
			play_particle("effect/5sha/vr_killbanner_rampage.vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, attacker, 5)
			EmitSoundOn("announcer_killing_spree_announcer_kill_rampage_01", attacker)

			attacker.is_baozou = true

			if attacker.team_id == 4 then
				if attacker.from_team_id ~= nil then
					ShowCombat({
						t = 'killing_spree_5_creep',
						player = _G.team2playerid[attacker.from_team_id],
						text = attacker:GetUnitName(),
						hero = 'npc_dota_hero_wisp',
					})
				else
					ShowCombat({
						t = 'killing_spree_5_creep',
						player = _G.team2playerid[4],
						text = attacker:GetUnitName(),
						hero = 'npc_dota_hero_wisp',
					})
				end
			else
				ShowCombat({

					player = _G.team2playerid[attacker.from_team_id or attacker.team_id],
					text = attacker:GetUnitName(),
					hero = 'npc_dota_hero_wisp',

			end
		end

		if attacker.killing_spree_count > 5 then

	end

function DAC:OnRequestBuyChess(keys)
	local buy_index = keys.buy_index

	local team_id = _G.playerid2team[keys.PlayerID]
	local h = TeamId2Hero(team_id)
	SetNotAfk(h)

	if _G.team2playerid == nil or _G.team2playerid[team_id] == nil or PlayerResource:GetPlayer(_G.team2playerid[team_id]) == nil then
		return
	end
	if IsUnitExist(h) == false or h.curr_chess_table == nil or h.curr_chess_table[buy_index] == nil then
		return
	end
	local buy_item = h.curr_chess_table[buy_index]
	local chess = buy_item.chess
	local price = buy_item.price
	local money = buy_item.money

	if buy_item.wheel_chess_star ~= nil then
		if buy_item.wheel_chess_star == 3 then
			chess = chess..'11'
		elseif buy_item.wheel_chess_star == 2 then
			chess = chess..'1'
		end
	end

	--判断能不能买得起
	if money == nil or money == 'gold' then
		if price > h:GetMana() then
			CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(team_id, "mima", {
				key = GetClientKey(team_id),
				text = "text_mima_no_mana"
			})
			return
		end
	else
		if price > GetToken(h, 'item_' .. money) then
			CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(team_id, "mima", {
				key = GetClientKey(team_id),
				text = "text_mima_no_" .. money
			})
			return
		end
	end

	--判断手牌里是否有两个一样的，有的话直接合成
	local have_exist_count, chess1, chess2, chess3 = Find2SameChessInHandOrOnBoard(h, chess, true)

	--寻找手牌空位
	local index = FindEmptyHandSlot(team_id)
	if index == nil and have_exist_count < 2 and h.is_auto_combine == 1 then
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(team_id, "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(team_id),
			text = "text_mima_hand_full"
		})
		return
	end
	if index == nil and h.is_auto_combine ~= 1 then
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(team_id, "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(team_id),
			text = "text_mima_hand_full"
		})
		return
	end

	--验证完毕，可以购买
	--扣款
	local result = false
	if money == nil or money == 'gold' then
		--花金币招募
		result = CostMana(h, price)
	else
		--花代币招募
		result = CostToken(h, price, money)
	end
	Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
		UpdateMyMoney(team_id)
	end)
	h.curr_chess_table[buy_index] = nil
	CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(team_id, "request_buy_chess_cb", {
		key = GetClientKey(team_id),
		buy_index = buy_index,
	})
	if FindValueInTable(_G.unrevealed_legendary_chess_list,chess) == true and h.draw_type ~= 1 and h.draw_type ~= 4 then
		local reveal = RevealOneLegendary(chess)
		if reveal == true then
			--揭示奖励
			local position_to = CenterVector(h:GetTeam()) + Vector(RandomInt(-400, 400), RandomInt(-400, 400), 0)
			local reward = _G.reveal_reward
			_G.reveal_reward = _G.reveal_reward - 0
			if _G.reveal_reward < 1 then
				_G.reveal_reward = 1
			end
			DropMoneyBag(Vector(0, 0, 128), position_to, 100, (reward or 1))
			AddTotalMoneyStat(h:GetPlayerID(), (reward or 1))

			ShowCombat({
				t = 'reveal_legendary',
				player = h:GetPlayerID(),
				num = reward,
			})
			InitSynergyBanInfo()
		end
	end

	local x = nil
	local ppp = nil
	--启明星
	if have_exist_count >= 2 and chess1 ~= nil and chess2 ~= nil and h.is_auto_combine == 1 then
		CombineChessPlusAsync({ [1] = chess1, [2] = chess2 }, (chess .. '1'), function(x)
			if IsUnitExist(x) then
				--补上没生成的第三个配件棋子的购买价格
				x.buy_price = x.buy_price + price
				RequestBuyChessInner(h, buy_item, x)
			end
		end)
	else
		if h:HasModifier('modifier_item_super_uprank') and (money == nil or money == 'gold') and chess ~= 'chess_io' then
			local chesscost = GetChessCostByName(chess)
			if chesscost > 5 then 
				chesscost = 5
			end
			local prob_table = {
				[1] = 25,
				[2] = 22,
				[3] = 19,
				[4] = 16,
				[5] = 13,
			}
			if RandomInt(1,100) <= prob_table[chesscost] then
				local level_one_chess_table = string.split(h.level_one_chess, ',')
				if FindValueInTable(level_one_chess_table,chess) then
					chess = chess..'1'
					ppp = "particles/econ/items/earthshaker/earthshaker_arcana/earthshaker_arcana_blink_start_stars.vpcf"
					EmitSoundOn('super.uprank',h)
				end
			end
		end	
		CreateChessInHandAsync(h, chess, nil, nil, function(x)
			if IsUnitExist(x) then
				x.buy_price = price
				if money ~= 'gold' then
					x.buy_price = 0
				end
				if money == 'rm_token' then
					x.buy_price = GetChessCostByName(x:GetUnitName())
				end
				if ppp then
					play_particle(ppp,PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, x, 3)
				end
				RequestBuyChessInner(h, buy_item, x)
			end
		end)
	end
end

function RequestBuyChessInner(h, buy_item, x)
	if IsUnitExist(x) then
		if buy_item.extra_synergy ~= nil then
			local extra_synergy = nil
			for i, ex in pairs(buy_item.extra_synergy) do
				AddSynergy({
					caster = x,
					synergy = ex
				})
				extra_synergy = ex
				SaveExtraSynergy(x, ex)
				x:FindAbilityByName('dac_guai_base'):ApplyDataDrivenModifier(x, x, 'modifier_shining', {})
			end
			if extra_synergy ~= nil then
				local s = _G.combo_ability_type[extra_synergy]
				if s.is_race == true then
					CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("drodo_chat", {
						player_id = h:GetPlayerID(),
						win_streak = h.win_streak or 0,
						vip = h.is_vip,
						onduty_hero = h.onduty_hero,
						text = "notice_add_synergy1",
						chess = GetChessBaseName(x:GetUnitName()),
						time_stamp = math.floor(GameRules:GetGameTime()),
						type = 'copy_synergy_event',
						ability = extra_synergy,
						-- emoji = 175,
					})
				else
					CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("drodo_chat", {
						player_id = h:GetPlayerID(),
						win_streak = h.win_streak or 0,
						vip = h.is_vip,
						onduty_hero = h.onduty_hero,
						text = "notice_add_synergy2",
						chess = GetChessBaseName(x:GetUnitName()),
						time_stamp = math.floor(GameRules:GetGameTime()),
						type = 'copy_synergy_event',
						ability = extra_synergy,
						-- emoji = 175,
					})
				end
			end
		end

		if buy_item.wheel_properties ~= nil then
			CopyChessProperties(x, buy_item.wheel_properties)

		end
	end
end

function IsBattleTime()
	--判断现在是不是正在战斗的时间（不允许做战斗回合的操作）
	if GetTime().phase == GAME_PHASE_BATTLE then
		return true
	end
	if GetTime().phase == GAME_PHASE_PREPARE and (GetTime().left < 5 or GetTime().elapsed < 2) then
		return true
	end

	return false
end

	if keys.ai == nil then
		NoAI(caster)
	end
	local picked_chess = keys.force_picked_chess or caster.picked_chess
	if IsUnitExist(picked_chess) == false or picked_chess.is_removing == true then
		--picked_chess不存在
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(caster:GetTeam(), "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(caster:GetTeam()),
			text = "text_mima_must_select_a_chess"
		})
		EmitSoundOn("General.CastFail_NoMana", keys.caster)
		if GetTime().phase == GAME_PHASE_PREPARE and GetTime().left > 5 then
			caster:FindAbilityByName('pick_chess'):SetActivated(true)
			caster:FindAbilityByName('recall_chess'):SetActivated(true)
		end
		return
	end
	if HasMovingModifier(picked_chess) == true or picked_chess.is_moving == true then
		return
	end
	local target_pos = Vector(keys.x, keys.y, keys.z)

	local team_id = picked_chess.team_id
	CancelPickChess(caster)
	picked_chess.io_target = nil

	local origin_pos = nil
	if picked_chess.hand_index == nil then
		origin_pos = XY2Vector(picked_chess.x, picked_chess.y, team_id)
	else
		origin_pos = HandIndex2Vector(team_id, picked_chess.hand_index)
	end

	local chess_pos_type, x1, y1, _ = GetTargetPositionType(origin_pos, caster, team_id)
	local target_pos_type, x2, y2, target_chess = GetTargetPositionType(target_pos, caster, team_id)

	if keys.is_slide_mode == 1 and target_pos_type == 4 then
		-- 丢到河里，视为丢弃（卖掉）
		RemoveChess({
			caster = caster,
			target = picked_chess,
		})
		return
	end

	if chess_pos_type == 0 or target_pos_type == 0 or (target_pos_type == 3 and chess_pos_type == 2) then
		--无效地点
		return
	end
	if x1 == x2 and y1 == y2 then
		return
	end

	local blink_duration = 0
	if target_pos_type == 3 and target_chess ~= nil then
		if IsSpecialChess(GetChessBaseName(picked_chess:GetUnitName())) == true or (FindValueInTable(_G.chess_list_by_mana[5], GetChessBaseName(picked_chess:GetUnitName())) == false and FindValueInTable(_G.chess_list_by_mana_gold, GetChessBaseName(picked_chess:GetUnitName())) == true) then
			CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(caster:GetTeam(), "mima", {
				key = GetClientKey(caster:GetTeam()),
				text = "text_mima_egg_unavailable",
			})
			return
		else
			--把棋子picked_chess丢进蛋巢target_chess
			BlinkChessX({ p = HandIndex2Vector(team_id, x2), caster = picked_chess, set_forward = true, })
			RemoveChessFromHand(picked_chess, caster)
			local blink_duration = BlinkChessX({ p = HandIndex2Vector(team_id, x2), caster = picked_chess, set_forward = true, })

			Timers:CreateTimer(blink_duration, function()
				target_chess.egg_chess = GetChessBaseName(picked_chess:GetUnitName())
				local star = GetChessStar(picked_chess) or 1

				if star == 1 then
					target_chess.egg_chess_count = 1
				elseif star == 2 then
					target_chess.egg_chess_count = 3
				elseif star == 3 then
					target_chess.egg_chess_count = 9
				end

				-- if caster:HasModifier('modifier_item_egg') and FindChessCountInChessPool(target_chess.egg_chess) > 0 then
				-- 	local pp_cal = (target_chess.egg_chess_count)*0.02+0.475
				-- 	local ran = RandomInt(1,100)
				-- 	-- prt('prob_cal: '..ran..'/'..math.floor(pp_cal*100))
				-- 	if pp_cal > 1 then
				-- 		pp_cal = 1
				-- 	end
				-- 	if ran <= pp_cal*100 then
				-- 		target_chess.egg_chess_count = target_chess.egg_chess_count + 1
				-- 		RemoveChessFromChessPool(target_chess.egg_chess)
				-- 	end
				-- end

				if target_chess.egg_chess_count > 9 then
					target_chess.egg_chess_count = 9
				end

				CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("unit_table", 'egg_' .. target_chess:entindex(), {
					chess = target_chess.egg_chess,
					count = target_chess.egg_chess_count,
				})

				target_chess:SetOriginalModel('models/egg.vmdl')
				target_chess:SetModel('models/egg.vmdl')
				target_chess:SetModelScale(1.3)
				local scale = target_chess.egg_chess_count
				AddModelScalePlus(target_chess, 1.4 + scale * 0.2)
				target_chess:SetBaseMaxHealth(9)
				target_chess:SetMaxHealth(9)
				if scale < 1 then scale = 1 end
				target_chess:SetHealth(scale)
				AddAbilityAndSetLevel(target_chess, 'no_hp_add')
				picked_chess.buy_price = 0
				if picked_chess.press_count then
					target_chess.press_count = picked_chess.press_count
				end
				if picked_chess.grow_count then
					target_chess.grow_count = picked_chess.grow_count
				end
				if picked_chess.extra_synergy ~= nil and table.maxn(picked_chess.extra_synergy) > 0 then
					target_chess.extra_synergy = CopyTable(picked_chess.extra_synergy)
				end
				target_chess.mojing_ability = picked_chess.mojing_ability
				target_chess.mojing_ability_level = picked_chess.mojing_ability_level

				DropItemsFromOneChess({
					caster = caster,
					target = picked_chess,
				})
				CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("drodo_chat", {
					player_id = caster:GetPlayerID(),
					win_streak = caster.win_streak or 0,
					vip = caster.is_vip,
					onduty_hero = caster.onduty_hero,
					text = "notice_put_in_egg",
					chess = picked_chess:GetUnitName(),
					time_stamp = math.floor(GameRules:GetGameTime()),
					type = 'egg_event',
					-- emoji = 175,
				})
				RemoveChess({
					caster = caster,
					target = picked_chess,
					is_sell = false,
					force_remove = true,
				})
			end)
			return
		end
	end
	if chess_pos_type == 1 then
		--选中的棋子在手牌	
		if target_pos_type == 1 then
			--选中的棋子在手牌，目标位置在手牌
			RemoveChessFromHand(picked_chess, caster)
			if target_chess ~= nil then
				--目标位置有棋子target_chess，交换
				RemoveChessFromHand(target_chess, caster)
				AddChess2Hand(target_chess, x1, caster)
				BlinkChessX({
					p = HandIndex2Vector(team_id, x1),
					caster = target_chess,
					set_forward = true,
				})
				target_chess.cb = function(c)
					SetPrepareChessForward(c)
				end
			end
			AddChess2Hand(picked_chess, x2, caster)
			BlinkChessX({
				p = HandIndex2Vector(team_id, x2),
				caster = picked_chess,
				set_forward = true,
			})
			picked_chess.cb = function(c)
				SetPrepareChessForward(c)
				TriggerCombine(c)
			end
		elseif target_pos_type == 2 and IsBattleTime() == false then
			--选中的棋子在手牌，目标位置在场上
			if TeamId2Hero(team_id):HasModifier('modifier_item_conceal_prepare') or picked_chess:HasAbility('smoke_screen_trigger') then
				ConcealOneChess(picked_chess)
			end
			if target_chess ~= nil then
				--目标位置有棋子target_chess，找个附近的空格子跳，不交换
				local closest_xy = GetClosestEmptyArea(x2, y2, team_id)
				if closest_xy ~= nil then
					x2 = closest_xy.x
					y2 = closest_xy.y
					RemoveChessFromHand(picked_chess, caster)
					AddChess2Board(picked_chess, x2, y2, caster)
					BlinkChessX({
						p = XY2Vector(x2, y2, team_id),
						caster = picked_chess,
						set_forward = true,
					})
					picked_chess.cb = function(c)
						SetPrepareChessForward(c)
						TriggerCombine(c)
					end
				end
				picked_chess.io_target_index = target_chess:entindex()
			else
				--目标位置没有棋子，直接跳到目标位置
				RemoveChessFromHand(picked_chess, caster)
				AddChess2Board(picked_chess, x2, y2, caster)

				BlinkChessX({
					p = XY2Vector(x2, y2, team_id),
					caster = picked_chess,
					set_forward = true,
				})
				picked_chess.cb = function(c)
					SetPrepareChessForward(c)
					TriggerCombine(c)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif chess_pos_type == 2 then
		--选中的棋子在场上
		if target_pos_type == 1 and IsBattleTime() == false then
			--选中的棋子在场上，目标位置在手牌
			if TeamId2Hero(team_id):HasModifier('modifier_item_conceal_prepare') or picked_chess:HasAbility('smoke_screen_trigger') then
				RevealOneChess(picked_chess)
			end
			if target_chess ~= nil then
				--目标位置有棋子target_chess，找个附近的手牌位置跳，不交换
				local closest_empty_hand_index = GetClosestEmptyHandIndex(x2, team_id)
				if closest_empty_hand_index ~= nil then
					x2 = closest_empty_hand_index
					RemoveChessFromBoard(picked_chess, caster)
					AddChess2Hand(picked_chess, x2, caster)
					BlinkChessX({
						p = HandIndex2Vector(team_id, x2),
						caster = picked_chess,
						set_forward = true,
					})
					picked_chess.cb = function(c)
						SetPrepareChessForward(c)
						TriggerCombine(c)
					end
				end
			else
				RemoveChessFromBoard(picked_chess, caster)
				AddChess2Hand(picked_chess, x2, caster)
				BlinkChessX({
					p = HandIndex2Vector(team_id, x2),
					caster = picked_chess,
					set_forward = true,
				})
				picked_chess.cb = function(c)
					SetPrepareChessForward(c)
					TriggerCombine(c)
				end
			end
		elseif target_pos_type == 2 and IsBattleTime() == false then
			--选中的棋子在场上，目标位置在场上
			RemoveChessFromBoard(picked_chess, caster)
			if target_chess ~= nil then
				--目标位置有棋子target_chess，交换
				RemoveChessFromBoard(target_chess, caster)
				AddChess2Board(target_chess, x1, y1, caster)
				BlinkChessX({
					p = XY2Vector(x1, y1, team_id),
					caster = target_chess,
					set_forward = true,
				})
				target_chess.cb = function(c)
					SetPrepareChessForward(c)
				end
				picked_chess.io_target_index = target_chess:entindex()
			end
			AddChess2Board(picked_chess, x2, y2, caster)
			BlinkChessX({
				p = XY2Vector(x2, y2, team_id),
				caster = picked_chess,
				set_forward = true,
			})
			picked_chess.cb = function(c)
				SetPrepareChessForward(c)
				TriggerCombine(c)
			end
		end
	end

	--统计场上羁绊
	StatClassCount(team_id)
	--同步ui人口
	CheckChess(team_id)
	CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(team_id, "population", {
		key = GetClientKey(team_id),
		max_count = _G.population_max[team_id],
		count = _G.population[team_id],
	})
	-- if blink_duration > 0 then
	-- 	if y2 == -1 then
	-- 		Timers:CreateTimer(blink_duration+0.01,function()
	-- 			if IsUnitExist(picked_chess) == true then
	-- 				TriggerCombineHand(caster,picked_chess:GetUnitName())
	-- 			end
	-- 		end)
	-- 	else
	-- 		Timers:CreateTimer(blink_duration+0.01,function()
	-- 			TriggerChessCombineAtGrid(x2,y2,team_id)
	-- 		end)
	-- 	end
	-- end
end

executionFunctions.name: DAC:OnPlayerChat
executionFunctions.bodyRaw:
function DAC:OnPlayerChat(keys)
	local tokens = string.split(string.lower(keys.text))
	local player_id = keys.playerid
	local team_id = _G.playerid2team[player_id] or 1

	if team_id == 1 then
		prt((PlayerResource:GetPlayerName(player_id) or '') .. ': ' .. (tokens[1] or ''))
		return
	end

	-- local hero = player_entity:GetAssignedHero()
	local hero = PlayerId2Hero(player_id)
	if hero == nil then
		return
	end
	local heroindex = hero:GetEntityIndex()
	local team = hero:GetTeam()

	if (
			tokens[1] == "-lvlup" or
			tokens[1] == "-createhero" or
			tokens[1] == "-item" or
			tokens[1] == "-refresh" or
			tokens[1] == "-startgame" or
			tokens[1] == "-killcreeps" or
			tokens[1] == "-wtf" or
			tokens[1] == "-disablecreepspawn" or
			tokens[1] == "-gold" or
			tokens[1] == "-lvlup" or
			tokens[1] == "-refresh" or
			tokens[1] == "-respawn" or
			tokens[1] == "dota_create_unit" or
			tokens[1] == "-teleport" or
			tokens[1] == "-ggsimida"
		) then
		if IsUnitExist(hero) == true then
			KillSelfTeam(team)
		end
		return
	end
	if string.find(keys.text, "^%w%w%w%w%w%p%w%w%w%w%w%p%w%w%w%w%w$") ~= nil then
		local key = string.upper(keys.text)
		local steamid = EntIndexToHScript(heroindex).steam_id
		CustomNetTables:SetTableValue("dac_table", "cdkey", {
			player_id = player,
			steam_id = steamid,
			text = key,
			hehe = RandomInt(1, 10000)
		})
		return
	end
	if tokens[1] == '-tp' then
		DAC:OnCourierTP({
			PlayerID = hero:GetPlayerID()
		})
		-- local p = Entities:FindByName(nil,'center'..(team-6)):GetAbsOrigin()
		-- FindClearSpaceForUnit(hero,p,true)
	end
	-- if tokens[1] == '-cp' and _G.myself == true then
	-- 	CourierCP(hero,hero)
	-- end

	--测试命令
	if string.find(keys.text, "^e%w%w%w$") ~= nil and _G.myself == true then
		if hero.effect ~= nil then
			hero:RemoveAbility(hero.effect)
			hero:RemoveModifierByName('modifier_texiao_star')
		end
		hero:AddAbility(keys.text)
		hero:FindAbilityByName(keys.text):SetLevel(1)
		hero.effect = keys.text
	end

	if tokens[1] == '-test_unlock' and _G.myself == true then
		combat('TEST CODE: UNLOCK')
		--释放垄断
		UnlockDestroyedPieces(hero)
	end
	if tokens[1] == '-test_reveal' and _G.myself == true then
		RevealOneLegendary(tokens[2])
	end
	
	if tokens[1] == '-test_chessboard' and _G.myself == true then
		prt(GetChessboardInfo(hero:GetPlayerID()).id)
	end

	if tokens[1] == '-test_refill' and _G.myself == true then
		combat('TEST CODE: REFILL')
		if tokens[2] ~= nil then
			AddAChessToChessPool(tokens[2])
		end
	end

	if tokens[1] == '-test_roshan' and _G.myself == true then
		local children = hero:GetChildren()
		for k, child in pairs(children) do
			if child and child:IsNull() == false then
				print(child:GetClassname())
				-- and (child:GetClassname() == "dota_item_wearable" or child:GetClassname() == "prop_dynamic") then
				-- child:RemoveSelf()
			end
		end
	end



	if tokens[1] == '-item_got' and _G.myself == true then
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.5, function()
			local txt = '(' .. table.maxn(hero.item_got or {}) .. ')'
			for _, i in pairs(hero.item_got or {}) do
				txt = txt .. '|#' .. i .. '|, |'
			end
			prt(txt)
		end)
	end

	if tokens[1] == '-clear' and _G.myself == true then
		combat('TEST CODE: CLEAR GROUND ITEM')
		ClearTeamGround(hero:GetTeam())
	end


	if (tokens[1] == '-crab' or tokens[1] == '-chess') and _G.myself == true and _G.is_tester_mode == true then
		combat('TEST CODE: +CHESSES')
		if tokens[2] ~= nil and tokens[3] == nil then
			_G.next_crab = 'chess_' .. tokens[2]
			prt(_G.next_crab)
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local x = nil
				local this_chess = nil
				if i == 1 then
					this_chess = _G.next_crab
				elseif i == 2 then
					this_chess = _G.next_crab .. '1'
				elseif i == 3 then
					this_chess = _G.next_crab .. '11'
				end
				CreateChessInHandAsync(hero, this_chess, nil, nil, function(x) end)
			end
			_G.next_crab = nil
		else
			local u_index = 2
			while tokens[u_index] ~= nil and u_index <= 9 do
				CreateChessInHandAsync(hero, 'chess_' .. tokens[u_index], nil, nil, function(x) end)
				u_index = u_index + 1
			end
			_G.next_crab = nil
		end
	end


	if tokens[1] == '-lua' and _G.myself == true then
		local f1 = GetFrameCount()
		Timers:CreateTimer(1, function()
			local f2 = GetFrameCount()
			local fps = f2 - f1
			local memory = math.floor(collectgarbage("count") / 1000)
			local entities_table = Entities:FindAllInSphere(Vector(0, 0, 0), 99999.9)
			local entities = table.maxn(entities_table)
			prt('Lua内存: ' .. memory .. 'M, 实体数量:' .. entities .. ', 每秒帧数:' .. fps)
			-- CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("show_lua_ping",{
			-- 	fps = fps,
			-- 	memory = memory,
			-- 	entities = entities,
			-- })

			print('entities=============' .. entities)
			for _, u in pairs(entities_table) do
				print(u:GetClassname())
			end
		end)
	end

	if tokens[1] == '-timers' and _G.myself == true then
		Timers:CreateTimer(function()
			local count = 0
			for _, t in pairs(Timers.timers) do
				count = count + 1
			end
			prt('Timers总计：' .. count .. '个')
		end)
	end
	if (tokens[1] == '-drop' or tokens[1] == '-item') and _G.myself == true then
		local u_index = 2
		combat('TEST CODE: +ITEM')
		-- while tokens[u_index] ~= nil and u_index <= 9 do
		local i = 'item_' .. tokens[u_index]
		local newItem = CreateItem(i, hero, hero)
		if newItem == nil then
			return
		end
		local drop = CreateItemOnPositionForLaunch(hero:GetAbsOrigin(), newItem)
		local dropRadius = RandomFloat(50, 200)
		newItem:SimulateLaunchLoot(hero:GetAbsOrigin() + RandomVector(dropRadius))
		-- newItem:SimulateLaunchLoot(false,200,0.75,hero:GetAbsOrigin() + RandomVector(dropRadius))
		-- end
	end
	if tokens[1] == '-removeitem' and _G.myself == true then
		for i = 0, 16 do
			if hero:GetItemInSlot(i) then
				hero:RemoveItem(hero:GetItemInSlot(i))
			end
		end
	end
	if tokens[1] == '-buff' and _G.myself == true then
		local buff = GetStat(hero:GetPlayerID(), 'buff')
		print(buff)
		local chess_synergies = JoinTableString(GetStat(hero:GetPlayerID(), 'chess_synergies'))
		print(chess_synergies)
	end
	if (tokens[1] == "-choose" or tokens[1] == '-round') and _G.myself == true then
		DAC:OnTesterBoxChooseRound({ round = tonumber(tokens[2]) })
	end
	if (tokens[1] == '-mana' or tokens[1] == '-money') and _G.myself == true and _G.is_tester_mode == true then
		DAC:OnTesterBoxGiveMoney({ PlayerID = hero:GetPlayerID(), money = tonumber(tokens[2] or 100) })
	end
	if tokens[1] == '-exp' and _G.myself == true then
		local exp = tonumber(tokens[2] or 9999)
		combat('TEST CODE: +' .. exp .. ' EXP')
		AddCourierExp({
			caster = hero,
			xpadd = exp,
			disable_quick_lvl_up = true,
			cost = 0,
			ignore_level_restrict = true,
		})
	end

	if tokens[1] == '-ws' and _G.myself == true then
		local win_count = tonumber(tokens[2] or '1')
		combat('TEST CODE: +' .. win_count .. ' WIN STREAK')
		for i = 1, win_count do
			AddWinStreak(hero:GetTeam())
		end
	end
	if tokens[1] == "-a" and _G.myself == true then
		local level = tonumber(tokens[3]) or 1
		local aaa = tokens[2] or 'tester_damage'
		if aaa == 'damage' then
			aaa = 'tester_damage'
		end
		combat('TEST CODE: +ABILITY ' .. aaa .. ', LEVEL = ' .. level)
		hero:AddAbility(aaa)
		hero:FindAbilityByName(aaa):SetLevel(level)
	end
	if (tokens[1] == "-effect" or tokens[1] == "-e") and _G.myself == true then
		combat('TEST CODE: +EFFECT ' .. tokens[2])
		play_particle(tokens[2], PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, hero, 10)
		return
	end
	if tokens[1] == "-hero" and _G.myself == true then
		--装饰信使
		SetCourierAsync(hero, tokens[2], 'e000')

		hero.onduty_hero = tokens[2]
		hero.courier_name = tokens[2]
		combat('TEST CODE: COURIER = ' .. tokens[2])
		RemoveAbilityAndModifier(hero, 'courier_fly')
		if hero.flyup_effect ~= nil then
			ParticleManager:DestroyParticle(hero.flyup_effect, true)
		end
	end
	if tokens[1] == "-size" and _G.myself == true then
		hero.init_model_scale = tokens[2] + 0
		hero:SetModelScale(hero.init_model_scale)
		combat('TEST CODE: COURIER SIZE = ' .. tokens[2])
	end
	if tokens[1] == "-model" and _G.myself == true then
		--装饰信使
		local model = tokens[2]
		combat('TEST CODE: MODEL = ' .. tokens[2])
		
		hero:SetOriginalModel(model)
		hero:SetModel(model)
		hero:SetModelScale(1)
	end


	if tokens[1] == "-crown" and _G.myself == true then
		local crown_level = tonumber(tokens[2] or 1)
		combat('TEST CODE: CROWN = ' .. crown_level)
		hero.is_crown = true
		ShowCrown(hero, crown_level)
	end

function DAC:OnRefreshChess(keys)
	local player_team = _G.playerid2team[keys.PlayerID]
	local hero = _G.teamid2hero[player_team]

	if player_team ~= keys.team or IsUnitExist(hero) == false then
		return
	end

	local a = hero:FindAbilityByName("summon_hero")
	if a == nil or a:IsActivated() == false or a:IsCooldownReady() == false then
		return
	end

	a:StartCooldown(0.6)

	local cost_mana = 2
	if hero.second_draw_activate == true then
		--二次机会
		Draw5ChessAndShow(keys.team, true, -1)
		hero.second_draw_activate = nil
	elseif hero:GetMana() < 2 then
		--金币不够
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(keys.team, "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(keys.team),
			text = "text_mima_no_mana"
		})
		return
	else
		EmitSoundOn('frostivus_ui_select', hero)
		hero.chesslock = false
		CostMana(hero, 2)
		Draw5ChessAndShow(keys.team, true)
	end
end

executionFunctions.bodyRaw:
function DiscardOneItem(i, hero, update_ui)
	if IsUnitExist(hero) == false or i == nil or _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[i] == nil then
		return
	end
	if update_ui == nil then
		update_ui = true
	end
	if hero.discard_item_table == nil then
		hero.discard_item_table = {}
	end

	--如果当前等级的装备只剩4个，就不remove了！
	local cost = _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[i]
	local item_count_by_cost = table.maxn(_G.ITEM_LIST_BY_LEVEL[cost])
	local discard_count = 0
	local discard_count_total = 0
	for _, ii in pairs(hero.discard_item_table) do
		if _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[ii] == cost then
			discard_count = discard_count + 1
		end
		discard_count_total = discard_count_total + 1
	end
	if item_count_by_cost - discard_count <= 4 then
		return
	end

	if FindValueInTable(hero.discard_item_table, i) == false then
		--超过10个就把最早ban的放出来
		if discard_count_total >= 10 then
			hero.discard_item_table = RemoveFirstKeyInTable(hero.discard_item_table)
		end
		table.insert(hero.discard_item_table, i)
	end
	if update_ui == true then
		ShowDiscardItem(hero)
	end
end

function DAC:OnRequestChooseLoot(keys)
	local target_item = keys.target_item_name
	local player_id = keys.PlayerID
	local loot_index = keys.loot_index

	local hero = PlayerId2Hero(player_id)

	local loot = nil
	if hero == nil or hero:IsNull() == true then
		return
	end
	--放弃
	if loot_index ~= nil and loot_index == -1 then
		DiscardOtherLoot('', hero)
		if hero.backup_loot_table and hero.backup_loot_table[1] and _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[hero.backup_loot_table[1]] then
			local down_level = _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[hero.backup_loot_table[1]] - 1
			if down_level >= 1 and down_level <= 5 then
				AddItemPlus(hero, 'item_lootbox_lv' .. down_level)
				EmitSoundOn("dac.loot.drop", hero)
			end
		end
		hero.loot_table = nil
		hero.backup_loot_table = nil
		loot = nil
	end
	--随机一个（给的是备用的）
	if loot_index ~= nil and loot_index == -2 and hero.backup_loot_table ~= nil and type(hero.backup_loot_table) == 'table' and hero.backup_loot_table[1] ~= nil then
		loot = hero.backup_loot_table[1]
		DiscardOtherLoot(loot, hero)
	end
	--新圣物补偿
	if loot_index ~= nil and loot_index == -3 and hero.backup_loot_table and hero.backup_loot_table[1] and FindValueInTable(_G.DROP_RELIC_LIST, hero.backup_loot_table[1]) == true then
		loot = 'item_stolen_vault'
	end

	if loot_index ~= nil and loot_index > 0 and hero.loot_table ~= nil and type(hero.loot_table) == 'table' and target_item ~= nil then
		if hero.loot_table[target_item] ~= nil or hero.reroll_loot_table[target_item] ~= nil then
			loot = target_item
		end
	end
	if loot == nil then
		return
	end
	if FindValueInTable(_G.DROP_RELIC_LIST, loot) == true or loot == 'item_stolen_vault' then
		--圣物
		local relic_ori = nil
		if loot == "item_repeat_relic" then
			local relic_history = GetRelicHistory(hero)
			relic_ori = "item_repeat_relic"
			if relic_history == nil or table.maxn(relic_history) < 1 then
				loot = hero.backup_loot_table[1]
			else
				loot = relic_history[table.maxn(relic_history)]['relic']
			end
		end
		--移除旧圣物
		RemoveRelic(hero:GetTeam(),relic_ori)

		if HasEmptySlot4Relic(hero) == false then
			--没位置了，选取失败
			CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(hero:GetTeam(), "request_choose_loot_cb", {
				key = GetClientKey(hero:GetTeam()),
				result = false,
				error = 'text_mima_inventory_full',
			})
			return
		end

		SetStat(player_id, 'relic', relic_ori or loot, true)
		ExcludeOneRelic(relic_ori or loot, hero)
		AddRelic2History(hero, relic_ori or loot)
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.01,function()
			if _G.battle_round%10 == 1 and _G.game_status == 2 then
				UpdateRelicTTL(hero, 11)
			else
				UpdateRelicTTL(hero, 10)
			end
		end)
	else
		AddItemGot(hero, loot)

	end
	AddItemPlus(hero, loot)

	StartUpdateUIRecycleItemResult(hero)
	EmitSoundOn("General.Combine", hero)
	play_particle("effect/combine_item/1.vpcf", PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, hero, 3)

	hero.loot_table = nil
	hero.backup_loot_table = nil

	CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(hero:GetTeam(), "request_choose_loot_cb", {
		key = GetClientKey(hero:GetTeam()),
		result = true,
	})


	local quest_2_relic_list = {
		q033 = 'item_double_lootbox',
		q034 = 'item_upgrade_lootbox',
		q035 = 'item_more_interest',
		q036 = 'item_more_reward',
		q037 = 'item_upgrade_roll',
		q038 = 'item_destroy_piece',
		q039 = 'item_friends_discount',
		q040 = 'item_conceal_prepare',
		q041 = 'item_streak_plus',
		q042 = 'item_free_ban',
		q043 = 'item_double_io',
		q044 = 'item_shrink_meister',
		q045 = 'item_vampiric_embrace',
		q046 = 'item_second_chance',
		q047 = 'item_mangotree',
	}
	if quest_2_relic_list[_G.egg_quest] ~= nil and quest_2_relic_list[_G.egg_quest] == loot then
		--完成指定圣物任务
		SetQuest(hero.team_id, true)
	end
	if IsUnitExist(hero) == false then
		return
	end
	--选取圣物
	if loot == 'item_stolen_vault' then
		local position_to = CenterVector(hero:GetTeam()) + Vector(RandomInt(-400, 400), RandomInt(-400, 400), 0)
		DropMoneyBag(Vector(0, 0, 128), position_to, 300, RandomInt(10,15))
	end
	if loot == 'item_magic_box' then
		hero.magic_box_exclude_table = {}
	end
	if loot == 'item_conceal_prepare' then
		--帷幕
		if _G.game_status ~= 2 then
			HidePrepare(hero:GetTeam())
		end
	end
	if loot == 'item_free_ban' then
		--钥匙（如果已经ban了，返还价格）
		if hero.synergy_banned_price ~= nil and hero.synergy_banned_price > 0 then
			--获得destroy_tax金币
			local position_to = CenterVector(hero:GetTeam()) + Vector(RandomInt(-400, 400), RandomInt(-400, 400), 0)
			DropMoneyBag(Vector(0, 0, 128), position_to, 300, (hero.synergy_banned_price or 1))
			-- AddTotalMoneyStat(hero:GetPlayerID(), (hero.synergy_banned_price or 1))
			hero.synergy_banned_price = 0
		end
	end

	if loot == 'item_mangotree' then
		local pp = CenterVector(hero:GetTeam()) + Vector(128 * 5, -128 * 2.5, 0)
		GridNav:DestroyTreesAroundPoint(pp, 100, false)
		local tt = CreateUnitByName("mango_tree", pp, false, nil, nil, hero:GetTeam())
		tt.team_id = hero:GetTeam()
		hero.mango_tree = tt
		AddAbilityAndSetLevel(tt, 'no_hp_add')
		tt:SetBaseMaxHealth(8)
		tt:SetMaxHealth(8)
		tt:SetHealth(8)
		play_particle(
		"particles/econ/items/oracle/oracle_ti10_immortal/oracle_ti10_immortal_purifyingflames_dust_hit_ring.vpcf",
			PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, hero.mango_tree, 3)
		EmitSoundOn("item.mangotree.spawn", hero.mango_tree)

		Timers:CreateTimer(0.3, function()
			if GetCurrRelicByTeam(hero:GetTeam()) ~= nil then
				GetCurrRelicByTeam(hero:GetTeam()):SetCurrentCharges(8)
			end
		end)
	end
	if loot == 'item_more_interest' then
		local pp = CenterVector(hero:GetTeam()) + Vector(128 * 5, -128 * 2.5, 0)
		GridNav:DestroyTreesAroundPoint(pp, 100, false)
		local gg = CreateUnitByName("great_vault", pp, false, nil, nil, hero:GetTeam())
		gg.team_id = hero:GetTeam()
		hero.great_vault = gg
		play_particle(
		"particles/econ/items/oracle/oracle_ti10_immortal/oracle_ti10_immortal_purifyingflames_dust_hit_ring.vpcf",
			PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, hero.great_vault, 3)
		EmitSoundOn("hongweibaoku", hero.great_vault)
	end
	if loot == 'item_upgrade_lootbox' then
		--哼哼井武器匠
		hero.upgrade_lootbox_chance = 2

		local pp = CenterVector(hero:GetTeam()) + Vector(128 * 5, -128 * 2.5, 0)
		GridNav:DestroyTreesAroundPoint(pp, 100, false)
		local gg = CreateUnitByName("blacksmith", pp, false, nil, nil, hero:GetTeam())
		gg.team_id = hero:GetTeam()

		gg:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)
		play_particle("particles/econ/events/compendium_2023/compendium_2023_teleport_end_streaks.vpcf",
			PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, gg, 3)

		Timers:CreateTimer(0.01, function()
			if IsUnitExist(gg) == true then
				-- gg:FaceTowards(Vector(-1,0,0))
				gg:SetForwardVector(Vector(-1, 0, 0))
				gg:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_IDLE)

				return 1
			else
				return
			end
		end)

		hero.blacksmith = gg
		hero.blacksmith:SetHealth(hero.upgrade_lootbox_chance)
		-- play_particle("particles/econ/items/oracle/oracle_ti10_immortal/oracle_ti10_immortal_purifyingflames_dust_hit_ring.vpcf",PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW,hero.great_vault,3)
		EmitSoundOn("blacksmith", hero.blacksmith)

		Timers:CreateTimer(0.3, function()
			if GetCurrRelicByTeam(hero:GetTeam()) ~= nil then
				GetCurrRelicByTeam(hero:GetTeam()):SetCurrentCharges(hero.upgrade_lootbox_chance)
			end
		end)
	end

	if loot == 'item_bench_contract' then
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local pp = HandIndex2Vector(hero:GetTeam(), i)
			local holder = CreateChessInHand(hero, "placeholder", true)
			if IsUnitExist(holder) then
				BlinkChessX({ caster = holder, blink_type = "breaksoil" })
				-- holder:SetForwardVector(Vector(0,-1,0))
				holder.buy_price = 1
				local scale = holder.buy_price
				AddModelScalePlus(holder, 1.2 + scale / 10.0)
				AddTotalMoneyStat(player_id, 1)
				holder:SetBaseMaxHealth(scale)
				holder:SetMaxHealth(scale)
			else
				--生成失败：自动卖1块钱
				AddCourierMana(hero, 1)
				AddTotalMoneyStat(hero:GetPlayerID(), 1)
			end
		end
		EmitSoundOn('Hero_Treant.Overgrowth.Target', hero)
	end

	if loot == 'item_copy_synergy' then
		EmitSoundOn('General.Buy', hero)
		if RandomInt(1, 100) <= 50 then
			AddItemPlus(hero, 'item_card_fate')
		else
			AddItemPlus(hero, 'item_card_chance')
		end
	end
	if loot == 'item_streak_plus' then
		hero.streak_plus_win = hero.win_streak
		hero.streak_plus_lose = hero.lose_streak

		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(hero:GetTeam(), "show_gold", {
			key = GetClientKey(hero:GetTeam()),
			gold = hero:GetMana(),
			lose_streak = hero.lose_streak or 0,
			win_streak = hero.win_streak or 0,
			box_level = CalStreakPlusBoxLevel(TeamId2Hero(hero:GetTeam())),
		})
	end
end

executionFunctions.name: GetDamageAbility
executionFunctions.bodyRaw:
function GetDamageAbility(a, v, damage, entindex_inflictor_const)
	if not entindex_inflictor_const or damage <= 0 then
		return nil
	end

	local ability = EntIndexToHScript(entindex_inflictor_const)
	if ability ~= nil and ability:GetAbilityName() ~= nil then
		return ability
	end
end

executionFunctions.bodyRaw:
function DAC:DamageFilter(keys)
	if keys.entindex_victim_const == nil then
		return false
	end
	local v = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_victim_const)
	local a = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_attacker_const or keys.entindex_victim_const)
	local t = keys.damagetype_const
	local is_summons = false
	local is_illusion = false
	local a_ori = a
	if IsSummons(a) == true then
		is_summons = true
	end
	if a:HasModifier("modifier_illusion") == true then
		is_illusion = true
	end
	if a.damage_owner ~= nil and a.damage_owner:IsNull() == false then
		a = a.damage_owner
	end
	--仅限同棋盘伤害
	local attacker_at_team_id = a.at_team_id or a.team_id
	local victim_at_teamid = v.at_team_id or v.team_id
	if attacker_at_team_id ~= victim_at_teamid then
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end

	--手牌的棋子，不能造成伤害（拿辉耀之类的情况）
	if a.hand_index ~= nil then
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end

	--ability是技能伤害，nil是普攻伤害
	local damage_ability = GetDamageAbility(a, v, keys.damage, keys.entindex_inflictor_const)

	--攻击伤害类型转换1：火枪狙击伤害锁定为物理
	if t == DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL and (a:HasModifier('modifier_item_aiweinazhiyu') == false or a:HasModifier('modifier_item_haojie') == true or a:HasModifier('modifier_is_demonhunter_buff_plus') == true or a:HasModifier('modifier_is_demon_buff') == true) and a:HasAbility('sniper_assassinate') and damage_ability and damage_ability:GetAbilityName() == 'sniper_assassinate' then
		--新版狙击手-暗杀：根据等级造成物理伤害，并将原来的魔法伤害无效化
		local d = keys.damage or 400
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
			ApplyDamage({
				victim = v,
				attacker = a,
				damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL,
				damage = d,
				ability = a:FindAbilityByName('sniper_assassinate'),
			})
		end)
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end
	--攻击伤害类型转换2：巨魔战将飞斧技能的伤害锁定为物理伤害
	if damage_ability and a:HasAbility('troll_axe') and damage_ability:GetAbilityName() == 'troll_warlord_whirling_axes_melee' then
		local axe_damage = keys.damage
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
			ApplyDamage({
				victim = v,
				attacker = a,
				damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL,
				damage = axe_damage,
				ability = a:FindAbilityByName('troll_axe'),
			})
		end)
		a:PerformAttack(v, true, true, true, false, false, false, true)
		play_particle(
		"particles/econ/items/bloodseeker/bloodseeker_eztzhok_weapon/bloodseeker_bloodbath_eztzhok_ribbon.vpcf",
			PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, v, 2)
		EmitSoundOn("chess_troll.axe.hit", v)
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end
	if damage_ability and a:HasAbility('troll_axe') and damage_ability:GetAbilityName() == 'troll_warlord_whirling_axes_ranged' then
		local axe_damage = keys.damage
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
			ApplyDamage({
				victim = v,
				attacker = a,
				damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL,
				damage = axe_damage,
				ability = a:FindAbilityByName('troll_axe'),
			})
		end)
		a:PerformAttack(v, true, true, true, false, false, false, true)
		play_particle(
		"particles/econ/items/bloodseeker/bloodseeker_eztzhok_weapon/bloodseeker_bloodbath_eztzhok_ribbon.vpcf",
			PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, v, 2)
		EmitSoundOn("chess_troll.axe.hit", v)
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end
	--攻击伤害类型转换3：战鹰、斗熊等锁定伤害类型的攻击
	if a:HasAbility('attack_magical') and t == DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL then
		--仅在这里将伤害无效化，实际伤害逻辑做在了技能里
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end
	if a:HasAbility('attack_pure') and t ~= DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE then
		--仅在这里将伤害无效化，实际伤害逻辑做在了技能里
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end
	--攻击伤害类型转换4：单恶魔的攻击伤害转为纯粹
	if a:HasModifier('modifier_is_demon_buff') and is_illusion ~= true and not damage_ability and t ~= DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE then
		--仅在这里将伤害无效化，实际伤害逻辑做在了技能里
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end
	--攻击伤害类型转换5：4恶魔猎手、浩劫
	if keys.damage > 0 and (a:HasModifier('modifier_item_haojie') or a:HasModifier('modifier_is_demonhunter_buff_plus')) and t ~= DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE then
		local damage_origin = keys.damage * 1.0
		local m_r = v:Script_GetMagicalArmorValue(nil)
		if t == DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL then
			if m_r >= 1.0 then
				m_r = 0.99
			end
			damage_origin = damage_origin / (1 - m_r)
		end
		local p_r = v:GetPhysicalArmorValue(false)
		if t == DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL then
			damage_origin = damage_origin / (1 - (0.06 * p_r / (1 + 0.06 * math.abs(p_r))))
		end
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
			ApplyDamage({
				victim = v,
				attacker = a,
				damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE,
				damage = damage_origin,
				ability = damage_ability,
			})
		end)
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end
	--攻击伤害类型转换6：艾维娜之羽都转成魔法伤害
	if a:HasModifier('modifier_item_aiweinazhiyu') == true and a:HasModifier('modifier_item_haojie') == false and a:HasModifier('modifier_is_demonhunter_buff_plus') == false and a:HasModifier('modifier_is_demon_buff') == false and t ~= DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL then
		local damage_origin = keys.damage
		local p_r = v:GetPhysicalArmorValue(false)
		if t == DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL then
			damage_origin = damage_origin / (1 - (0.06 * p_r / (1 + 0.06 * math.abs(p_r))))
		end
		Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
			ApplyDamage({
				victim = v,
				attacker = a,
				damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL,
				damage = damage_origin,
				ability = damage_ability,
			})
		end)
		keys.damage = 0
		return false
	end
	--图腾受到伤害，锁定伤害量为1或者2
	if (v:HasAbility('is_ward') == true or v:HasAbility("ward_portal") == true) and keys.damage > 0 then
		if IsUnitExist(a) == true and (v:GetAbsOrigin() - a:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D() > 200 then
			keys.damage = 2
		else
			keys.damage = 1
		end

		-- --恶魔之扉：技能免疫
		-- if v:HasAbility("ward_portal") == true and damage_ability then
		-- 	keys.damage = 0
		-- 	return false
		-- end
	end

	if v:HasModifier('modifier_wisp_tether_buff') then 
		local aa = v:FindModifierByName('modifier_wisp_tether_buff'):GetAbility()
		local reduction_per = GetAbilityKV(aa,'damage_reduction_per') or 0
		keys.damage = keys.damage * (100-reduction_per)/100
	end
	if v:HasModifier('modifier_wisp_altar_power_count') then 
		local power_count = v:FindModifierByName('modifier_wisp_altar_power_count'):GetStackCount()
		keys.damage = keys.damage * math.pow(0.9,power_count)
	end
	if a:HasModifier('modifier_wisp_altar_power_count') then 
		local power_count = a:FindModifierByName('modifier_wisp_altar_power_count'):GetStackCount()
		keys.damage = keys.damage * math.pow(1.1,power_count)
	end
	--被石化的棋子加深伤害
	if a:HasModifier("modifier_is_element_buff_plus_plus") == true and v:HasModifier('modifier_medusa_stone_gaze_stone') then
		local aa = a:FindModifierByName('modifier_is_element_buff_plus_plus'):GetAbility()
		local multi = GetAbilityKV(aa,'multiplier') or 1
		keys.damage = keys.damage * multi
	end
	
	--镜像棋子，只造成50%伤害
	if a:HasModifier("modifier_illusion") == true then
		keys.damage = keys.damage * 0.5
	end
	--幽鬼打荒芜
	if a:HasModifier('modifier_spe_desolate') and IsLonely(v) == true then
		-- play_particle('effect/dead/2.vpcf',PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW,v,3)
		keys.damage = keys.damage * 2.0
		-- local desolate_ability = a:FindAbilityByName('spe_desolate')
		-- if desolate_ability ~= nil then
		-- 	local chaos_per = GetAbilityKV(desolate_ability,'chaos_per')
		-- 	local chaos_duration = GetAbilityKV(desolate_ability,'chaos_duration')
		-- 	if RandomInt(1,100) <= chaos_per then
		-- 		desolate_ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(a, v, "modifier_queenofpain_sonic_wave_chaos_debuff", {
		-- 			duration = chaos_duration
		-- 		})
		-- 	end
		-- end
	end

	--幻象法球
	if damage_ability and damage_ability:GetAbilityName() == 'puck_illusory_orb' then
		local duration = GetAbilityKV(damage_ability, 'blind_duration') or 2
		v:AddNewModifier(a, v, "modifier_keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light", { duration = duration })
	end

	--lion死亡一指
	--and (a:HasModifier('modifier_item_haojie') == true or a:HasModifier('modifier_is_demonhunter_buff_plus') == true or a:HasModifier('modifier_is_demon_buff') == true) 
	if t == DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL and damage_ability and damage_ability:GetAbilityName() == 'lion_finger_of_death'  then
		local lion_ability = a:FindAbilityByName('lion_finger_of_death')
		if lion_ability ~= nil then
			local bonus = GetAbilityKV(lion_ability, "damage_bonus") or 200
			local base = GetAbilityKV(lion_ability, "damage") or 300
			local d_count = a.demon_count
			if a.damage_owner and a.damage_owner.demon_count then
				d_count = a.damage_owner.demon_count
			end
			local damage_final = base + ((d_count or 0) * bonus)

			if a:HasModifier('modifier_item_aiweinazhiyu') == true then
				keys.damage = damage_final
			else
				Timers:CreateTimer(0.01, function()
					ApplyDamage({
						victim = v,
						attacker = a,
						damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE,
						damage = damage_final,
						ability = damage_ability,
					})
				end)
				keys.damage = 0
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	if t == DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL then
		if v:HasAbility("mars_bulwark_attack") == true then
			--玛尔斯，计算角度，决定是否抵挡部分伤害
			local ability = v:FindAbilityByName("mars_bulwark_attack")
			local level = ability:GetLevel()
			local v1 = v:GetForwardVector():Normalized()
			local v2 = (a:GetAbsOrigin() - v:GetAbsOrigin()):Normalized()
			-- local cross_product = v1.x * v2.x + v1.y * v2.y
			local angle1 = VectorToAngles(v1)
			local angle2 = VectorToAngles(v2)
			local p = "particles/units/heroes/hero_mars/mars_shield_of_mars_small.vpcf"
			if level >= 3 then
				p = "particles/units/heroes/hero_mars/mars_shield_of_mars.vpcf"
			end

			if math.abs(angle1.y - angle2.y) < 45 or (360 - math.abs(angle1.y - angle2.y)) < 45 then
				--90度范围内
				local damage_reduce_per = ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("physical_damage_reduction", level - 1)
				keys.damage = keys.damage / 100.0 * (100 - damage_reduce_per)
				play_particle(p, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, v, 2)
			elseif math.abs(angle1.y - angle2.y) < 90 or (360 - math.abs(angle1.y - angle2.y)) < 90 then
				--180度范围内
				local damage_reduce_per = ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("physical_damage_reduction_side", level - 1)
				keys.damage = keys.damage / 100.0 * (100 - damage_reduce_per)
				play_particle(p, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, v, 2)
			end
		end
		--矮人：所以类型伤害根据距离增加伤害
		if a:HasModifier('modifier_is_dwarf_buff_plus') then
			--2矮人
			local distance = (a:GetAbsOrigin() - v:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D()

			local damage_bouns_per = distance / 128.0 / 1.414 * 15
			keys.damage = keys.damage * (100 + damage_bouns_per) / 100
		end
		--6野兽：根据层数增加伤害
		if v:FindModifierByName('modifier_is_beast_debuff_plus_plus') ~= nil then
			local count = v:FindModifierByName('modifier_is_beast_debuff_plus_plus'):GetStackCount()
			keys.damage = keys.damage * (1 + count * 10 / 100)
		end
		-- --9猎人：击退敌人
		-- if a:HasModifier('modifier_is_hunter_buff_plus_plus') == true then
		-- 	local blocks = 1
		-- 	local knockback_result = KnockBack({
		-- 		caster = a,
		-- 		target = v,
		-- 		blocks = blocks,
		-- 	})
		-- 	if knockback_result == true then
		-- 		ExtraDamage({
		-- 			caster = a,
		-- 			target = v,
		-- 			damage = 50,
		-- 			damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL
		-- 		})
		-- 	end
		-- end
	end
	if t == DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL then
		--魔法伤害，可被装备加成
		local damage_magical_x_list = {
			modifier_item_konglingguajian = 20,
			-- modifier_item_ahalimumojing = 20,
			modifier_item_hongzhang = 40,
			modifier_item_yangdao = 60,
			modifier_item_ahalimushenzhang = 40,
			modifier_item_huiguang = 30,
			modifier_item_fashulengjing = 20,
			-- modifier_item_aiweinazhiyu = 30,
			modifier_item_yuanlifazhang = 10,
		}

		local damage_magical_bonus = 0
		for m, b in pairs(damage_magical_x_list) do
			if a:FindModifierByName(m) ~= nil then
				damage_magical_bonus = damage_magical_bonus + b
			end

		if a.xuejingshi_count ~= nil and a.xuejingshi_count > 0 then

	end

	--造成伤害回蓝
	if IsUnitExist(a) == true then
		mana_get = keys.damage / 10
		if mana_get > 20 then
			mana_get = 20
		end
		if a:HasModifier('modifier_sil_silence_all') == true then
			mana_get = 0
		end
		MPRechargeHit({
			caster = a,
			mana_base = mana_get,
		})
	end

	if v:GetUnitName() == 'dummy' then
		v:StartGestureWithPlaybackRate(ACT_DOTA_FLINCH, 1)
	end
	--伤害统计（不统计过量伤害）
	local damage_stat = keys.damage
	if damage_stat > v:GetHealth() then
		damage_stat = v:GetHealth()
	end
	Add2DamageStat(a, v, damage_stat, t)
	return true
end

				if t.draenei_heal > 300 then

					ApplyDamageInRadius({

function StartUpdateUIRecycleItemResult(u)
	if u.update_ui_recycle_timer ~= nil then
		return
	end
	Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
		--启动一个timer，当检测到装备数量发生变化的时候，OnShowRecycleItemResult
		if IsUnitExist(u) == false or u:IsHero() == false then
			u.update_ui_recycle_timer = nil
			return
		end
		local item_count_before = u.item_count or 0
		local try_count = 100
		if u.update_ui_recycle_timer ~= nil then
			return
		end
		DAC:OnShowRecycleItemResult({
			PlayerID = u:GetPlayerID(),
			show_confirm = 0,
		})
		u.update_ui_recycle_timer = Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
			if IsUnitExist(u) == false or try_count <= 0 then
				u.update_ui_recycle_timer = nil
				return
			end
			local item_count = GetUnitItemCount(u)
			if GetUnitItemCount(u) ~= item_count_before then
				DAC:OnShowRecycleItemResult({
					PlayerID = u:GetPlayerID(),
					show_confirm = 0,
				})
				u.update_ui_recycle_timer = nil
				return
			end
			try_count = try_count - 1
			return 0.1
		end)
		return
	end)
end
