function CopySynergy(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	local target = keys.target
	local ability = keys.ability
	local p = (keys.target_points or {})[1]

	if GetTime().phase == GAME_PHASE_BATTLE or GetTime().phase == GAME_PHASE_PREPARE and GetTime().left < 2 then
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(caster:GetTeam(), "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(caster:GetTeam()),
			text = "text_mima_cannot_delete_battle_chess"
		})
		EmitSoundOn("General.CastFail_NoMana", caster)
		return
	end

	--支持点目标选取
	if not target then
		local x = Vector2X(p, caster:GetTeam())
		local y = Vector2Y(p, caster:GetTeam())
		if y > 0 then
			for _, unit in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(caster:GetTeam())) do
				if IsUnitExist(unit) == true and unit.x == x and unit.y == y and unit:GetTeam() == caster:GetTeam() then
					target = unit
				end
			end
		end
		if y == -1 and caster.hand_entities and caster.hand_entities[x] then
			target = caster.hand_entities[x]
		end
	end
	if IsUnitExist(target) == false then
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(caster:GetTeam(), "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(caster:GetTeam()),
			text = "text_mima_no_target"
		})
		return
	end
	if target:HasModifier('modifier_shining') == true then
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(caster:GetTeam(), "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(caster:GetTeam()),
			text = "text_mima_already_shining"
		})
		return
	end

	local type = keys.type
	local copy_synergy = nil
	local try_count = 0
	local copycat = nil
	local exclusion_table = {}
	--不能坤的羁绊
	local invalid_synergy = {
		'is_human', 'is_pandaman', 'is_druid', 'is_mech', 'is_undead',
	}
	local invalid_synergy_meele = { 'is_dwarf' }
	while copy_synergy == nil and try_count < 200 do
		try_count = try_count + 1
		copycat = FindAllyClosest(target, true, exclusion_table)
		if IsUnitExist(copycat) then
			if type == 'race' then
				local race, race2 = GetChessRace(GetUnitBaseName(copycat))
				local target_race, target_race2 = GetChessRace(GetUnitBaseName(target))
				local synergy_check = nil
				if (target:Script_GetAttackRange() <= 205 or FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy_meele, race) == false) and FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy, race) == false and race ~= target_race and race ~= target_race2 and target:FindAbilityByName(race) == nil then
					synergy_check = race
				end
				if race2 ~= nil then
					if (target:Script_GetAttackRange() <= 205 or FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy_meele, race2) == false) and FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy, race2) == false and race2 ~= target_race and race2 ~= target_race2 and target:FindAbilityByName(race2) == nil then
						if RandomInt(1, 100) < 50 or synergy_check == nil then
							synergy_check = race2
						end
					end
				end
				if synergy_check ~= nil then
					copy_synergy = synergy_check
				end
			end
			if type == 'class' then
				local class, class2, class3 = GetChessClass(GetUnitBaseName(copycat))
				local synergy_check = nil
				if (target:Script_GetAttackRange() <= 205 or FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy_meele, class) == false) and FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy, class) == false and class ~= target_class and class ~= target_class2 and class ~= target_class3 and target:FindAbilityByName(class) == nil then
					synergy_check = class
				end
				if class2 ~= nil and class3 ~= nil then
					if (target:Script_GetAttackRange() <= 205 or FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy_meele, class2) == false) and FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy, class2) == false and class2 ~= target_class and class2 ~= target_class2 and class2 ~= target_class3 and target:FindAbilityByName(class2) == nil then
						if RandomInt(1, 100) < 50 or synergy_check == nil then
							synergy_check = class2
						end
					end
					if (target:Script_GetAttackRange() <= 205 or FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy_meele, class3) == false) and FindValueInTable(invalid_synergy, class3) == false and class3 ~= target_class and class3 ~= target_class2 and class3 ~= target_class3 and target:FindAbilityByName(class3) == nil then
						if RandomInt(1, 100) < 50 or synergy_check == nil then
							synergy_check = class3
						end
					end
				end
				local target_class, target_class2, target_class3 = GetChessClass(GetUnitBaseName(target))
				if synergy_check ~= nil then
					copy_synergy = synergy_check
				end
			end
			if copycat ~= nil and copy_synergy == nil then
				table.insert(exclusion_table, copycat:entindex())
			end
		end
	end
	if copy_synergy ~= nil then
		AddSynergy({
			caster = target,
			synergy = copy_synergy
		})
		SaveExtraSynergy(target, copy_synergy)

		ItemSpendCharge(keys)
		target:FindAbilityByName('dac_guai_base'):ApplyDataDrivenModifier(target, target, 'modifier_shining', {})
		--特效、音效
		local effect_name = "particles/units/heroes/hero_rubick/rubick_spell_steal.vpcf"
		ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile({
			Target = target,
			Source = copycat,
			Ability = nil,
			EffectName = effect_name,
			bDodgeable = false,
			iMoveSpeed = 1200,
			bProvidesVision = false,
			iSourceAttachment = DOTA_PROJECTILE_ATTACHMENT_ATTACK_1
		})
		target:StartGesture(ACT_DOTA_CAST_ABILITY_4)
		EmitSoundOn("Hero_Rubick.SpellSteal.Cast", target)

		play_particle("particles/econ/events/frostivus/frostivus_tree_cast_ability.vpcf", PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW,
			target, 3)

		if type == 'race' then
			CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("drodo_chat", {
				player_id = caster:GetPlayerID(),
				win_streak = caster.win_streak or 0,
				vip = caster.is_vip,
				onduty_hero = caster.onduty_hero,
				text = "notice_add_synergy1",
				chess = target:GetUnitName(),
				time_stamp = math.floor(GameRules:GetGameTime()),
				type = 'copy_synergy_event',
				ability = copy_synergy,
				-- emoji = 175,
			})
		else
			CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToAllClients("drodo_chat", {
				player_id = caster:GetPlayerID(),
				win_streak = caster.win_streak or 0,
				vip = caster.is_vip,
				onduty_hero = caster.onduty_hero,
				text = "notice_add_synergy2",
				chess = target:GetUnitName(),
				time_stamp = math.floor(GameRules:GetGameTime()),
				type = 'copy_synergy_event',
				ability = copy_synergy,
				-- emoji = 175,
			})
		end
	else
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(caster:GetTeam(), "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(caster:GetTeam()),
			text = "text_mima_no_synergy_to_copy"
		})
		return
	end
end

function MedusaSplitShot(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	local ability = keys.ability
	if not IsUnitExist(caster) or ability == nil then
		return
	end

	local arrow_count = GetAbilityKV(ability, "arrow_count") or 3
	local split_shot_bonus_range = GetAbilityKV(ability, "split_shot_bonus_range") or 100

	local team_id = caster.at_team_id or caster.team_id
	local target_table = {}
	for _, v in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(team_id)) do
		if IsUnitExist(v) and v:GetTeam() ~= caster:GetTeam() and (caster:GetAttackTarget() and v:entindex() ~= caster:GetAttackTarget():entindex()) and GetDistance(caster, v) < caster:Script_GetAttackRange() + split_shot_bonus_range then
			table.insert(target_table, {
				chess_index = v:entindex(),
				chess_name = v:GetUnitName(),
				distance = GetDistance(caster, v),
			})
		end
	end


	if table.maxn(target_table) > 0 then
		if table.maxn(target_table) > arrow_count then
			table.sort(target_table, function(a, b)
				return a.distance < b.distance
			end)
		end

		Timers:CreateTimer(0.3, function()
			for i = 1, arrow_count do
				if target_table[i] ~= nil and target_table[i].chess_index ~= nil then
					local v = EntIndexToHScript(target_table[i].chess_index)
					if IsUnitExist(v) == true then
						projectile = ProjectileManager:CreateTrackingProjectile({
							Target = v,
							Source = caster,
							Ability = ability,
							EffectName = caster:GetRangedProjectileName(),
							bDodgeable = false,
							iMoveSpeed = 800,
							bProvidesVision = false,
							iSourceAttachment = DOTA_PROJECTILE_ATTACHMENT_HITLOC
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

	if u:HasModifier('modifier_is_demonhunter_buff') == true then
		for _, unit in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(u.at_team_id or u.team_id or u:GetTeam())) do
			if IsUnitExist(unit) == true then

				-- end
				if unit.team_id == u.team_id and unit:HasAbility('is_demon') then
					demon_count = demon_count + 1
				end
				if unit.team_id ~= u.team_id and unit:HasAbility('is_demonhunter') then
					demon_count = demon_count + 1
				end
			end
		end
	else
		--没有恶魔猎手buff，只有友方同名的恶魔才算
		for _, unit in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(u.at_team_id or u.team_id or u:GetTeam())) do

				if unit.team_id == u.team_id and unit:HasAbility('is_demon') and GetChessBaseName(unit:GetUnitName()) == GetChessBaseName(u:GetUnitName()) then
					demon_count = demon_count + 1

		end
	end
	if demon_count > 7 then
		demon_count = 7
	end
	u.demon_count = demon_count
	if u:HasModifier('modifier_is_demon_buff') then
		if u.demon_count > 0 then

function GetEvolveLevel(u)
	if IsUnitExist(u) == false then
		return 0
	end
	local u_team = u:GetTeam()
	local chesser_team = u_team
	if u_team == 4 then
		--客场棋子
		chesser_team = _G.counterpart[u.at_team_id or 0]
		if chesser_team == nil then
			return 0
		end
	elseif u_team >= 6 and u_team <= 13 then
		--主场棋子
	else
		return 0
	end
	local level = GetLevel(u) or 1
	local max_level = TeamId2Hero(chesser_team):GetLevel()
	local delta = 0
	if u:HasModifier('modifier_is_shaman_buff_plus_plus') then
		delta = 2
	elseif u:HasModifier('modifier_is_shaman_buff_plus') then
		delta = 2
	end
	level = level + (delta or 0)
	if level > max_level then
		level = max_level
	end
	if level > 9 then
		level = 9
	end
	if level < 1 then
		level = 1
	end
	return level
end

function FindNUnluckydog(n, chessboard_id, fun)
	local chess_table = {}
	for _, unit in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(chessboard_id)) do
		if IsUnitExist(unit) == true then
			table.insert(chess_table, {
				entindex = unit:entindex(),
				unit_name = unit:GetUnitName(),
				score = fun(unit),
			})
		end
	end
	table.sort(chess_table, function(a, b)
		return a.score > b.score
	end)
	local result_table = {}
	for i = 1, n do
		local obj = chess_table[i]
		if obj ~= nil and obj.score >= 0 then
			table.insert(result_table, EntIndexToHScript(obj.entindex))
		end
	end
	return result_table
end

		local min_distance = 9999

		for x = 1, 8 do

function GetLineupDistanceScore(chess_table, teamid)
	if chess_table == nil or teamid == nil then
		return
	end
	local d_sum = 0
	local d_var_sum = 0
	local d_count = 0
	for _, base_chess in pairs(chess_table) do
		d_count = d_count + 1
		for _, target_chess in pairs(chess_table) do
			local d_single = (XY2Vector(base_chess.x, base_chess.y, teamid) - XY2Vector(target_chess.x, target_chess.y, teamid))
			:Length2D()
			d_var_sum = d_var_sum + math.pow((d_single - 400), 2)
			d_sum = d_sum + d_single
		end
	end
	return d_sum / d_count - math.sqrt(d_var_sum)
end

function SparseLineup(hero)
	if IsUnitExist(hero) == false or hero:FindAbilityByName('pick_chess') == nil or hero:FindAbilityByName("pick_chess"):IsActivated() == false then
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(hero:GetTeam(), "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(hero:GetTeam()),
			text = "text_cannot_move_chess",
		})
		return
	end

	local chess_table = {}
	for _, v in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(hero:GetTeam())) do
		if IsUnitExist(v) == true and v:GetTeam() ~= 4 and v.y ~= nil and v.x ~= nil then
			chess_table[v.y .. '_' .. v.x] = {
				x = v.x,
				y = v.y,
				entindex = v:entindex()
			}
		end
	end

	local d_base = GetLineupDistanceScore(chess_table, hero:GetTeam())
	local d_check = d_base + 0.1
	local loop_count = 0
	local temp_table = chess_table
	local fail_try = 0
	while loop_count < 100 do
		loop_count = loop_count + 1
		if d_base < d_check then
			temp_table = chess_table
			for _, chess in pairs(temp_table) do
				local n_count = GetOnechessNeighbour(temp_table, hero:GetTeam(), chess)
				if n_count > 0 then
					local d_before = GetOnechessDistanceScore(temp_table, hero:GetTeam(), chess)
					local delta_y = math.floor((math.atan(chess.y - 2.5) + RandomInt(-1, 3)) / 2)
					local delta_x = math.floor((math.atan((chess.x - 4.5) / 2.5) + RandomInt(-1, 3)) / 2)
					local new_x = chess.x + delta_x
					local new_y = chess.y + delta_y
					if new_x < 1 then new_x = 1 end
					if new_x > 8 then new_x = 8 end
					if new_y < 1 then new_y = 1 end
					if new_y > 4 then new_y = 4 end
					if temp_table[new_y .. '_' .. new_x] == nil then
						local chess_data = {
							x = new_x,
							y = new_y,
							entindex = chess.entindex
						}
						local d_after = GetOnechessDistanceScore(temp_table, hero:GetTeam(), chess_data)
						if d_after > d_before then
							temp_table[chess.y .. '_' .. chess.x] = nil
							temp_table[new_y .. '_' .. new_x] = chess_data
						end
					end
				end
			end
			d_base = d_check
			d_check = GetLineupDistanceScore(temp_table, hero:GetTeam())
		else
			d_check = d_base + 0.1
			fail_try = fail_try + 1
			if fail_try > 60 then
				chess_table = temp_table
				break
			end
		end
	end
	local delay = 0
	for _, final_chess in pairs(chess_table) do
		local target_pos = XY2Vector(final_chess.x, final_chess.y, hero:GetTeam())
		local target_chess = EntIndexToHScript(final_chess.entindex)
		MoveChessDelay(hero, target_chess, target_pos, delay)
		delay = delay + 0.05
	end
end

		end
		if t == 'top' then
			TopLineup(hero)
		end
		if t == 'bottom' then
			BottomLineup(hero)
		end
		if t == 'sparse' then

		end
	end
end

function ManaBurn(caster, target, ability, mana, is_damage, damage_type)
	if IsUnitExist(target) == false then
		return
	end
	local mana_after = target:GetMana() - mana
	if mana_after < 0 then
		mana_after = 0
	end
	local damage = target:GetMana() - mana_after
	target:SetMana(mana_after)

	if IsUnitExist(caster) == false then
		return
	end
	if caster:HasAbility('am_mana_break') == true then
		if caster.mana_burned == nil then
			caster.mana_burned = 0
		end
		caster.mana_burned = caster.mana_burned + mana

		local a = caster:FindAbilityByName('am_mana_break')
		local mana_void_required = GetAbilityKV(ability, "mana_void_required") or 100
		if caster.mana_burned >= mana_void_required then
			caster.mana_burned = 0
			caster.mana_void = true
			-- caster:FindAbilityByName("antimage_mana_void"):SetActivated(true)
		end
	end
	if is_damage == true and damage > 0 then
		ApplyDamage({
			victim = target,
			attacker = caster,
			damage = damage,
			damage_type = damage_type or DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL,
			ability = ability,
		})
		play_particle('particles/units/heroes/hero_antimage/antimage_manabreak_slow.vpcf', PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW,
			target, 3)
		EmitSoundOn('Hero_Antimage.ManaBreak', target)
	end
end

function AddChessMana(chess, mana, show)
	if chess:GetMana() >= 100 or chess:GetMaxMana() <= 0 then
		return
	end
	--lion：恶魔的凝视
	local is_demon_eye_dog = nil
	for i, v in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(chess.at_team_id or chess.team_id)) do
		if IsUnitExist(v) == true and v:GetTeam() ~= chess:GetTeam() and v:HasAbility('lion_demon_eye') then
			local a = v:FindAbilityByName('lion_demon_eye')
			local p = GetAbilityKV(a, 'mana_reduce_per') or 0
			local r = GetAbilityKV(a, 'radius') or 1
			if (v:GetAbsOrigin() - chess:GetAbsOrigin()):Length2D() <= r then
				mana = math.floor(mana * (100 - p) / 100)
				is_demon_eye_dog = v
			end
		end
	end
	if is_demon_eye_dog ~= nil and chess.demon_eye_particle == nil then
		play_particle("particles/generic_gameplay/generic_manaburn.vpcf", PATTACH_OVERHEAD_FOLLOW, chess, 3)
	end
	if chess:HasModifier('modifier_item_bingyan_2') then
		mana = mana/2
	end
	chess:SetMana(chess:GetMana() + mana)

	if show == true then
		AMHC:CreateNumberEffect(chess, mana, 2, AMHC.MSG_MISS, { 128, 128, 255 }, 0)
	end
	return mana
end

function GetHitDamage(u)
	local level = GetLevel(u)
	if u.eat_level ~= nil then
		level = level + u.eat_level
	end
	if HasKillModifier(u) == true then
		level = level / 2.0
	end
	local d = math.floor(1 + (1.0 * level / 3))
	return d
end

		local ice_wall_particle_effect_b = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(

		Timers:CreateTimer(0.5, function()
			for _, p in pairs(point_table) do
				-- local caster = keys.caster

				-- local role = keys.role or 2
				-- local radius = keys.radius or 500
				-- local modifier = keys.modifier
				-- local ability = keys.ability
				AddModifierInRadius({
					caster = caster,

					radius = 200,
					modifier = 'modifier_invoker_ice_wall_debuff',

					duration = 3,

function CalStreakPlusBoxLevel(hero)
	local terminate_level = hero.streak_plus_win or 1
	if terminate_level < (hero.streak_plus_lose or 1) then
		terminate_level = hero.streak_plus_lose
	end
	local box_level = 0
	local relic_history_count = table.maxn(GetRelicHistory(hero) or {}) or 1
	if terminate_level then
		if terminate_level >= 2 and terminate_level < 5 then
			box_level = relic_history_count + 0
		end
		if terminate_level >= 5 and terminate_level < 10 then
			box_level = relic_history_count + 1
		end
		if terminate_level >= 10 then
			box_level = relic_history_count + 2
		end
	end
	if box_level > 5 then
		box_level = 5
	end
	return box_level
end

function TriggerSMArcaneBolt(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	local target = keys.target
	if IsUnitExist(caster) == false then
		return
	end
	for _, sm in pairs(GetValidChessOnBoard(caster.at_team_id or caster.team_id)) do
		if IsUnitExist(sm) == true and IsChessCanCast(sm) == true and caster:GetTeam() == sm:GetTeam() and sm:HasAbility('skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt_container') then
			local ability = sm:FindAbilityByName('skywrath_mage_arcane_bolt_container')
			if ability ~= nil and ability:IsActivated() == true and ability:IsCooldownReady() == true then
				Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
					SMArcaneBolt({
						caster = sm,
						ability = ability,
						force_target = target,
					})
				end)
				if sm:HasModifier('modifier_is_harpy_buff') == true then
					Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(0.2,0.5), function()
						SMArcaneBolt({
							caster = sm,
							ability = ability,
						})
					end)
				end
				if sm:HasModifier('modifier_is_harpy_buff_plus') == true then
					Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(0.2,0.5), function()
						SMArcaneBolt({
							caster = sm,
							ability = ability,
						})
					end)
				end
				if sm:HasModifier('modifier_item_fashulengjing') then
					Timers:CreateTimer(RandomFloat(0.2,0.5), function()
						SMArcaneBolt({
							caster = sm,
							ability = ability,
						})
					end)
				end
				local cd = ability:GetCooldown(ability:GetLevel()) or 2.0
				cd = 1.0 * cd * GetCooldownPerByGod(sm)
				ability:StartCooldown(cd)
			end
		end
	end
end

function ShowDamageNumberEffect(entity, number, color, duration)
	local particle_table = {
		[1] = "effect/damage_show/damage_1.vpcf",
		[2] = "effect/damage_show/damage_2.vpcf",
		[3] = "effect/damage_show/damage_3.vpcf",
		[4] = "effect/damage_show/damage_4.vpcf",
		[5] = "effect/damage_show/damage_5.vpcf",
		[6] = "effect/damage_show/damage_6.vpcf",
		[7] = "effect/damage_show/damage_7.vpcf",
	}
	color = color or { 90, 145, 205 }
	duration = duration or 3
	number = number or 0
	if IsUnitExist(entity, true) == false then
		return
	end
	local color_r = tonumber(color[1]) or 255
	local color_g = tonumber(color[2]) or 255
	local color_b = tonumber(color[3]) or 255
	local color_vec = Vector(color_r, color_g, color_b)

	--处理数字
	number = math.floor(number)
	local number_count = #tostring(number) + 1

	local p = particle_table[1]
	if number > 200 then
		p = particle_table[2]
	end
	if number > 500 then
		p = particle_table[3]
	end
	if number > 1000 then
		p = particle_table[4]
	end
	if number > 2000 then
		p = particle_table[5]
	end
	if number > 4000 then
		p = particle_table[6]
	end
	if number > 10000 then
		p = particle_table[7]
	end

	--创建特效
	local particle = AMHC:CreateParticle(p, PATTACH_CUSTOMORIGIN_FOLLOW, false, entity, duration)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControlEnt(particle, 0, entity, 5, "attach_hitloc", entity:GetOrigin(), true)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle, 1, Vector(10, number, 9))
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle, 2, Vector(duration, number_count, 0))
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle, 3, color_vec)
end

function GetRandomChessByCostFromAllChess(cost, no_dup_table)
	local random_table = {}
	if no_dup_table == nil then
		no_dup_table = {}
	end
	if cost == 5 then
		if _G.chess_list_by_mana_gold then
			for _, c in pairs(_G.chess_list_by_mana_gold) do
				table.insert(random_table, c)
			end
		end
	else
		if _G.chess_list_by_mana[cost] then
			for _, c in pairs(_G.chess_list_by_mana[cost]) do
				table.insert(random_table, c)
			end
		end
		if _G.chess_list_by_mana_black[cost] then
			for _, c in pairs(_G.chess_list_by_mana_black[cost]) do
				table.insert(random_table, c)
			end
		end
	end
	if _G.chess_list_by_mana_special[cost] then
		for _, c in pairs(_G.chess_list_by_mana_special[cost]) do
			if c ~= 'chess_io' then
				table.insert(random_table, c)
			end
		end
	end

	local try_count = 0
	while try_count < 100 do
		local cc = random_table[RandomInt(1, table.maxn(random_table))]
		if FindValueInTable(no_dup_table,cc) == false and FindValueInTable(_G.chess_list_by_synergy['is_druid'],cc) == false then
			return cc
		end
		try_count = try_count + 1
	end
	return no_dup_table[RandomInt(1,table.maxn(no_dup_table))]
end

function CalDoubleCoin(caster)
	local gold = math.floor(caster:GetMana()) or 0
	local hp = math.floor(caster:GetHealth()) or 0
	if gold == hp then
		CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToTeam(caster:GetTeam(), "mima", {
			key = GetClientKey(caster:GetTeam()),
			text = "text_mima_no_double_coin_hp_gold"
		})
		return
	end
	local hp_new = hp
	local gold_new = gold
	local transfer_hp
	local transfer_gold
	if hp > gold then
		transfer_hp = math.floor(hp * 0.2 + 0.5)
		transfer_gold = transfer_hp
		hp_new = hp - transfer_hp
		gold_new = gold + transfer_gold
	else
		transfer_gold = math.floor(gold * 0.2 + 0.5)
		transfer_hp = transfer_gold
		hp_new = hp + transfer_hp
		gold_new = gold - transfer_gold
	end
	return {
		hp = hp,

function SwashbuckleStartNew(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	if IsUnitExist(caster) == false then
		return
	end
	local ability = caster:FindAbilityByName('pangolier_swashbuckle_new')
	if ability == nil then
		return
	end
	if ability:IsCooldownReady() == false then
		return
	end

	local end_radius = GetAbilityKV(ability, 'end_radius') or 150
	local inner_cooldown = GetAbilityKV(ability, 'inner_cooldown') or 3
	local chessboard_id = caster.at_team_id or caster.team_id

	--选一个方向，刺刺刺刺
	local di = FindGouheDirection(caster)
	if di == nil then
		local directions = {
			[1] = { x = 1, y = 0 },
			[2] = { x = 1, y = 1 },
			[3] = { x = 1, y = -1 },
			[4] = { x = -1, y = 0 },
			[5] = { x = -1, y = 1 },
			[6] = { x = -1, y = -1 },
			[7] = { x = 0, y = -1 },
			[8] = { x = 0, y = 1 },
		}
		local trytime = 0
		local di_random = nil
		while trytime < 100 and di == nil do
			di_random = directions[RandomInt(1, 8)]
			local target_point_x = Vector2X(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), chessboard_id)
			local target_point_y = Vector2Y(caster:GetAbsOrigin(), chessboard_id)
			while IsIn8x8(target_point_x + di_random.x, target_point_y + di_random.y) == true do
				target_point_x = target_point_x + di_random.x
				target_point_y = target_point_y + di_random.y
			end
			local find_enemy = TargetCountForMorph(
				target_point_x,
				target_point_y,
				caster,
				end_radius)
			if find_enemy.count > 0 then
				di = di_random
			end
			trytime = trytime + 1
		end
	end
	if di ~= nil then
		local direction = Vector(di.x * 128, di.y * 128, 0)
		-- 	caster:SetForwardVector(direction)
		ability.direction = direction
		ability.attack_count = 0
		ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(caster, caster, 'modifier_pangolier_swashbuckle_attack', { duration = 5 })
		ability:StartCooldown(inner_cooldown)
	end
end

function RequestPrecacheUnitAsync(precache_name,cb)
	--不参加异步加载
	if (string.find(precache_name,'courier_') == nil and string.find(precache_name,'model_') == nil) or (string.find(precache_name,'model_') ~= nil and string.find(precache_name,'11') == nil) or FindValueInTable(_G.precache_list,precache_name) == true then
		if cb then
			cb()
		end
	else
		--需要异步加载
		if _G.precache_busy == true then 
			Timers:CreateTimer(0.5,function()
				RequestPrecacheUnitAsync(precache_name,cb)
				return
			end)
		else
			--空闲，开始加载
			_G.precache_busy = true
			if _G.is_tester_mode == true then
	            combat('precache: '..precache_name)
	        end
			PrecacheUnitByNameAsync(precache_name, function()
				_G.precache_busy = false
				table.insert(_G.precache_list, precache_name)
				if cb then
					cb()
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

	local caster = keys.caster

	end

function ItemExchangeItems(keys)
	local caster = keys.caster
	local target = keys.target
	local relic_item = FindItemInInventory(caster,'item_exchange_items')
	local charges = relic_item:GetCurrentCharges()
	if charges < 1 then
		return
	end
	local item_count = 0
	local exchange_list = {}
	for slot = 0, 8 do
		if caster:GetItemInSlot(slot) ~= nil then
			local item = caster:GetItemInSlot(slot)
			local item_name = item:GetAbilityName()
			local item_level = _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[item_name]
			if item_level and charges >= item_level then
				DiscardOneItem(item_name, caster)
				table.insert(exchange_list,item_name)
				item_count = item_count + item_level
				charges = charges - item_level
				caster:RemoveItem(caster:GetItemInSlot(slot))
			end
		end
	end
	for i,v in pairs(exchange_list) do 
		local try_time = 50
		local new_item = nil
		while try_time > 0 do
			try_time = try_time - 1
			local item_level = _G.ITEM_2_LEVEL[v]
			local item_list = _G.ITEM_LIST_BY_LEVEL[item_level]
			new_item = item_list[RandomInt(1,table.maxn(item_list))]
			if FindValueInTable(caster.discard_item_table,new_item) == false then
				break
			end
		end
		caster:AddItemByName(new_item)
	end
	play_particle("particles/econ/items/windrunner/windranger_arcana/windranger_arcana_item_cyclone_v2_magic.vpcf",
		PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, caster, 3)
	EmitSoundOn('exchange.item',caster)
	ItemSpendCharge({
		caster = caster,
		ability = relic_item,
		charge = item_count,
	})
end

function ball_lightning_damage(keys)
	-- Variables
	local targetLoc = keys.target:GetAbsOrigin()
	local casterLoc = keys.caster.ball_lightning_start_pos
	if targetLoc == nil or casterLoc == nil then
		return
	end
	local ability = keys.ability
	local damage_per_distance = ability:GetAbilityDamage()
	local distance_per_damage = ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("distance_per_damage", ability:GetLevel() - 1)
	local damageType = ability:GetAbilityDamageType()

	if keys.caster:GetTeam() ~= keys.target:GetTeam() and keys.target:IsMagicImmune() == false then
		-- Calculate and damage the unit
		local real_damage = (targetLoc - casterLoc):Length2D() * damage_per_distance / distance_per_damage
		if real_damage > damage_per_distance * 20 then
			real_damage = damage_per_distance * 20
		end
		local damageTable = {
			victim = keys.target,
			attacker = keys.caster,
			damage = real_damage,
			damage_type = damageType,
			ability = ability,
		}
		ApplyDamage(damageTable)
	end
end

function shadow_fiend_requiem_of_souls_lua:Explode(lines)
	-- get references
	self.damage = self:GetAbilityDamage()
	self.duration = self:GetSpecialValueFor("requiem_slow_duration")

	-- get projectile
	-- local particle_line = "particles/units/heroes/hero_shadow_demon/shadow_demon_shadow_poison_projectile.vpcf"
	-- local particle_line = "effect/sf/proj.vpcf"
	local particle_lines = "particles/units/heroes/hero_nevermore/nevermore_requiemofsouls_line.vpcf"
	if self:GetLevel() == 3 then
		particle_lines = "effect/sf/1ofsouls_line.vpcf"
	end
	local line_length = self:GetSpecialValueFor("requiem_radius")
	local width_start = self:GetSpecialValueFor("requiem_line_width_start")
	local width_end = self:GetSpecialValueFor("requiem_line_width_end")
	local line_speed = self:GetSpecialValueFor("requiem_line_speed")
	local max_distance_time = line_length / line_speed

	-- create linear projectile
	local initial_angle_deg = self:GetCaster():GetAnglesAsVector().y
	local delta_angle = 360 / lines
	for i = 0, lines - 1 do
		-- Determine velocity
		local facing_angle_deg = initial_angle_deg + delta_angle * i
		if facing_angle_deg > 360 then
			facing_angle_deg = facing_angle_deg - 360
		end
		local facing_angle = math.rad(facing_angle_deg)
		local facing_vector = Vector(math.cos(facing_angle), math.sin(facing_angle), 0):Normalized()
		local velocity = facing_vector * line_speed

		-- create projectile
		local info = {
			Source = self:GetCaster(),
			Ability = self,
			EffectName = particle_lines,
			vSpawnOrigin = self:GetCaster():GetOrigin(),
			fDistance = line_length,
			vVelocity = velocity,
			fStartRadius = width_start,
			fEndRadius = width_end,
			iUnitTargetTeam = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,
			iUnitTargetFlags = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_SPELL_IMMUNE_ENEMIES,
			iUnitTargetType = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC,
			bReplaceExisting = false,
			bProvidesVision = false,
		}
		ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(info)

		-- Create the particle
		local particle_lines_fx = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(particle_lines, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN, self:GetCaster())
		ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle_lines_fx, 0, self:GetCaster():GetAbsOrigin())
		ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle_lines_fx, 1, velocity)
		ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle_lines_fx, 2, Vector(0, max_distance_time, 0))
		ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(particle_lines_fx)
	end

	-- Play effects
	self:StopEffects1(true)
	self:PlayEffects2(lines)
end

function IncreaseStackCount(event)
	-- Variables
	local caster = event.caster
	local target = event.target
	local ability = event.ability
	local modifier_name = event.modifier_counter_name
	local dur = ability:GetDuration()

	local modifier = target:FindModifierByName(modifier_name)
	local count = target:GetModifierStackCount(modifier_name, caster)

	-- if the unit does not already have the counter modifier we apply it with a stackcount of 1
	-- else we increase the stack and refresh the counters duration
	if not modifier then
		ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(caster, target, modifier_name, { duration = dur })
		target:SetModifierStackCount(modifier_name, caster, 1)
	else
		target:SetModifierStackCount(modifier_name, caster, count + 1)
		modifier:SetDuration(dur, true)
	end
end

function DecreaseStackCount(event)
	--Variables
	local caster = event.caster
	local target = event.target
	local modifier_name = event.modifier_counter_name
	local modifier = target:FindModifierByName(modifier_name)
	local count = target:GetModifierStackCount(modifier_name, caster)

	-- just some saftey checks -just in case
	if modifier then
		-- if there is something to reduce reduce
		-- else just remove the modifier
		if count and count > 1 then
			target:SetModifierStackCount(modifier_name, caster, count - 1)
		else
			target:RemoveModifierByName(modifier_name)
		end
	end
end

function spiked_carapace_reflect(keys)
	-- Variables
	local caster = keys.caster
	local attacker = keys.attacker
	local damageTaken = keys.DamageTaken

	if attacker == nil or attacker:IsNull() == true then
		return
	end

	-- Check if it's not already been hit
	if
		not caster.carapaced_units[attacker:entindex()]
		and not attacker:IsMagicImmune()
		and not attacker:HasModifier("modifier_spiked_carapace_buff_datadriven")
	then
		-- attacker:SetHealth( attacker:GetHealth() - damageTaken )

		ApplyDamage({
			victim = attacker,
			attacker = caster,
			damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE,
			damage = damageTaken,
		})

		keys.ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(caster, attacker, "modifier_spiked_carapaced_stun_datadriven", {})
		caster:SetHealth(caster:GetHealth() + damageTaken)
		caster.carapaced_units[attacker:entindex()] = attacker
	end
end

function invoker_chaos_meteor_datadriven_on_spell_start(keys)
	local caster_point = keys.caster:GetAbsOrigin()
	local target_point = keys.caster.target_position --keys.target_points[1]

	local caster_point_temp = Vector(caster_point.x, caster_point.y, 0)
	local target_point_temp = Vector(target_point.x, target_point.y, 0)

	local point_difference_normalized = (target_point_temp - caster_point_temp):Normalized()
	local velocity_per_second = point_difference_normalized * keys.TravelSpeed

	keys.caster:EmitSound("Hero_Invoker.ChaosMeteor.Cast")
	-- keys.caster:EmitSound("Hero_Invoker.ChaosMeteor.Loop")

	--Create a particle effect consisting of the meteor falling from the sky and landing at the target point.
	local meteor_fly_original_point = (target_point - (velocity_per_second * keys.LandTime)) + Vector(0, 0, 1000) --Start the meteor in the air in a place where it'll be moving the same speed when flying and when rolling.
	local chaos_meteor_fly_particle_effect = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(
		"particles/units/heroes/hero_invoker/invoker_chaos_meteor_fly.vpcf",
		PATTACH_ABSORIGIN,
		keys.caster
	)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(chaos_meteor_fly_particle_effect, 0, meteor_fly_original_point)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(chaos_meteor_fly_particle_effect, 1, target_point)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(chaos_meteor_fly_particle_effect, 2, Vector(1.3, 0, 0))

	--Chaos Meteor's main and burn damage is dependent on the level of Exort.  This values are stored now since leveling up Exort while the meteor is in midair should have no effect.
	local ability_level_table = {
		[5] = 1,
		[7] = 2,
		[9] = 3,
	}
	local ability_level = ability_level_table[keys.caster:GetLevel()] or 1
	local main_damage = keys.ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("main_damage", ability_level - 1)
	local burn_dps = keys.ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("burn_dps", ability_level - 1)

	--Chaos Meteor's travel distance is dependent on the level of Wex.  This value is stored now since leveling up Wex while the meteor is in midair should have no effect.
	local travel_distance = keys.ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("travel_distance", ability_level - 1)

	--Spawn the rolling meteor after the delay.
	Timers:CreateTimer({
		endTime = keys.LandTime,
		callback = function()
			--Create a dummy unit will follow the path of the meteor, providing flying vision, sound, damage, etc.
			local chaos_meteor_dummy_unit =
				CreateUnitByName("invisible_unit", target_point, false, nil, nil, keys.caster:GetTeam())
			chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:AddAbility("chaos_meteor_datadriven")
			local chaos_meteor_unit_ability = chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:FindAbilityByName("chaos_meteor_datadriven")
			if chaos_meteor_unit_ability ~= nil then
				chaos_meteor_unit_ability:SetLevel(1)
				chaos_meteor_unit_ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(
					chaos_meteor_dummy_unit,
					chaos_meteor_dummy_unit,
					"modifier_invoker_chaos_meteor_datadriven_unit_ability",
					{ duration = -1 }
				)
			end

			-- keys.caster:StopSound("Hero_Invoker.ChaosMeteor.Loop")
			chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:EmitSound("Hero_Invoker.ChaosMeteor.Impact")
			-- chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:EmitSound("Hero_Invoker.ChaosMeteor.Loop")  --Emit a sound that will follow the meteor.

			chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:SetDayTimeVisionRange(keys.VisionDistance)
			chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:SetNightTimeVisionRange(keys.VisionDistance)

			--Store the damage to deal in a variable attached to the dummy unit, so leveling Exort after Meteor is cast will have no effect.
			chaos_meteor_dummy_unit.invoker_chaos_meteor_main_damage = main_damage
			chaos_meteor_dummy_unit.invoker_chaos_meteor_burn_dps = burn_dps
			chaos_meteor_dummy_unit.invoker_chaos_meteor_parent_caster = keys.caster

			local chaos_meteor_duration = travel_distance / keys.TravelSpeed
			local chaos_meteor_velocity_per_frame = velocity_per_second * 0.03

			--It would seem that the Chaos Meteor projectile needs to be attached to a particle in order to move and roll and such.
			local projectile_information = {
				EffectName = "particles/units/heroes/hero_invoker/invoker_chaos_meteor.vpcf",
				Ability = chaos_meteor_unit_ability,
				vSpawnOrigin = target_point,
				fDistance = travel_distance,
				fStartRadius = 0,
				fEndRadius = 0,
				Source = chaos_meteor_dummy_unit,
				bHasFrontalCone = false,
				iMoveSpeed = keys.TravelSpeed,
				bReplaceExisting = false,
				bProvidesVision = true,
				iVisionTeamNumber = keys.caster:GetTeam(),
				iVisionRadius = keys.VisionDistance,
				bDrawsOnMinimap = false,
				bVisibleToEnemies = true,
				iUnitTargetTeam = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_NONE,
				iUnitTargetFlags = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NONE,
				iUnitTargetType = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_NONE,
				fExpireTime = GameRules:GetGameTime() + chaos_meteor_duration + keys.EndVisionDuration,
			}

			projectile_information.vVelocity = velocity_per_second
			local chaos_meteor_projectile = ProjectileManager:CreateLinearProjectile(projectile_information)

			chaos_meteor_unit_ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(
				chaos_meteor_dummy_unit,
				chaos_meteor_dummy_unit,
				"modifier_invoker_chaos_meteor_datadriven_main_damage",
				nil
			)

			--Adjust the dummy unit's position every frame.
			local endTime = GameRules:GetGameTime() + chaos_meteor_duration
			Timers:CreateTimer({
				callback = function()
					chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:SetAbsOrigin(
						chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:GetAbsOrigin() + chaos_meteor_velocity_per_frame
					)
					if GameRules:GetGameTime() > endTime then
						--Stop the sound, particle, and damage when the meteor disappears.
						-- chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:StopSound("Hero_Invoker.ChaosMeteor.Loop")
						chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:StopSound("Hero_Invoker.ChaosMeteor.Destroy")
						chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:RemoveModifierByName(
							"modifier_invoker_chaos_meteor_datadriven_main_damage"
						)

						--Have the dummy unit linger in the position the meteor ended up in, in order to provide vision.
						Timers:CreateTimer({
							endTime = keys.EndVisionDuration,
							callback = function()
								chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:SetDayTimeVisionRange(0)
								chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:SetNightTimeVisionRange(0)

								--Remove the dummy unit after the burn damage modifiers are guaranteed to have all expired.
								Timers:CreateTimer({
									endTime = keys.BurnDuration,
									callback = function()
										chaos_meteor_dummy_unit:RemoveSelf()
									end,
								})
							end,
						})
						return
					else
						return 0.03
					end
				end,
			})
		end,
	})
end

function sleight_of_fist_init(keys)
	-- Cannot cast multiple stacks
	if keys.caster.sleight_of_fist_active ~= nil and keys.caster.sleight_of_fist_action == true then
		keys.ability:RefundManaCost()
		return nil
	end

	-- Inheritted variables
	local caster = keys.caster
	local targetPoint = caster.target_position --keys.target_points[1]
	local ability = keys.ability
	local radius = ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("radius", ability:GetLevel() - 1)
	local attack_interval = ability:GetLevelSpecialValueFor("attack_interval", ability:GetLevel() - 1)
	local modifierTargetName = "modifier_sleight_of_fist_target_datadriven"
	local modifierHeroName = "modifier_sleight_of_fist_target_hero_datadriven"
	local casterModifierName = "modifier_sleight_of_fist_caster_datadriven"
	local dummyModifierName = "modifier_sleight_of_fist_dummy_datadriven"
	local particleSlashName = "particles/units/heroes/hero_ember_spirit/ember_spirit_sleightoffist_tgt.vpcf"
	local particleTrailName = "particles/units/heroes/hero_ember_spirit/ember_spirit_sleightoffist_trail.vpcf"
	local particleCastName = "particles/units/heroes/hero_ember_spirit/ember_spirit_sleight_of_fist_cast.vpcf"
	local slashSound = "Hero_EmberSpirit.SleightOfFist.Damage"

	-- Targeting variables
	local targetTeam = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY
	local targetType = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_BASIC + DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_HERO
	local targetFlag = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_FLAG_NO_INVIS
	local unitOrder = FIND_ANY_ORDER

	-- Necessary varaibles
	local counter = 0
	caster.sleight_of_fist_active = true
	caster.is_moving = true
	local dummy = CreateUnitByName(caster:GetName(), caster:GetAbsOrigin(), false, caster, nil, caster:GetTeamNumber())
	ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(caster, dummy, dummyModifierName, {})

	-- Casting particles
	local castFxIndex = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(particleCastName, PATTACH_CUSTOMORIGIN, caster)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(castFxIndex, 0, targetPoint)
	ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(castFxIndex, 1, Vector(radius, 0, 0))

	Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
		ParticleManager:DestroyParticle(castFxIndex, false)
		ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(castFxIndex)
	end)

	-- Start function
	local castFxIndex = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(particleCastName, PATTACH_CUSTOMORIGIN, caster)
	local units = FindUnitsInRadius(
		caster:GetTeamNumber(),
		targetPoint,
		caster,
		radius,
		targetTeam,
		targetType,
		targetFlag,
		unitOrder,
		false
	)

	for _, target in pairs(units) do
		counter = counter + 1
		ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(caster, target, modifierTargetName, {})
		Timers:CreateTimer(counter * attack_interval, function()
			-- Only jump to it if it's alive
			if target:IsAlive() then
				-- Create trail particles
				local trailFxIndex = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(particleTrailName, PATTACH_CUSTOMORIGIN, target)
				ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(trailFxIndex, 0, target:GetAbsOrigin())
				ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(trailFxIndex, 1, caster:GetAbsOrigin())

				Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
					ParticleManager:DestroyParticle(trailFxIndex, false)
					ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(trailFxIndex)
					return nil
				end)

				-- Move hero there
				FindClearSpaceForUnit(caster, target:GetAbsOrigin(), false)

				ability:ApplyDataDrivenModifier(caster, caster, modifierHeroName, {})

				caster:PerformAttack(target, true, true, true, false, false, false, true)

				-- Slash particles
				local slashFxIndex = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(particleSlashName, PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, target)
				StartSoundEvent(slashSound, caster)

				Timers:CreateTimer(0.1, function()
					ParticleManager:DestroyParticle(slashFxIndex, false)
					ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(slashFxIndex)
					StopSoundEvent(slashSound, caster)
					return nil
				end)

				-- Clean up modifier
				caster:RemoveModifierByName(modifierHeroName)
				target:RemoveModifierByName(modifierTargetName)
			end
			return nil
		end)
	end

	-- Return caster to origin position
	Timers:CreateTimer((counter + 1) * attack_interval, function()
		FindClearSpaceForUnit(caster, dummy:GetAbsOrigin(), false)
		dummy:RemoveSelf()
		caster:RemoveModifierByName(casterModifierName)
		caster.sleight_of_fist_active = false
		caster.is_moving = false
		return nil
	end)
end

function modifier_jump:UpdateHorizontalMotion(me, dt)
	if IsServer() then
		-- 判断是否到达了终点
		-- if self.leap_traveled < self.flDistance then
		if (me:GetAbsOrigin() - self.vTargetPosition):Length2D() > self.flHorizontalSpeed then
			me:SetAbsOrigin(me:GetAbsOrigin() + self.vDirection * self.flHorizontalSpeed)
			self.leap_traveled = self.leap_traveled + self.flHorizontalSpeed
			me:FaceTowards(self.vTargetPosition)
		else
			--到终点了
			me:SetAbsOrigin(self.vTargetPosition)
			RemoveAbilityAndModifier(me, "jiaoxie")
			me:InterruptMotionControllers(true)
			play_particle("particles/dev/library/base_dust_hit_shockwave.vpcf", PATTACH_ABSORIGIN_FOLLOW, me, 3)
			EmitSoundOn("Hero_OgreMagi.Idle.Headbutt", me)
			self:Destroy()
			me.is_moving = false
			me.blink_start_p = nil
			me.blink_stop_count = 0
		end
	end
end

	-- create linear projectile
	local info = {

		Ability = self,
		vSpawnOrigin = spawnPos,

		bDeleteOnHit = false,

		iUnitTargetTeam = DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_ENEMY,

		EffectName = projectile_name,
		fDistance = distance,
		fStartRadius = start_radius,
		fEndRadius = end_radius,
		vVelocity = direction * speed,

		bHasFrontalCone = false,

function grimstroke_stroke_of_fate_lua:OnProjectileHitHandle(target, location, handle)
	if IsServer() then
		if not target then
			-- unregister projectile
			self.active_proj[handle] = nil
			return true
		end

		-- register new projectile
		if not self.active_proj[handle] then
			self.active_proj[handle] = 0
		end

		-- get data
		local multiplier = self.active_proj[handle]
		local base_damage = self:GetAbilityDamage()
		local plus_damage = self:GetSpecialValueFor("bonus_damage_per_target")
		local slow = self:GetSpecialValueFor("slow_duration")

		local attacker_at_team_id = self:GetCaster().at_team_id or self:GetCaster().team_id
		local victim_at_teamid = target.at_team_id or target.team_id
		if attacker_at_team_id ~= victim_at_teamid then
			--不同棋盘的：无效
			return
		end

		-- damage
		local damageTable = {
			victim = target,
			attacker = self:GetCaster(),
			damage = base_damage + multiplier * plus_damage,
			damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL,
			ability = self, --Optional.
		}
		ApplyDamage(damageTable)

		-- debuff
		target:AddNewModifier(
			self:GetCaster(), -- player source
			self, -- ability source
			"modifier_grimstroke_stroke_of_fate_lua", -- modifier name
			{
				duration = slow,
			} -- kv
		)

		-- add stack
		self.active_proj[handle] = multiplier + 1

		-- play effects
		self:PlayEffects2(target)
	end
end

function tusk_walrus_punch_lua:OnSpellStart(keys)
	local caster = self:GetCaster()
	local target = self:GetCursorTarget()
	if caster == nil or caster:IsNull() == true then
		return
	end

	target:AddNewModifier(caster, self, "modifier_tusk_walrus_punch_flying", { duration = 1 })
	target.is_moving = true

	local damage_owner = caster.damage_owner
	if damage_owner == nil or damage_owner:IsNull() == true then
		local particle = ParticleManager:CreateParticle(
			"particles/units/heroes/hero_tusk/tusk_walruspunch_txt_ult.vpcf",
			PATTACH_ABSORIGIN,
			caster
		)
		ParticleManager:SetParticleControl(particle, 2, caster:GetAbsOrigin() + Vector(0, 0, 175))
		ParticleManager:ReleaseParticleIndex(particle)
		damage_owner = caster
	end

	caster:EmitSound("Hero_Tusk.WalrusPunch.Cast")
	target:EmitSound("Hero_Tusk.WalrusPunch.Target")

	--造成伤害
	local bonus_damage = self:GetSpecialValueFor("bonus_damage") or 0
	local crit_multiplier = self:GetSpecialValueFor("crit_multiplier") or 100
	local damage = damage_owner:GetAverageTrueAttackDamage(target) / 100.0 * crit_multiplier + bonus_damage

	ApplyDamage({
		victim = target,
		attacker = caster,
		damage = damage,
		damage_type = DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL,
		damage_flags = DOTA_DAMAGE_FLAG_NONE,
		ability = self,
	})
end

function modifier_toss:UpdateHorizontalMotion(me, dt)
	if IsServer() then
		-- 判断是否到达了终点
		-- if self.leap_traveled < self.flDistance then
		if self.step < 30 then
			me:SetAbsOrigin(self.vStartPosition + self.vDirection * self.fDistance * (self.step / 30))

		else

			me.is_moving = false

			self:Destroy()

			me.blink_stop_count = 0
		end
	end
end

function modifier_primal_beast_pulverize_lua_debuff:OnCreated(kv)
	self.parent = self:GetParent()
	self.caster = self:GetCaster()
	self.ability = self:GetAbility()
	self.isRoshan = self.parent:GetUnitName() == "npc_dota_roshan"

	-- references
	self.interval = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor("interval")
	self.radius = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor("splash_radius")
	self.ministun = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor("ministun")
	self.damage = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor("ministun")
	self.animrate = self:GetAbility():GetSpecialValueFor("animation_rate")

	if not IsServer() then
		return
	end

	-- ability properties
	self.damage = self:GetAbility():GetAbilityDamage()
	self.abilityDamageType = self:GetAbility():GetAbilityDamageType()
	self.abilityTargetTeam = self:GetAbility():GetAbilityTargetTeam()
	self.abilityTargetType = self:GetAbility():GetAbilityTargetType()
	self.abilityTargetFlags = self:GetAbility():GetAbilityTargetFlags()

	-- channel interrupt data
	self.interrupt_pos = self.caster:GetOrigin() + self.caster:GetForwardVector() * 200
	self.cast_pos = self.caster:GetOrigin()
	self.pos_threshold = 100

	-- caster attachment location
	local attach_rollback = {
		[1] = "attach_pummel",
		[2] = "attach_attack1",
		[3] = "attach_attack",
		[4] = "attach_hitloc",
	}
	for i, name in ipairs(attach_rollback) do
		self.attach_name = name
		if self.caster:ScriptLookupAttachment(name) ~= 0 then
			break
		end
	end

	-- parent attachment location
	local hitloc_enum = self.parent:ScriptLookupAttachment("attach_hitloc")
	local hitloc_pos = self.parent:GetAttachmentOrigin(hitloc_enum)
	self.deltapos = self.parent:GetOrigin() - hitloc_pos

	-- motion controller
	if not self:ApplyHorizontalMotionController() then
		if not self.isRoshan then
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
	end
	if not self:ApplyVerticalMotionController() then
		if not self.isRoshan then
			self:Destroy()
			return
		end
	end

	self:SetPriority(DOTA_MOTION_CONTROLLER_PRIORITY_HIGHEST)

	-- Start interval
	self:StartIntervalThink(self.interval)
end

		self.abilityTargetFlags, -- int, flag filter
		0, -- int, order filter
		false -- bool, can grow cache
	)

	-- precache damage
	local damageTable = {
		-- victim = target,
		attacker = self.caster,
		damage = self.damage,
		damage_type = self.abilityDamageType,
		ability = self.ability, --Optional.
		damage_flags = DOTA_DAMAGE_FLAG_NONE, --Optional.
	}

	for _, enemy in pairs(enemies) do
		-- damage
		damageTable.victim = enemy
		ApplyDamage(damageTable)

		-- stun
		enemy:AddNewModifier(
			self.caster, -- player source
			self, -- ability source
			"modifier_stunned", -- modifier name
			{ duration = self.ministun } -- kv
		)

		EmitSoundOn("Hero_PrimalBeast.Pulverize.Stun", self.caster)
	end

	-- play effects
	self:PlayEffects(origin, self.radius)

	-- cancel if caster moved away
	if (self.caster:GetOrigin() - self.cast_pos):Length2D() > self.pos_threshold then
		self:Destroy()
		return
	end
end

	-- Find enemies in radius

		false -- bool, can grow cache
	)

	-- damage enemies

		ApplyDamage(self.damageTable)

		-- Play effects
		self:PlayEffects2(enemy)
	end

	-- counter
	self.count = self.count + 1
	if self.count >= self.max_count then
		self:Destroy()
	end
end
